title: [Moonglae Inn, South Lobby]
description: Heavy oak doors open into the expansive lobby of the Moonglae Inn.  Greystone walls rise high overhead, where polished ironwood beams reinforce the sharply sloping roof.  Bustling porters usher new guests toward the front desk, while other visitors mingle in small groups, discussing the news of the day.  The room is dominated by a large eahnor planter circled by a round sofa that sits atop a plush red carpet in the center of the room.

title: [United Bank of City-States]
description: Rich wine-hued brocade draperies cover the walls of the small teller's room, leaving one to wonder who might be watching from behind.  The rich blue carpeting underfoot muffles the sound of movement as patrons conduct their business in hushed tones and move back out into the lobby.  The teller sits behind a tall counter, flanked by two elven guards.

title: [Herbalist's, Dispensary]
description: Redolent with a sweet, almost cinnamony fragrance, the herbalist's shop is dominated by a glass counter.  It contains small pouches of bark, leaves, berries and stems.  Syiah Kintaru, master herbalist, stands behind it, grinding herbs with a porcelain mortar and pestle.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east and west.  On the north wall is a curtained opening.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east and west.  On the north wall is a curtained opening.
You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east-west.  To the east you can see an intersection leading to more lockers, and a curtained opening on the north wall.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which intersects another running north-south.  The east wall of the hallway contains a curtained opening, as do most of the walls along the corridor.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which runs north-south.  On the east wall is a curtained opening, and to the north you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which ends here at a curtained opening along its east wall.  To the north you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which ends here at the north wall.  On the east wall is a curtained opening and to the south you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [First Elanith Bank, Teller]
description: Most of the teller windows that line this room are missing the gates and gratings that once secured them.  Impatient clients stand at one of the two intact windows, waiting to get the attention of the tellers on the other side.

title: [Aznell's Armory, Forge]
description: Bits and pieces of armor adorn the walls, leather on one, and metal on the facing wall.  Scraps of leather and metal are littered across the floor, thickest near the iron anvil where apprentices are working on a misshapen lump of metal.  The heat and the closeness of the forge press in around you.

title: [Tykel's Arms, Showroom]
description: Glancing about the interior of the shop reveals all manner of bladed weapons, from daggers to twohanded swords.  Most of the weaponry is wrought in bronze, although finer specimens reflect the glint of steel.  All seem to share an air about them that says, "This weapon is meant to be used".  Tykel the Weaponsmith stands ready to sing the praises of his handiwork.

title: [Dakris's Furs, Front Room]
description: This is the large front room of the furrier's shop.  Roughly hewn planks, supported by wooden barrels, span the space and serve as a counter.  Behind it presides Dakris the Furrier, purveyor of rare furs and hides.  A few simple chairs are randomly scattered along the dirt floor.  Across the room, to the southeast, you see a doorway covered only by a draped velnalin hide.

This is the large front room of the furrier's shop.  Roughly hewn planks, supported by wooden barrels, span the space and serve as a counter.  A few simple chairs are randomly scattered along the dirt floor.  Across the room, to the southeast, you see a doorway covered only by a draped velnalin hide.

title: [Kilron's Pawnshop, Front Room]
description: This little pawnshop is somewhat cheerier than you would expect, presided over by its well-dressed and well-heeled owner, Kilron.  A polished white marble counter is set off by freshly whitewashed walls and a highly varnished wood floor.  An antique cabinet on the far wall holds several impressive and equally ancient weapons, some precious trinkets, and several items that you cannot identify, except that they seem to glow in different shades of colored light with different intensities.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Front Desk]
description: A contoured counter of polished black oak curves along one side of the room, its high sheen reflecting light from a pair of glowing crystalline orbs which flank it.  Behind the counter, a wall-mounted shelf contains a complex of honeycombed cubicles.  A shallow niche on one wall contains the miniature carving of a leafless tree, the ends of its gnarled branches tipped with tiny luminous nodules.

title: [Ta'Illistim Weaponry]
description: Nearly dark and extremely warm, the weaponry resonates with the rythmic sound of a hammer on anvil coming from a back room.  An iron brazier casts a dim reddish light across the shop, glinting off the weapons displayed on various racks.

title: [Ta'Illistim Alchemy Supply]
description: The stone walls are hung with simple tapestries.  A small bronze brazier, its glowing coals emanating a gentle warmth, rests in one corner.  Gracefully carved modwir bookcases line the walls of the shop, laden with wands, rods, and supplies for crafting amulets.

title: [Valina's Herbs and Tinctures]
description: Row upon row of tiny glaesine bottles line wooden shelves, which in turn crowd every bit of wall space in this tiny shop.  Baskets of herbs rest at the foot of a large thanot worktable.  An open doorway leads further into the building's interior, the occasional murmur of conversation drifting from within.

title: [Old News Pawnshop]
description: The many racks, shelves and display cases of this shop are brimming with assorted merchandise.  Torchlight glistens on several blades carefully displayed in a glass case by the window, strategically placed to catch the eye of passersby.  Two elven lads chatter between themselves as they busily polish some armor.  The west wall of the shop is handsomely decorated with an array of shields.  An intricately carved cabinet in the center of the shop appears to be heavily padlocked.

Two elven lads chatter between themselves as they busily polish some armor.  The west wall of the shop is handsomely decorated with an array of shields.  An intricately carved cabinet in the center of the shop appears to be heavily padlocked.

title: [Alchemist's House, Shop]
description: The front part of the small house serves as an alchemist's shop.  The cramped room is filled with various ramshackle furnishings holding all manner of amulets, wands, phials, and magical potions.  A locked glass-paned bookcase holds ancient volumes and magical scrolls.  A strong steel door is set into the back wall.

title: [Reignbeau Caverns]
description: Many-hued clay forms the walls, ceiling, and floor of this low, twisting cavern.  Dozens of stalactites drip thick liquids in every color of the rainbow.  It takes a keen eye and a quick step to avoid an unintended change in hair color.  The clay that oozes from the walls and drops from above forms dozens of multihued puddles around you.  Grumbling, uncooperative dwarves loiter in every corner.

title: [Frith's Inn, Front Desk]
description: The front room of this unassuming inn imparts a sense of warmth and comfort.  Serving wenches carrying trays of food and drink to rooms throughout the hostelry cast a welcoming glance at you as they pass.  Laughter and the sound of good fellowship reach your ears from the direction of some swinging doors.  At the mahogany front desk, the friendly proprietor stands ready to attend to your needs.

title: [Tanzania's Gems & Jewelry]
description: Soft amber-hued velvet curtains frame the shop's glaesine windows.  Thick garnet-colored carpeting muffles all sounds of footfalls as shoppers mill about the shop, buying and selling various pieces of jewelry and gems.  Sunlight streams in through the glaesine windowpanes, illuminating the jewels displayed in cases along the rear wall.

Soft amber-hued velvet curtains frame the shop's glaesine windows.  Thick garnet-colored carpeting muffles all sounds of footfalls as shoppers mill about the shop, buying and selling various pieces of jewelry and gems.  Moonlight streams in through the glaesine windowpanes, illuminating the jewels displayed in cases along the rear wall.

title: [Gemcutter's, Front Room]
description: Inside the Gemcutter's shop, you see two glass showcases holding jewelry and precious stones.  Directly ahead of you is a low desk with several racks holding tools of the Gemcutter's trade.

title: [The Bank of Kharam-Dzu]
description: Surly dwarves grumble in line, clutching their coin-purses to their chests.  Opposite the doors is a high, black steel counter.  A spectacled dwarf is perched behind it, squinting at you from atop his tall chair.  All around him, bald heads and flailing hands bob up and down frantically.  The clinking of coins mixes with giggles of glee from the back.

title: [Golden Helm, Lobby]
description: The thick stone walls are hung with rich tapestries in velvet and silk.  A variety of battle-worn weapons are also displayed, some so old you have never seen their like.  An open guest registry book lies on the ornately-carved rosewood front desk, which faces the front doors.

title: [Big Snorri's Bows]
description: The smell of fresh shaved wood drifts through the air in this large shop.  Barrels of arrows line the walls while just over them, shelves holding bows and crossbows of various types stretch from wall to wall.  Like thick spider webs, bowstrings of different lengths hang from the ceiling.  Standing in the middle of the room is a giant counter.

title: [Locks Picked & Lockpicks]
description: Darkness seems to be the theme for this room as it has no lighting save for what washes in from the entrance.  Before you is a short wooden counter with an odd-looking tree of keys resting on it.  You notice a small note just under the tree.  Behind the counter, a slit-eyed halfling watches you with a practice-wary gaze.

Darkness seems to be the theme for this room as it has no lighting save for what washes in from the entrance.  Before you is a short wooden counter with an odd-looking tree of keys resting on it, beneath which is a small note.  A dusty wooden crate sits in a shadowed corner.  Behind the counter, a slit-eyed halfling watches you with a practice-wary gaze.

title: [Company Store, Pawnbroker]
description: This pawnshop seems fairly prosperous and upscale.  It is clean, though somewhat cluttered, and brightly lit.  The counter is made of a local hardwood and is polished to a bright luster.  Despite the obvious efforts to protect the counter top, a few scars tell of heavy usage.  A small pile of weapons is neatly stacked to one side while one of the assistants busily records their receipt.

title: [Company Store, Pelts & Mandible]
[Company Store, Pelt & Mandible]
description: Pelts and skins from several creatures are tacked to the walls.  Several creatures have been stuffed and mounted.  Looking behind you, you see over the red archway a huge bone that looks like a giant rib.  It spans from the floor, over the archway and back to the floor again.  The counter before you is haphazardly covered with several hides, as the proprietor has yet to remove them from the counter.

Several creatures have been stuffed and mounted around the room, while the pelts and skins of others are tacked to the walls.  Spanning the red archway is a huge bone that looks like a giant rib.  The counter before you is haphazardly covered with several hides, apparently awaiting proper storage.  A rickety staircase leads down toward the source of some very powerful odors.

title: [Company Store, Armory]
description: Large display cases line the room and provide customers with examples of local wares.  Shields of varying size and description, and of several different materials, are mounted high up on the walls.  Armor mounted upon stands fill the floor of the armory and provide an example of the quality of their workmanship.

title: [Company Store, Weaponry]
description: The sharp smell of oil greets your senses while the wide selection of weaponry displayed around you seems enough to appease the desires of even the most jaded warrior.  Racks of weapons line the walls while the center of the room is dominated by a large grindstone.  The weapons seem to be of uncommonly high quality for a mining town.

title: [Company Store, Jeweler]
description: Everything in the room shines and sparkles in the light.  Even the simple counter manages a fine reflection in its polished glass face.  Your only hint of an actual workplace is a small desk near the back that has a few carefully placed jeweler's tools upon it.

title: [Teras Isle Forging Supply Shop]
description: Resembling an hourglass laid on its side, this chamber appears to have been naturally formed, then embellished and made functional by dwarven design and labor.  The choke-point in the center of the cavern is almost entirely filled by a steel-topped counter and display case, and beyond it, hammerfalls echo from a dozen or so tunnels that pierce the curving walls.  A dwarven attendant stands behind the counter, patiently waiting to provide whatever assistance might be needed.

title: [Kharam-Dzu Exchange, Inside]
description: The floors are a bit stained and there are visible signs of rot along the corners.  Apparently, this place has been flooded more than once.  Yet despite the signs of wear business continues.  Several young dwarves walk back and forth delivering or removing large piles of papers from the clerk's desks.  The clerks simply nod, remaining engrossed in their job.

title: [Temple, Cleric Room]
description: The most noticeable feature of the room is the massive dome overhead.  The tall domed ceiling apexes at a grey crystal set into the roof.  Two pillars help to support the dome while a band of silver, interrupted by raised rune designs, encircles the base of the dome.  A small window allows a view of the nocturnal world outside while the light from the crystal tints the room to a light shade of grey.  A simple blue rug rings the perimeter of the room.

A small window allows a little light in while the light from the crystal tints the room to a light shade of grey.  A simple blue rug rings the perimeter of the room.

title: [Sorena's Emporium]
[Sorena's Emporium, Showroom]
[Sorena's Alchemy, Showroom]
description: Lamps are slung from some of the thickest roots.  Shelves have been hollowed out of the walls and are filled with dark glass jars and clay pots.  A slab of granite in the center of the room serves as the worktable.  It is covered with vials, tubes, candles and various tools of alchemy.  Fluids, in all colors of the spectrum, bubble and hiss in their glass containers.

title: [Cottage, Back Room]
description: The back room is cluttered with bits of dried animal hanging on strings from the ceiling, jars full of oddly colored liquids and foul smells that cling to the walls and your clothes like the cloying grip of a banshee.  Sitting amidst the clutter you see a decrepit wreck of a man, his stringy hair jutting at odd angles away from his head, his clothes mere rags that hang limply on his cadaverous frame.

title: [Cottage, Living Room]
description: Littered about the main room of the rickety cottage are cots made of stone.  They look very functional but also very hard and uncomfortable.  Several wounded people lie on them, being tended to by Mirtag, the local healer.

title: [Glowing Zircon Gem Shop]
description: Zirconia the Jeweller sits with her feet up on a short steel counter as she sorts through a small chest full of gems.  Occasionally digging into a bulging money bag to toss coins at gem sellers, she whistles happily to herself as she works.

Apprentices, all lined up in a row at a short steel counter, work diligently grading and sorting the incoming stones and precious gems under the eagle eye of their supervisor.  An assortment of jeweler's loupes, polishing cloths, and sizing charts lay close to hand, ready to help in the evaluation of the merchandise.

title: [Berrytoe's General Store]
[Berrytoe's Bare Essentials]
description: Barrels and boxes draped in cloth of all shades cover the wooden floor of this small store.  A group of dwarves stands off to one side, haggling furiously with a halfling.  The halfling waves his arms angrily, nearly hitting a dwarf with a tiny backpack.  At one end of the room, another halfling guards a counter full of wares.

Polished barrels and decoratively etched crates draped in bright cloth have been placed strategically around the shop to attract the eyes of milling customers to the wares set out upon them.  A round glass skylight in the ceiling above casts sunbeams on a miniature snow-covered village placed on a stand in the center of the room.  A group of dwarves off to the side haggles furiously with a flustered sales assistant, while behind a counter against the the opposite wall, the merchant Berrytoe stands with a welcoming smile.

title: [Blackfinger's Locks]
description: The walls of this small room are lined with small, gold-framed cases holding some of Blackfinger's finer wares.  Ranging from diamond-encrusted lockpicks to the simplest pick, the cases glow in the warm candlelight.  A low oak workstand lines one wall of the room, on which Blackfinger cheerfully works his talents.

title: [Pawnshop, Interior]
description: Stark wooden floorboards creak under the weight of stacks of bundled weapons and leather.  Perched atop the tall bundles is a halfling clerk who looks none too eager to help you.  In a place of honor on the wall opposite the door is a portrait of Sniffberry, the pawnshop proprietor.

title: [Furryback's Pelt and Skin]
description: Stacks of hides and pelts cover the floor in this cramped shop, leaving a narrow trail to the counter.  A bright-eyed halfling sits on top of the counter, sorting through a stack of skins as he talks to himself under his breath.

title: [Pinefar, General Store]
description: This is a warm domain of polished oak surfaces and clumps of sweet-smelling herbs hanging from low rafters.  Another of the generous hearths covers one wall, with a low sales-counter opposite it.  Shelves stretch from floor to ceiling behind the counter, filled with a variety of merchandise, and pastries line the counter-top in a tempting display.

title: [Pinefar, Furrier Shop]
description: The  shop has the aromatic scent of tanned hides, filled as it is with floor-to-ceiling shelves which sport all manner of furs and leathers, each neatly rolled.  A tall stack of furs and pelts fills one corner as well. Over the curtain leading into the General Store, a horseshoe hangs askew, making one wonder if it'll fall with one more passage beneath its precarious perch.

title: [Pinefar, Infirmary]
description: The room is aromatic, scented with bunches of herbs that hang from the beamed ceiling like garland.  An oak counter is cluttered with glass canisters filled with all sorts of powders and leaves, and a bed sits against the far wall, the two pieces being the room's only furnishings.  A window sporting a white linen drape offers a view of the snowy landscape.

The room is aromatic, scented with bunches of herbs that hang from the beamed ceiling like garland.  An oak counter is cluttered with glass canisters filled with all sorts of powders and leaves, and a bed sits against the far wall, the two pieces being the room's only furnishings.  A window sporting a white linen drape offers a view of the moonlit, snowy landscape.

title: [Pinefar, Gemshop]
description: The small cranny of a shop has walls painted a deep shade of burgundy, which are edged with polished oak.  Shelves cover the back wall, fronted by a low counter with a glass top and shallow drawers beneath that.  One small window gives a view of the mountainside, but heavy bars criss-cross the view just outside the glass, protecting the room from intrusion.

Shelves cover the back wall, fronted by a low counter with a glass top and shallow drawers beneath that.  One small window gives a view of the moonlit mountainside, but heavy bars criss-cross the view just outside the glass, protecting the room from intrusion.

title: [Pinefar, Depository]
description: Pinefar's Depository is painted a respectable shade of dark green.  A couple of dusty-looking animal trophies decorate the walls.  The entire back of the room is covered with a wooden screen polished to the same luster as elsewhere in the manor, and behind this carved grill sits a sleepy-looking halfling, painstakingly counting a pile of coins.

title: [Leaftoe's Health and Bake Shop]
description: A brick oven radiates heat from the corner.  Flour dusts the walls and floor, almost like a light snow.  Tins of sugar and other components line shelves on the walls, and bundles of herbs hang from the ceiling.  The room is filled with happy chaos, centering on the famed baker Leaftoe, who bustles about checking on the wares.

title: [Icemule Trace, Bank]
description: A row of highly polished brass teller windows lines the back wall of the bank.  Staggered in height from short to tall, their ledges comfortably accommodate travellers of all sizes.  Suspended from the ceiling is a gilded silver sign.

title: [Icemule Trace Exchange]
description: The room is a bustle of activity with clerks moving stacks of paper left and right for reasons you cannot begin to fathom.  A musty wood fragrance fills the air, somewhat reminiscent of an old log cabin filled with dust.  Just behind a low wooden desk sits a middle-aged halfling clerk who seems to be waiting impatiently for something.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: Deep fur rugs line the floors of the office, providing warm beds for several sleeping cats and dogs.  Stacks of crates and boxes line the office walls, marked with exotic destinations.

title: [Thirsty Penguin, Front Desk]
description: A narrow desk with a bouquet of forget-me-nots perched cheerfully on its top is set before a short hallway.  Highly polished lamps brighten up every corner of this crowded room, encouraging you to warm yourself before setting out again.  A crystal statue of a penguin, nearly as tall as a halfling, twinkles in the light.

title: [Xenophon's Fletcher Shop]
description: This cozy shop is lit by dozens of wax candles that glimmer on the shelves, illuminating stacks of elk hide quivers and various style of bolts and arrows.  Bows of fine wood and bone stand along the walls, ready for inspection by discerning archers.  Shop assistants busy themselves with wood and feathers in the back of the room, and a wooden counter inlaid with polished mithril stands before you.

title: [Wineberry's Weapons, Shop]
description: In spite of the obviously recent renovations, the main room of the shop retains a faint scent of oil and smoke that is not altogether unpleasant.  Several halflings wander about, polishing metal surfaces or adjusting the position of something to better catch the light.  Fresh sawdust is scattered on the ground, wet footprints tracked through it here and there.

title: [Haldrick's Armory]
description: This shop lies below street level, half-moon windows along the front illuminating racks of armor and shields.  Recent renovations have left traces of dust currently being excised by an apprentice with a broom.

title: [Exchange Booth]
description: Inside the cramped confines of the booth is an iron teller's cage from which the beady eyes of a swarthy gnome in uniform peer back.  Wreaths of island flowers attempt to soften the otherwise foreboding iron.  A pair of local guardsmen bearing pole-axes wander in occasionally to survey the surroundings.

title: [Four Winds Bank, Teller Windows]
[Mist Harbor Bank, Bank Windows]
description: A magnificent bouquet of freshly cut orchids sits on a table at the center of the room.  Beneath it, an intricate mosaic depicting a scene from one of the island's gardens is inlaid upon the wood floor.  Behind a long counter stretching from wall to wall, tellers are busy helping customers.  Casually dressed guards stand at each end of the counter, quietly watching the room.  Mounted on the ceiling, a massive woven palm frond fan softly whirrs as its tiny pulleys help keep the room nice and comfortable.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Lobby]
description: Complex layers of stacked stone, ranging in color from palest grey to nearly solid black, form the entire rear wall into one massive fireplace.  The flames spread their welcome warmth throughout the greatroom, warding off the chill let in by the constant comings and goings of guild members.  Enormous tusked and horned heads of the fierce beasts of the north are mounted along the east wall, gazing at the rest of the guild through glass eyes.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Office]
description: Pushed against the polished mahogany walls are matching leather armchairs separated by gilt-edged end tables.  Twirling gently from its chain overhead, the clacking prisms from the crystal chandelier produce a soft melodic chime.  Directly beneath the fixture rests an oval shaped desk inlaid with blue lapis lazuli along its edges.  Tucked at the back of the room, the dried and well-preserved carcass of a mammoth arachnid rests within a glass display case.

title: [Our Colorful Place, Entry]
description: Multi-colored rugs and brilliantly hued walls mark the entry into this small, cozy shop.  A multi-colored counter, painted with every color of the rainbow, monopolizes most of the room.  Standing behind the counter, Darirose, the tiny halfling owner, and her night staff await new orders and instructions.

Standing behind the counter, Darirose, the tiny halfling owner, and her children await new orders and instructions.

title: [Healer's Tent, Treatment Room]
description: A sense of relief and anticipation pervades the softly-lit tent.  The makeshift room, small and crowded with the ill and wounded, contains the astringent odor of balms and ungents.  Old rugs depicting the healing powers of various deities and magical practices lie on the ground.  At the far end of the tent stands a long, padded table.

Old rugs depicting the healing powers of various deities and magical practices lie on the ground.  At the far end of the tent stands a long, padded table.

title: [Etaenia's Jewels]
description: Blue, green, and purple striped rugs are scattered about on the floor, like small islands, while an oak counter partially spans one side of the room.  A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, the curtains drawn back allowing daylight to enter.

A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, and crystal lamps are hung between the windows, providing additional lighting.

title: [Aegenis General Store]
description: Torches cast flickering light across the stone walls of this cavernous shop.  The high walls terminate in a vaulted roof high above, fashioned of thick wooden timber.  Various pieces of metalwork hang suspended from the beams above.  A long wooden counter stands before a curtained doorway through which employees occasionally wander.

title: [Ta'Illistim Armory]
description: Torchlight glimmers on the armory's marcasite-flecked granite walls and across the dull sheen of the smooth black slate floor.  Stacks of leather and heavy cloth are piled atop a bench near the back of the shop, ready to be fashioned into tunics and robes.  A clerk sits behind a massive sales counter just inside the door.

title: [Gaedrein's Furs and Pelts]
description: Stacks of furs and pelts are thickly layered upon maoral shelves which cover the shop's stone walls from floor to ceiling.  Several glaesine lanterns hanging from the rafters above cast a dim amber glow across the windowless room.  A lone counter sits at the rear of the shop, behind which the shop's proprietor stands, waiting for patrons to assist.

title: [Ta'Illistim Locksmith]
description: Small hooks have been fastened to the stone wall behind the locksmith's counter.  Dangling from the hooks are key blanks and lockpicks fashioned of a wide array of materials, some plain and others quite ornate.  Multicolored carpets are scattered across the stone floor, glowing in the sunlight beaming in through the glaesine windows.

title: [Bank of Ta'Illistim Exchange]
description: The small cottage that serves as the city's exchange booth clearly is often visited, as the stone flooring underfoot has been deeply worn in a path from the door to the clerk's desk.  An engraved mithglin sign is mounted upon the wall behind the desk.

The ground level of the tower which serves as the city's exchange is clearly often visited, as the stone flooring underfoot has been deeply worn in a path from the door to the clerk's desk.  An engraved silver sign is mounted upon the wall behind the desk.

title: [Hall of Patrons, Chamber]
description: A variety of verdant ivy adorns the walls, creeping along the high windows in a twining embrace.  The surroundings are a stark white -- the brilliant luster of the polished marble reflecting the light in beautiful, sparkling waves.  A deep black pool stands within the center of the room, its edges chased with delicate silver-hued designs.

title: [Gaertira's Herbs]
description: Colorfully-painted planters brimming with fresh herbs and flowers are supported by wooden poles that are evenly spaced around this open-air platform.  The numerous fragrances of this tiny treetop garden mingle together into a delightful harmony of aroma.  A modwir counter has been topped off with a granite slab, serving as a worktable for creating tinctures, tonics, and other healing concoctions.

title: [Treetop Market]
description: Fragrant wisteria coils around the white-washed latticework that has been suspended as the ceiling, from which dangles several of the smaller wares for sale.  Stocked shelves are festooned with garlands of lilies and roses, while lovely bouquets sit upon display tables.  An antique rocking chair with a throw blanket folded over one arm rests cozily beside a simple carved stand.

title: [Gems of the Earth]
description: Shards of colored glass dangle from the ceiling, casting a myriad of jewel tones upon the platform as sunlight shines through them.  A simple wooden counter houses two rather large chests and serves as the only furniture on this level of the store.  Sturdy-looking steps rise to the second floor in a wide spiral around a massive tree trunk.

Shards of colored glass dangle from the ceiling, glimmering like jewels amid the freestanding torches.  A simple wooden counter houses two rather large chests and serves as the only furniture on this level of the store.  Sturdy-looking steps rise to the second floor in a wide spiral around a massive tree trunk.

title: [Hihaeim's Locksmithery]
description: Plaster and stone walls remain unadorned, along with the majority of the room.  Though vacant, the shop is meticulously clean and nary a speck of dust can be found.  A bejeweled brass bin is tucked behind a smooth granite counter, prominently displaying a catalog of wares.  Warm light shines through a narrow oak archway draped in pale blue fabric.

A catalog of wares is prominently displayed upon a smooth granite counter, open for perusal and to facilitate the delivery of orders from the curtained-off backroom.

title: [Haegan's Weaponry]
description: Recent renovations are apparent in this small shop, from the new tile floor to a rather pristine wood-paneled walls.  The tang of metal and faint scent of oil linger in the air, drifting over from the neighboring forge.  A small burnished counter stands before several organized racks that display the numerous weapons for sale.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Entry]
description: Clear lacquer preserves the golden hue of the oak used to create wide railings and the shelves beneath, which are fitted into the wide sides of the tanik tree at the edge of the circular platform.  Silken banners spread through the branches forming a colorful roof that shimmers when sunlight filters through the leafy canopy above.  Pillows lay in organized heaps among wicker baskets filled with vials of dye.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Colorful dupioni silk tapestries showing various scenes of wizards at work and play conceal one of the shop's stone walls.  The room is illuminated by mullein torches that cast a flickering light along the walls.  Natural recesses in the stone serve as bookcases, housing huge, dusty leather-bound volumes.  A stalagmite draped with an irregular piece of water-stained damask stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Urgaen's Pawnshop]
description: Melodic chimes dangle above the ash door, signaling the arrivals and departures from this cozy pawnshop.  Dangling above a polished white oak counter, a crooked plank has been decorated with a child's colorful beadwork that reads, "Pawnshop."  A fringed curtain obscures an archway that leads to the rear of the shop.

title: [Cysaegir Bank]
description: Simple wooden teller windows fitted with glaes panes stand open to service the many Aelotoi men and women bustling about.  A domed skylight allows sunshine to stream in, glinting off the silver coins being transferred, withdrawn, and deposited.  Vivid butterflies have been painted flitting across the pale pink and blue-tinted stone walls.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Lobby]
description: Beautifully rendered watercolor and oil paintings adorn the silver-speckled marble walls.  Cushioned benches offer a grand view of the heavily trafficked foyer while a banistered oak stairway leads off to other attractions of the Naerine Hostelry.  Faint sounds of rushing water can be heard through a set of glaes-paned doors leading out to the bailey.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Front Desk]
description: Beautiful stained glass windows depict idyllic landscapes of an exotic world, cast aglow by the warm rays of golden sunlight.  A vivid silk tapestry of a robed female silhouette hangs behind the varnished front desk, greeting those checking in for a stay.

title: [Metalworkers' Central Platform]
description: A metal-topped counter occupies the central third of the platform, and a large sign hangs from the main post that rises behind the counter.  A ruddy-complected giantman, with shoulders and arms heavily muscled even for one of his race, leans on an oversized boarding pike, a polished glaes toothpick protruding from his mouth.

title: [Mercantylers' Storage Warehouse]
description: Lanterns light this windowless central chamber, where carved signs resembling small, locked strongboxes point to a curtained alcove and to hallways leading east and south.   A padlocked and barred double door closes off the entire western wing of the building from prying eyes and public access.  The wooden image of a wagon stacked high with lockers hangs above a doorway set in the northwest corner of the chamber.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: A faded threadbare rug covers the floorboards in front of the desk that a half-Elven clerk is seated behind.  Everywhere else, chests and crates stenciled with the letters 'S O L H A V E N' fill the corners and stand in stacks along the walls.

title: [Locksmith, Backroom]
description: The backroom of the locksmith's shop is stark, and lit by a single tallow candle.  A blob of wax secures the candle atop a locked case that provides the only seating in the uncomfortable room.  A tall cabinet secured with a sturdy padlock occupies the far wall.

title: [Bank of Vornavis, Solhaven]
description: Dark panelled walls rise above you, culminating in a carved coffered ceiling.  The plush burgundy carpets are silent underfoot.  Merchants and townsfolk mill about, speaking in hushed, reverent whispers.  Three teller windows are open, the quiet clink of coins drifting from within.

title: [The North 'Haven Pawnery]
description: A middle-aged man wearing a bushy salt-and-pepper beard and a sour expression stands behind a modwir counter that bears the rounded edges and marring of a thousand transactions.  The cracked and yellowed plaster walls, dilapidated counter and the appearance of the proprietor suggest a distinctly Dwarven influence, if not lineage.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Main Hall]
description: Royal blue wall hangings and marble sheathed walls lend an air of elegance to the main hall of the Inn.  Black, white, and rose marble is placed in an elaborate pattern covering the floor.  Several vultite inlaid modwir tables are ranged around the edge of the room, each with a pair of heavy carved modwir chairs in attendance.  The centerpiece of the room is an immense crystal and candle chandelier, which sends sparks of soft light throughout the room.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Front Desk]
description: A highly-polished black marble counter runs along one wall, flanked by two large brass urns, each planted with a flowering tree heavy with red and white blossoms unlike anything ever seen in nature before.  The white marble tiled floor reflects the light from the brass and crystal wall-mounted lamps, giving off just enough illumination to sign the registration book.

title: [Kahlyr's Precious Gems]
description: Everything in this small shop gleams softly in the candlelight flickering from a crystal chandelier hanging overhead.  A row of glaes-paned cases lines one wall, the first holding a collection of gems and the second displaying a diamond necklet.  A carved wooden counter rests opposite.  A carpeted stairway leads up to the second floor of the shop.

title: [Sargassa's, Front Room]
description: This bright, sunny room smells strongly of dried herbs and flowers.  Long shelves hold rows of glaes-blown bottles and small wooden herb boxes.  A young half-elven girl whistles to herself as she busily stocks the shelves.

title: [Sargassa's, Infirmary]
description: Cots covered in soft blankets line the walls of this cozy, darkened room.  A merry fire dances in a small fireplace opposite the door.  From an iron pot dangling over the fire, a foul-smelling concoction bubbles over.  An ancient-looking elven woman bustles about, herbs bursting from her apron pockets and bandages dangling from her arms.

title: [Slim Jyhm's]
description: An eight-paned glaes window in the front of the shop makes this undoubtedly the best lit shop in all of Marshtown.  A leather topped counter separates the locksmith, his workbench and impressive array of lockpicking tools from the area where customers stand.

title: [The Legendary Rest, Lobby]
description: A spacious lobby replete with gleaming brass fixtures, plush woolen carpet, and polished walnut furniture greets guests both coming and going.  Carved, thickly padded walnut chairs reside next to lacquered walnut tables, their wood grain surfaces rubbed to a mirror-like sheen, and richly appointed tapestries adorn the walls.  A pair of heavy walnut doors, inlaid with cut-glass panes, allow exit to an immaculate courtyard, while a dignified elf waits stiffly behind a polished walnut desk.

title: [Stone Turret, Ground Floor]
description: The cool, stony darkness of this circular room is pierced by a shaft of sunlight coming through the open doorway.  A thick carpet softens the footsteps of the well-heeled gentry who stop to chat with the staff seated at a long table before ascending a twisting stone staircase.

A dozen tiny lamps, flickering in the draft coming through the open doorway, light this stone-walled, circular room.  A thick carpet softens the footsteps of the well-heeled gentry who stop to chat with the staff seated at a long table before ascending a twisting stone staircase.

title: [Alchemist's House, Consignment]
description: Blackened from a previous mishap with fire, the wooden table in one corner of the room has a rickety bench tucked beneath it.  Lining the back wall of this spacious room, sturdy oak planks serve as bookshelves housing over a dozen thick, leather-bound tomes.  Directly opposite the bookcase stands an oval-shaped glass counter, completely empty except for a lantern capped with a multicolored glass globe.

title: [Alchemist's House, Commodities]
description: Carpets in a variety of somber shades are tossed haphazardly across the floor.  Patterned in the center of each rug, in a brilliant gold thread, are interlocking spheres of assorted sizes.  Pushed against the wall of the chamber, holding an assortment of alchemical paraphernalia, stands a sturdy solid oak table.  Several clear-globed lanterns hang high overhead to provide adequate lighting for the various accoutrements available for purchase.

title: [Public Workshops Supply Stall]
description: A tin-clad counter occupies the center of the stall, and a large sign hangs from the main post that rises in the stall's center.  An almost grim faced half-elf, with broad shoulders and muscled biceps, stands behind the counter, a polished mithril toothpick held in her teeth.

title: [Wehnimer's, Shop Cellar]
description: Wrought iron candelabras occupy opposite corners of the room, casting a series of flickering shadows along the ceiling and walls.  Multicolored throw rugs patterned with interlocking spheres are scattered throughout the basement.  An oddly shaped table and a single ladder-back chair rest in the far corner of the room near an old pot-bellied stove.

title: [General Store, Salesroom]
description: All manner of goods are piled high on long flat tables and sturdy shelves here in the general store.  The smell of leather mixing with that of candle wax, the gleam of metal reflecting the sheen of silk and the feel of wood and ivory makes this room an interesting assault on your senses.

title: [Raging Thrak Inn, Front Desk]
description: A polished wooden desk sits to the side of the staircase, and bears the placard of the Thrak's proprietor.  At the top of the creaky wooden stairs are the establishment's guest rooms.

title: [Quaeta's Fletcher Shop]
description: Panels of wood cover the walls, stained rich and dark.  Shelves seem to grow from the wood, varnished in lighter tones.  Upon these rest bows of all shapes and sizes.  Some are intricately carved, others are unadorned, but all are of the highest quality.  Crossbows hang from hooks on the walls, and bowstrings dangle from the ceiling.  A counter sits against the west wall, displaying an array of arrowheads.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: Tidier than the lobby, the office is arranged quite professionally.  A well-crafted dark rug covers the wooden floor and a small, charcoal etching is framed on the wall behind the desk.  Stacks of crates labelled with various destinations are arranged neatly in a corner.

title: [Wehnimer's Exchange, Inside]
description: The inside of the booth is brightly lit.  Clerks in smart uniforms greet customers with a smile, inquiring about the voyage and the wonders found on the other side of the sea as they exchange your funds.  The air of the place is one of salutation, bidding you a cheerful welcome home.

title: [Loci Workshop, Antechamber]
description: A granite worktable, clearly a relic of the workshop's past, stands immovably at the center of the room.  Positioned behind the massive slab of granite and blocking the passageway that leads further into the shop is a bulky, heavily robed figure.  Freshly strewn rushes spotted with dried lavender and rosemary cover the floor, their scent failing to combat the lingering, acrid odor of smoke.  The aroma is not aided by the pungent smell of fish oil burning in the lamps suspended from the ceiling.

title: [Icemule Forging Supply Shop]
description: A well-beaten path provides contrast against the frost covered area leading up to a small counter.  Various glyphs and metals have been neatly stacked next to a small iron brazier.  To the south you see the rooftops of the local armory and weapons shop.

title: [Clenchfist Bros. Banking, Lobby]
description: Lit by plain iron lanterns, the unfinished modwir boards of the teller's counter, rough-sawn planks of the floor, bare log walls and drab garb of the dour dwarven teller make it obvious that no extra expense or effort has been spent here to dress the place up.  Nothing more has been done than was needed to provide a secure place for the exchange of silvers.

title: [Stonebiter's Gemporium, Lobby]
description: Footfalls, voices and lanternlight reflect off the polished brass and steel panels of the gemshop's wainscoting, making it a bright and noisy room.  Behind the low, steel-clad counter, Tolruk Stonebiter rests atop a three-legged stool -- jeweller's loupe, black velvet pad and pan balance ready to appraise the next gem or piece of jewelry.

title: [Pets No More]
description: Taking up less than a quarter of the length of the wagon, this small room contains only a short, butcher block counter with Mettys Rundig standing behind it.  A curtained doorway to the left of the counter leads further into the wagon.

title: [Finders-Sellers Pawnshop]
description: Wooden bins are lined up along the canvas partition behind Brenteera Zule's counter.  Silvers paid out come from a small chest resting in her lap, and each item pawned gets tossed into the appropriate bin without her eyes leaving the counter in front of her.

title: [You Bet Your Life Armory]
description: Narrow tables laden with an assortment of armors, all obviously used, run along both sides of the wagon.  Runtahk Schen stands behind the hinged, fold-down counter, smiling pleasantly.  A pair of straw-filled dummies stand to either side of the entrance, one sans armor and quite severely hacked up, the other sporting badly cut and dented armor, but appearing otherwise intact.

title: [Weapons With a History]
description: Sword hilts and weapon hafts sprout from open barrels that line the walls in this small room.  A board laid across two barrels serves as a counter for the transaction of business.  A narrow, curtained doorway to the right of the counter leads further into the wagon.

title: [Imaera's Bounty Herbalist Tent]
description: Hanging bunches of drying herbs force all but the shortest customers to stoop.  Appearing quite at home among the dangling obstacles, Marijon Pestlethwaite hums quietly as she works her way through the tent, checking the bundles, taking some down and hanging others up to dry.

title: ['Tain't Much Magic Tent]
description: The enclosed atmosphere of this small tent is laden with the greasy odor of spiced rolton jerky.  A tangled heap of blankets has been shoved into a back corner, and a pock-faced young Dark Elf slouches on a three-legged stool behind a display case and an open strongbox resting on crates.

title: ['Tain't Much Magic, Consignment]
description: A spiced rolton jerky odor mixed with a mild vanilla scent overwhelms the area.  Along the tent's dusky edges, dim lanterns light the way.

title: ['Tain't Much Magic, Emporium]
description: A strong vanilla scent pervades the air, overwhelming the faint aroma of jerky.  A small, overturned flask lies on the ground, giving a hint as to the origin of some of the smells.

title: [Darbo Phoop's Arcane Outfitters]
description: A scattering of arcane symbols, worked in polished brass, are inlaid in the blue granite floor.  A few of the sigils even gleam from the stair treads and risers that circle upward to the floor above.  Opposite the stairway,  a midnight blue tapestry stitched with gold astrological diagrams forms a backdrop for a glaes-paned display case and a dark maoral counter.  Cracked plaster walls peek between the wall hangings.

title: [Darbo Phoop's, Consignment]
description: The shop's granite floor continues to extend into this area, but has changed from blue to dark grey streaked with white swirls.  From the ceiling, a massive contraption hangs by tightly woven rope, its purpose unclear.

title: [Darbo Phoop's, Used Emporium]
description: Along each wall, hand-carved display cases sit undisturbed.  A large marble table claims the center of the room, offering the most prominent wares.

title: [Zul Logoth Forging Supply Shop]
description: Resembling an hourglass laid on its side, this chamber appears to have been naturally formed, but then embellished and made functional by dwarven design and labor.  The choke-point in the center of the cavern is now almost entirely filled by a steel-topped counter and display case, while beyond it, hammerfalls echo from a dozen or so tunnels that pierce the curved wall of the chamber.  A dwarven attendant stands behind the counter, patiently waiting to provide whatever assistance might be needed.

title: [Zaratek Hall, Alcove]
description: Pale stone walls enclose this alcove on three sides, flecked randomly with glossy mica.  Corkboards and bulletins are occupied by an abundance of scrolls delineating tasks and requested services of the guild.  The lone piece of furniture, a sturdy iron-worked stand, supports a thick leather-bound logbook.

title: [Dagresar's Furs]
description: A lone luminescent toadstool tries vainly to light all the corners in this small stone shop.  The walls, floor and ceiling are covered with furs, hides, and skins from nearly every creature across the lands.  A metal cabinet on the north wall contains teeth, bones, eyes, and other assorted parts, while two large large metal racks hold hides in various states of scraping and tanning.  From behind a low stone counter, the proprietor keeps an eye on his stock and customers.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth]
description: Two heavily heavily barred windows set just above a small marble ledge are the only items of real interest in this barren yet elegant lobby.  The walls, ceiling and floor, though, speak of a wealth of silvers that have enriched the owners of the establishment.  Two dwarves mill about behind the windows, counting coins, writing notes, and conducting the customary bank business.  A gilded sign, affixed to the wall between the two windows, gives information on the use of the bank's services.

title: [Gust's Armory]
description: Adding to the cacophony and overall state of disarray in this cluttered little cave is the noise of the nearby forge.  Several tallow candles placed on mismatched sconces along the walls do little to penetrate the soot and smoke lingering heavily inside the shop.  Shields and armor of all sizes and shapes hang from hooks carved from the rough stone walls.

title: [Praeteria's Gems and Jewels]
description: A stocky, middle-aged dwarf works behind a long, low counter, sorting gems and purchasing jewels from miners.  A long, wide shelf behind her contains several boxes with various titles.  She purchases the gems, then sorts them into the boxes.  When a box becomes too full, she empties it onto a tray and shoves the tray through an opening in the back wall.  The only other furnishings in this sparse shop are some crates stacked against the south wall and two amber toadstools in stone pots.

title: [Hortemeyer's Pre-Owned Goods]
description: The metal shelves of this shop are crammed full of assorted knick knacks, weapons, armor, containers, and many types of unrecognizable items.  The shelves run from floor to ceiling on all four walls except where they are forced to allow customers to enter.  Several ladders lean against the shelves to facilitate retrieval of items from the upper levels.  Larger items occupy places on the floor.  In the midst of it all, an old dwarf totters around, using a cane for support as he straightens the displays.

title: [Brutarius Kodel Weaponry]
description: Three displays dominate this small shop.  A tall oak cabinet with a glass front rests against the north wall, while an oak display case occupies much of the west wall's area next to the door.  A narrow marble table nestles between the two displays.  The proprietor keeps a sharp eye on the customers from behind a U-shaped granite counter, and a curtain on the east wall apparently allows egress to another room.  The counter's shape completely blocks patrons from using this curtain.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Entry]
description: The heavy scent of pine tar mixes with the odor of ale and cooked delicacies. The sounds of revelry and the clink of mugs appear to come from beyond the stone arch.  Dwarves in assorted garb enter and go east or through the arch, though those dressed in rougher attire seem to prefer the arch.  The patrons entering also seem to be much less inebriated than those exiting.  The patrons tread over an expansive oval rug, and silhouettes of larger-than-life musical instruments hang on the walls.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Front Desk]
description: A low stone counter wraps around a small private space, providing a place for the innkeeper to do business separate from the customer area.  The counter is bare except for a ledger, a sign and a shiny brass bell.  Several tapestries depicting various famous dwarven bards hang from the austere timber-and-stone walls.  A dimly lit hallway leads off to the east.

title: [J.M. and Descendants, Werstel]
description: A long counter extends from the north wall nearly to the south wall, splitting the room neatly in half.  Two large stone pots, one on either side of the counter, house luminescent toadstools, their glowing caps providing ample light by which to conduct trade.  Behind the counter a smiling dwarf goes about the business of opening boxes, creating lockpicks, and cheerfully helping customers.  A metal work table abuts the west wall, behind the counter, and a sign resides on the counter.

title: [Zul Logoth General Store]
description: All the varied dry goods that a dwarf would need for day-to-day living seem to be on display in this store.  The displays may seem more packed, however, because the store itself is so very small.  A sales desk sits near the south wall and provides a place where the proprietor can transact business.  Pushed into a corner, one tall toadstool in a lone stone pot does its best to light the area.  The only means of exit is through a crude stone arch.

title: [Rockslinger Relocation Services]
description: Several crates stand in one corner, all marked with the same destination.  The rest of the room is austere.  Only a stone desk and straight-backed chair break up the monotony of a grey granite floor, grey granite walls, and grey granite ceiling.  Two huge luminescent toadstools in large stone pots, each occupying opposite corners, appear sufficient to light the room.  A steel door allows exit to the corridors of Zul Logoth, a dark hallway extends to the west, and a wide corridor extends south.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although quite a bit of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on either side are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east, although a faint bit of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on the north and south sides are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Brother Barnstel's Herbals]
description: The tops of large large wooden casks line the back wall, the bodies of the casks imbedded in the wall and the bulk of the containers perhaps sticking out in some room behind.  Only the tops are visible here.  Smaller containers sit neatly stacked on the floor in front of the barrel-lined wall, and the odor of cooking herbs pervades the small shop.  A long stone counter traverses the shop from wall to wall, separating the medicinal area from the customer area.

title: [Granite Building, Foyer]
description: Inlaid into the smooth stone floor is a giant ring rendered in intertwined gold and brass.  A lacquered rosewood desk sits before the back wall, along with a comfortable high-backed chair.  Heavy, grey velvet curtains have been draped across a pair of arches for a touch of privacy.

title: [The Waggler's Warehouse]
description: Reflective tiles of polished steel have been deeply imbedded into the natural walls in a repeating pattern of diamonds.  A navy blue wool curtain drapes across a small passageway leading into the shop's storage area, though access to it is restricted by an expansive granite counter.  Prominently displayed on a series of wrought iron tables and racks are magical devices and tools of differing origin, each merely a small example of the wares for sale.

title: [The Waggler's, Consignment]
description: Mirrors line the walls of this shop from east to west, multiplying the tiniest amount of light to create a well-lit area.  Many objects are stockpiled, offering a cluttered appearance.

title: [The Waggler's, Used Emporium]
description: The back of shop empties out into a desolate nook, a stark contrast to the front.  A simple stone table guards the corner, undisturbed, as a metallic scent hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Furrier]
description: The pungent scent of curing chemicals assails your nostrils.  The walls are covered with hides from many sorts of animals, some very recognizable, some totally foreign.  Bear hide rugs cover the floor underfoot from wall to wall, the protruding heads with open mouths creating trip hazards in several places.  An unusually lean dwarf moves around toward the back of the room, sorting furs, hides and pelts into piles and muttering to himself.

title: [Gem Shop]
description: The inside of the shop is warm and cheery, with sunlight streaming in through the windows and a fire in a small, black brazier providing just the right amount of heat.  The floor is heavily lacquered with a dark varnish, and the walls sparkle with cheap, multicolored gems.  An elderly dwarf sits behind a narrow worktable.  He selects gems from a stack next to the vise, clamps them in, meticulously cuts them and moves them off to a small box.  Every so often he glances up and greets a customer.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: Only the sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.  Identical brass flowerpots stand opposite each other filled to the brim with trumpet-shaped purple blossoms of mournblooms.  Every so often, melancholy sounds, like the sad song of a lone woman, emanates from somewhere nearby.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: Etched brass flowerpots stand opposite each other overflowing with purple and yellow pansies.  Littering the ground beneath one of the pots are a few of the curled and discolored velvety petals.  The sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: A gilded mirror hangs above an ebonwood table, its only burden is a faceted crystal vase that overflows with an arrangement of pink and yellow roses interspersed with baby's breath.  The sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.  Wooden shutters carved in lacy patterns at the end of the corridor allow a minute trace of sunlight into the hallway.

title: [Morvaeyn's Armory]
description: Despite the banner reading, "Morvaeyn's Armory" on the far wall, there is no actual armor on display in this shop.  Instead, the chiseled stone-block walls feature a panoramic showcase of the wares, rendered in vivid paints.  Hanging above each painting, a large sign boasts the benefits and values of the individual armament.

title: [Maeve's Furs]
description: Exemplary displays of taxidermy decorate this spacious shop, though several of the arrangements are disturbing at best.  Posed as if ready to attack, stuffed white rabbits dangle upon wires over the grizzly prone body of a black forest ogre.  A glass counter has been filled to the brim with the preserved forms of dead badgers, and the countertop has been topped off a with a shiny golden bell.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Front Desk]
description: A bored-looking clerk sits behind a scarred wooden desk, occasionally handing out keys to patrons, who accept their keys from him with expressions varying from blank stares to annoyed grimaces.  Although this establishment is fairly shady, many of the customers look even shadier.

title: [Sylvarraend Pawn and Thrift]
description: Baskets and trunks full of arcane items are stacked high against the walls of this tiny cottage.  However full it may be, there does appear to be order to the madness, as the shop proprietor scurries about adding pawned goods to various tables and marking them for sale.

title: [The United Bank of City-States]
description: Flickering golden yellow light from dozens of bronze sconces that hang high up on the walls illuminates this chamber.  On the far right wall hangs a lovely brocade tapestry which depicts scenes from the town's early days.  A threadbare rug covers the entire floor, muffling the steps of the townsfolk.  A perky young elven clerk sits patiently waiting to assist someone.

title: [Sylvarraend Tinkers & Whatnots]
description: Scattered across the polished wooden floors, deep red rugs bring cheer to this rather austere room.  Boxes and trunks are stacked along one wall, each fastened with a small shiny lock.  In one corner, banked orange coals glow dimly in a small brazier.

title: [Sylvarraend Bowyer Supplies]
description: The wooden walls have been sanded smooth, but left unvarnished, creating a rustic look.  Bows of various types, some appearing to be nearly antiques, hang from the walls.  The flames flickering in the small fireplace cast a yellow-orange glow across the smooth maple planked flooring.

title: [Sylvarraend, Furrier]
description: Displayed over the doorway of small cottage is a stuffed stag's head, complete with a magnificent set of ten-tined antlers.  Cleaned furs and pelts line the wooden walls, trophies of many an adventurer's victorious hunt.  A tidy rack filled with sharp tools is set on the wall behind a wide counter.

title: [Shimmarglin Jewels and Gems]
description: The leaded glaesine windows are paned in a delicate floral pattern, detailing intertwining roses and ivy.  The windows are framed of the same garnet-hued curtains that decorate the front portion of the shop.  A thick sapphire-hued carpet covers the floor.  A series of shelves lines one wall, providing ample storage for the gem dealer's supplies.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Hallway]
description: A runner of thick, red woolen carpet follows the hallway north and south.  The runner covers the center of the red marble floor, providing a stable, soft, quiet area on which to walk.  Along the hallway, heavy golden curtains allow entrance to private booths where one can access a personal locker.  Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walnut walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Hallway]
description: A runner of thick, red woolen carpet follows the hallway to the north.  The runner covers the center of the red marble floor, providing a stable, soft, quiet area on which to walk.  Along the hallway, heavy golden velvet curtains allow entrance to private booths where one can access a personal locker.  Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walnut walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

title: [United Bank of City-States]
description: Thick aubergine carpeting and heavy dark green velvet drapes help to muffle sound inside the bank, but the faint *clink* of coins can still be heard filtering from behind the bank's teller, who sits patiently waiting to help the next patron.  A small but elegant wrought iron chandelier hangs from the ceiling above, its amber glaesine globes casting a warm hue across the room.

title: [Areacne's Gems of Ta'Vaalor]
[Ta'Vaalor, Areacne's Gemshop]
description: Exquisite antique-white dupioni silk curtains, trimmed in fine lace covers the bay window.  A beautifully arranged bouquet of wild roses in a transparent quartz vase rests in the center of the speckled marble-topped counter, which is trimmed in black willow.  Overhead, the delicate prisms of the crystal chandelier emit soft chimes, as a slight breeze makes it gently sway back and forth.  The thick, plush forest-green wall-to-wall carpet muffles the steps of the patrons of this elegant shop.

Various cut and uncut gemstones wink from where they sit on pale, stained oak shelves that line the sides of the room.  The gemsmith, Areacne, swiftly strides about the area, buying the occasional gem or stone for the store's collection or answering the questions of curious customers gazing over her merchandise.

title: [Ghaerdish's Furs and Pelts]
[Ghaerdish's Tannery]
description: Set on bronze plated frames and arranged in a triangular pattern over the Eastern wall are the mounted heads of four beasts.  The glass eyes of the magnificent specimens appear to track the movements of those within the quaint shop.  Lying on the floor directly in front of the counter are the hides of two arctic bears, sewn together by their back paws.  Hidden underneath a leather canvas in one corner of the room is a neat stack of cured animal hides.

A small part of the warehouse has been enclosed to form a shop where hunters may sell their scavenged skins and pelts to the furrier.  Several large windows allow a glimpse into the major operation of the business -- the tannery that provides cured leather and hides to outfit the armed forces of the fortress of Ta'Vaalor.  Although the smells are subdued in this room, there is still a stench that cannot be ignored emanating from the giant vats in the rear of the warehouse.

title: [Adventurers' Guild, Hiring Hall]
description: This long gathering hall is lined with rough wooden benches and a few posting boards with odd scraps of parchment tacked on them.  A few anxious-looking young men hover about the edges of the room, their nervous pacing a sharp contrast to the resigned attitude of some older folks resting on the benches.  At the far end of the hall, a sturdy maoral table serves as a desk, its contents meticulously arranged.

title: [Vonder's Archery Supply]
description: A newly polished mahogany counter spans the length of the room, completely dividing the room in half.  Several unfinished bows hang from a rack situated behind the counter, along with several displays holding various types of archery supplies.

title: [Elantaran's Magic Supply]
[Ta'Vaalor, Magical Supply]
description: An eclectic mix of glassware fills a pair of long tables.  Beakers, tubes and dishes make up most of the glassware.  Each table is supported by four legs carved to resemble rampant dragons.  A stunningly carved rolltop desk made from beautiful mahogany rests in one corner.  Quills, scrolls and one overly large bottle of black ink reside on the desktop.  A beautifully crafted scroll case towers over the desk, its many slots for scrolls mostly occupied now by a number of tomes.

title: [Elantaran's Magic, Consignment]
description: Filled with many miscellaneous, alchemic products, storage bins are neatly organized throughout the room.  An orb-chased candle chandelier hangs from above, offering a source of illumination.  Two shop attendants wander about, taking inventory and keeping a watchful eye.

title: [Elantaran's Magic, Used Goods]
description: A hand-carved yew table is centered among the walls enclosing the area.   Light floods in from the chandelier to the south, offering a conglomeration of dancing shadows and light.

title: [The Ta'Vaalor Weaponry]
description: The aromatic scent of oil and leather fills the air.  Trimmed with faenor metal, a well-crafted solid oak counter dominates the length of this shop.  Skillfully wrought and forged from rare, exotic material and hanging from metal supports in the walls is an assemblage of various weapons of war.  They have been artfully arranged in geometric patterns.  A black-inked sign is directly above an executioner's axe, which is leaning in the corner behind the counter.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Antique Goods]
[Ta'Vaalor, Secondhand Wares]
description: Beautiful gold sconces adorn both sides of the doorway in this quaint little shop.  A frosted glass cabinet, resting in the center of the royal-blue carpeting, holds an assortment of beautiful glass figurines.  An elegant emerald-green tapestry with gold stitching covers the wall above the fireplace.  Emptied of its cargo, a fair-sized gold chest lies on its side.  Its contents have been strewn haphazardly on the floor behind the counter.

An overwhelming stench of smoke fills the shop.  The remains of a a frosted-glass cabinet stand in the center of the room, the contents broken into piles of colorful glass dust.  The pawnbroker stands behind a makeshift counter of two crates and a scorched length of floor planking, trying desperately to pretend that everything is perfectly normal.

The stone walls are clean, but bare, and a simple woven wool carpet covers the wooden floor planks.  The pawnbroker stands behind a long counter, rows of tall shelves stretching behind him laden with a broad assortment of weapons, armor, potions, and trinkets, each meticulously labeled and catalogued.  A small trashcan stands against a side wall.

title: [Malwith Inn, Front Desk]
description: A large desk surrounds a small office area.  Books, scrolls and other odds and ends litter a table behind the desk.  A grand staircase leads up to the second floor, its railings ending in stylized dragon claws.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Forging Supply Shop]
description: Located snugly behind the armory, the area is secluded enough to cause minimal disturbance.  A set of wooden stairs leads up to a raised platform, adorned with decorative banners and display cases.  A brilliant cloth banner hangs from the counter, bearing the crest of Vaalor.  A stone walkway leads back around to the thoroughfare.

title: [Saphrie's Herbs and Tinctures]
[Ta'Vaalor, Triage Station]
description: Soft aquamarine curtains frame the glaesine-paned windows of the herb shop.  Whitewashed haon shelves line the walls, each shelf carefully stocked with a variety of glaes bottles.  A long monir counter, well worn and apparently used as a worktable, rests in the center of the shop.

Whitewashed haon shelves line the walls of this room, each shelf carefully stocked with a variety of glaes bottles, bandages, herbs, and other healing supplies.  Elven nurses flow around and behind a long monir counter, well-worn and apparently used as a worktable, that rests in the center of the room.  An open doorway to the west leads to the infirmary, and a black-inked sign rests upon the far wall.

title: [Saphrie's Herbs and Tinctures]
[Ta'Vaalor, Triage Station]
description: Sturdy wooden cots line the walls of this narrow room, each covered with pristine white linens.  High shelves loaded with herbs and bandages are mounted on the whitewashed walls above the cots.  A gentle breeze, redolent with the fragrance of acantha and blaeston, stirs the gauzy curtains framing the open windows.

Elven nurses bustle quietly about the room, tending to the ill and injured that lie on the sturdy wooden cots that line the walls of this narrow room.  The faintly herbal scents of acantha and blaeston linger in the air, and high shelves loaded with herbs and bandages are mounted on the whitewashed walls.

title: [Locksmith]
[Ta'Vaalor, Locksmith]
description: The wooden walls are bare except for unfinished shelves adorned with locks and lockpicks.  A frayed red carpet covers the center of the room, leaving the bare wooden slats exposed around the border of the floor.  The walls and floor of the building creak and groan as patrons move about the store.

The wall behind the counter is lined with an extensive array of meticulously labeled cubbyholes, each organized to hold specific types of locks, lock components, and lockpicks.  The locksmith, Shind, works behind counter, his spectacles perched on the tip of his nose.  To the left of the counter, a small sign has been tacked to the wall, under which is a stained oak barrel that serves as a trash bin.

title: [Glimaerseen Moving Company]
description: Pale haon walls set with brightly-trimmed windows make for a light and airy waiting room.  Neatly arranged next to one of the large openings is a sitting area with a view of the street.  Fresh gardenias gently float in a round glaes bowl sitting on a low counter, adding their sweet fragrance to the room.  Towards the back sits a desk with two wire baskets that overflow with paperwork, the only contrast to the otherwise tidy office.

title: [River's Rest, Dilapidated Pier]
description: Not as worn as it first appears to be, this pier is actually a sturdy and pleasant platform.  From this vantage, the river is clearly visible to the north, the comings and goings at the drawbridge seen but not heard.  Visible in the deep waters are the reflections of thousands of stars from the evening sky, occasionally obscured by a passing cloud.  Rustling reeds and the sudden splash of a fish leaping from the water do little to disturb the peace.

title: [River's Rest, Town Gardens]
description: Against the backdrop of a forest to the south, this garden is open to a starlit sky.  In unruly disorder, flowers and herbs of all descriptions are scattered in several beds throughout the gardens.  To the north, a large meadow spreads out as far as you can see.  Off to one side, a wizened old elf is busily uprooting weeds from one particularly overgrown bed.  Whistling a merry tune, he occasionally breaks into a sweet song as he works, smiling at all who enter his domain.

Whistling a merry tune, he occasionally breaks into a sweet song as he works, smiling at all who enter his domain.

title: [River's Rest Bank, Teller]
description: Unlike the other buildings in this town, this one is built of stone blocks, and decorated with wood beams.  When you realize that it is protecting the wealth of all who do business here, you can understand why.  Heavily armed guards watch over the lobby although you notice one flirting with a pretty elven teller who is currently between customers.  The window she is standing at is protected by heavy metal bars and appears to be very secure.

title: [General Store]
description: Although small, this shop appears to be the depository for just about anything anyone could possibly want.  Precariously loaded shelves fill the room and customers avidly browse the inventory.  Standing at a roomy counter, keeping an eagle eye on the scene, is an elderly shopkeeper.  A fat grey cat graces the counter with his presence and looks up, annoyed, as a customer places a package too close to his tail, but he is soon catnapping once again in a patch of moonlight.

title: [Felinium's Fur Emporium]
description: The walls of this small shop appear to be covered with the furs and skins of all types of creatures.  Closer inspection reveals that many are still being prepared for use, although an occasional impeccably finished specimen is found.  Hunt souvenirs rest on a set of shelves tucked in one corner, where a cluster of roughly clad traders have gathered to examine them closely.

title: [Diamante's Gemshop]
description: With a smile that sparkles as does her wares, Diamante dusts a sturdy display case, inspecting the assorted gems within as she does.  Her shop is neat and tidy, with comfortable chairs and tables scattered about for her customers to enjoy as they examine particularly interesting items - such as the rings a young couple examine in one corner.  A small bell sounds as the shop door opens, bringing yet another group into this cheerfully warm establishment.

title: [Galena's Lockworks]
description: A wooden counter divides this small workshop.  The flickering flames of a brazier reflect off the two tall, glazed windows, bathing the room in yellowish light.  An impressive array of antique locks and keys can be seen in a display case.  Behind the counter, leaning against a tall oak filing cabinet, is the smiling but watchful owner, the widow Galena.  A sign hangs above the counter.
