An impressive array of antique locks and keys can be seen in a display case.  Behind the counter, leaning against a tall oak filing cabinet, is the smiling but watchful owner, the widow Galena.  A sign hangs above the counter.

title: [Relynard's Pawnshop]
description: A bit brighter than it appears from the alley outside, this small shop is piled haphazardly with all manner of goods.  A pile of armor in one corner is complimented by a row of neatly arranged weapons in another corner.  Shelves full of other assorted items tower along the walls and seem ready to fall at the slightest touch.  Relynard is resting at his counter, apparently asleep.  However, you somehow know he is not and you resolve to watch your step.

title: [Timor's Storage, Hallway]
description: You are in a dimly lit hallway.  The torches on the walls flicker and fade casting all manner of shadows about the hallway.

title: [Timor's Storage, Shipping]
description: Overcrowded and piled with stacks of papers, some stamped RUSH in big red letters, the stuffy and small office looks tidy for all the chaos that it contains.  An occassional draft rustles the top layers of each stack, threatening to scatter papers everywhere.

title: [Hornswoggler's Tent]
description: There is a strong funk of recently disturbed dust and pungent smoke in the still air of the small tent.  A small, smoky oil lamp provides a dim yellowish light.  In the back of the tent a remarkably homely giantman snoozes while leaning against a pair of sturdy-looking strongboxes.  The hornswoggler sits cross-legged on a bamboo mat, smoking tobacco from a hookah.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Lobby]
description: Spacious and airy, the lobby of this small island inn welcomes the weary traveler.  Tucked away in the far corner of the room, a simple wooden staircase spirals up, out of sight, to the second floor.  Casual groups of comfortably worn sofas and chairs are scattered about.  At the base of the staircase, a jovial innkeeper stands behind a massive counter, passing out keys and keeping an eye on the lobby.  Occasional bursts of laughter filter in from the archway to the north.

title: [Relegan's Fletcher Shop]
description: Small intertwined branches make up the walls of this small workshop.  Carved from the stump of a haon tree, a counter sits in the middle of the room, partially covered in woodshavings and cut feathers.  Lining the walls are shelves which hold bows and crossbows, a dark curtain situated between two of them.

title: [Mislin Hall, Clerk's Office]
description: Dark maoral paneling and sparse furnishings -- only a desk and bookcase -- make for an austere and purely functional office.  Two shallow wooden boxes sit atop the desk, each filled with neatly penned documents, while parchment scrolls and thick ledgers fill the bookcase and lend a musty bite to the air.

title: [Lomara's Supernatural Supplies]
description: The interior of the small bungalow is awash in peculiar smells...sour stinks, sweet aromas, sharp odors, oily scents, metallic effluvia, fetid reeks.  Shelves of potions in odd-shaped jars and phials line one wall.  The doors of a large cabinet are ajar, providing a tantalizing glimpse of elixirs, nostrums, amulets and periapts.

title: [Lomara's, Consignment]
description: The bungalow extends into a smaller area which houses a large maoral counter.  The wooden floor to the front of it remains clean and clear, while the area behind the counter is stacked with a number of storage bins varying in size and color.

title: [River's Rest Forging Supply]
description: Tucked behind a massive hedge, the area is surrounded with dense foliage.  A small raised platform rests in the center, stocked with shelves of oils, metal, and glyphs.  Pillars of smoke rise from behind the platform, accompanied by ringing hammer-falls.

title: [Locks and More, Workshop]
description: The ceiling slants downward from a peak overhead, mimicking the shape of the roof above.  Hooks have been placed on the lower part of the ceiling towards one side of the room, various tools used in the art of locksmithing and repairing lockpicks hanging from them.  Beneath them is a worn oak table that looks as though it might once have been a fine piece.  Windows up near the peak of the ceiling on either side of the room provide the only light, the lamps overhead unlit.

Moonlight filters through the windows up near the peak of the ceiling, the lamps overhead lit to provide more light.

title: [Grundael's Furs]
description: Various furs, claws, and other bits and pieces of creatures are hung or mounted on the walls of this shop, displaying the skills of many adventurers.  A chandelier composed of antlers hangs overhead, the long candles in it currently unlit.  Open windows rest between the spoils displayed on the walls, allowing light to flood the room.  A long counter lines the back of the shop, an open doorway visible behind it.  Upon the counter rests a leatherbound ledger.

A long counter lines the back of the shop, an open doorway visible behind it.  Upon the counter rests a leatherbound ledger.

title: [Healer's House]
description: Filmy blue chiffon curtains blow gently in the breeze from the open windows, while a small calico cat snoozes beneath them in a patch of light on the floor.  Drying herbs hang from hooks upon the wall, waiting to be used in various medicines.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

A large quantity of lamps hanging overhead keep the room well lit.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

title: [Cendadric's Collectibles]
description: A large, fancy rosewood desk sits in the middle of this room, a cushioned velvet-covered chair placed precisely behind it.  On the wall behind the desk is a large portrait of an elven woman, the colors bright despite its evident age.  A large silver chandelier hangs overhead, its myriad of candles snuffed for the day, while a carved rosewood arch leads farther into the shop.

A large silver chandelier hangs overhead, its myriad of candles lighting the room, while a carved rosewood arch leads farther into the shop.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, General Exchange]
[Phisk's Sundry Wares]
description: The broad room is well-lit and meticulously clean.  Row upon row of shelves displaying a multitude of goods fill the back part of the room, and a polished oak counter stands near the door, upon which sits a sturdy scale, a black-inked sign, and a mist-filled silver bowl.  Brass lanterns are mounted on the walls, casting a warm glow over the wood-paneled walls and floor and driving the shadows out from between the shelves.

Dry, slightly stagnant air fills this broad structure, its arid scent tinged with odors of resin and wood polish.  Well-organized shelves have been affixed to the birch-paneled walls, their heavily varnished surfaces holding the various goods for sale in this establishment.  Decorative brass lanterns illuminate the room, their unwavering glow shedding an amber light across the wooden floor and rows of shelving.

title: [The Ta'Vaalor Armory]
description: Standing in the center of the highly polished checkered-marble floors, is a life-sized crystal replica of an antique forge.  This masterfully created structure serves as the counter in this distinguished armory.  An impressive display of well-maintained ancient suits of armor, encased in rectangular shaped frosted-glass cabinets, stands in the far corner.  Various scenes from days of yore are depicted on a black-velvet tapestry with raised silver stitching, which covers the back wall of the shop.

title: [The Mother Lode, Lobby]
description: Cheerful arrangements of flowers brighten up the corners of this rustic Inn.  A small red couch faces the front desk, providing a spot for weary travellers to rest before seeing their room.

title: [Thistleberry's Hut]
description: An odd combination of pungent and acrid smells lingers thickly in the cramped confines of the hut.  Occasional sharp twinges sting your nose and send ripples down your spine.  Spherical glass pots hang from the ceiling between bunches of drying grass.  Viny tendrils spill over the rafters, moving gracefully with slight air currents drifting in and out of the open doorway.  Lines of shelves stretch wall-to-wall behind a wooden counter, displaying scads of vari-colored jars along their lengths.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Lobby]
description: Thick and windowless marble walls enclose this rather spacious lobby, which is liberally decorated with the mounted heads of both exotic and mundane beasts.  The floor is covered with fine bearskin rugs and various specimens of antique dwarven stone furniture.  Overhead, a massive candle-lit chandelier adequately illuminates the area and provides for the impressive shadows cast by the various stuffed beasts arrayed about the room.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: Precariously balanced crates and boxes line the walls of the office, marked with jagged dwarven scrawls.  Groups of dwarves wander in and out, slapping each other on the back and laughing as they drag more boxes in and out.  A mangy grey cat lies curled up in a corner, lazily peering at you with a mildly curious expression.

title: [Lobby]
description: This square room seems to have been carved out of solid rock, as evidenced by the smooth, hard walls.  A simple, deep brown rug covers the center of the floor.  A mural has been painted on one wall, covering it from floor to ceiling with a detailed image of the Eye of V'Tull.  Two granite benches sit against the adjacent walls, and a refreshment cart stands in the corner.  A sign hangs over a carved stone stairway, and a rounded arch is carved in the fourth wall, nearly hidden by deep blue curtains.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Clerk's Office]
description: Bare of any papers, a plain oak desk is positioned diagonal to an unadorned high-backed chair behind it.  Other chairs line the northern and eastern wall nearest the desk where long bulletin boards are lined with neat rows of tasks to be completed.  A large armoire and armor stand are set side by side upon the western wall beneath a worn coat-of-arms banner.

title: [Dargeur's Armors]
description: Leather and metal armor of all shapes and sizes covers the walls of this establishment.  Oil lamps hang from the ceiling, dangling on rusted chains.  A brawny half-elf leans upon the wooden counter, eyeing the customers from half-closed eyes.

title: [Solhaven Arms]
description: Polished wooden cases line the room, containing a wide assortment of weapons.  Echoing through the shop is the sound of a hammer striking metal.  A stocky Dwarf stands nearby, smiling to herself.

title: [Galnuir's Archery]
description: Finely crafted bows of all shapes and sizes hang upon the walls of this sparsely furnished shop.  A simple wooden counter stands in one corner, with a rack behind.  A small table and chair sit in front of the fireplace.

title: [Company Store, Dry Goods]
description: A light dusting of flour covers the floor where a bag has burst from being knocked off of a shelf.  A slight lad busily cleans up the mess, sweeping the white powder into a dustpan and from there into a trash bin.  A young mother, making one heck of a ruckus, is angrily chastizing a tearful child while she searches for the silvers required to pay for the wasted victual.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Alearyl Hall]
description: High, corbeled arches give way to elaborately frescoed ceiling partitions, each glorified in hues of majestic purple, grey, and blue.  The floor is highly polished, matching the blue-grey granite common among other Ta'Illistim architecture.  A massive, maoral desk consumes a great portion of the room's far end and beyond it stands an iron-bound door along the southwest wall.  Two guards carefully watch those who pass through the hall.

title: [Ta'Illistim Alchemy Consignment]
description: Drifting warmth from the west invades the bearskin rug-covered floor of this homely room.  The stone walls are of a slate grey and offer a cold appearance.

title: [Ta'Illistim Alchemy Emporium]
description: Enclosed within the back recesses of the shop, a silk-covered table stands against a wall.  A brightly burning torch positioned above the table clearly displays its goods.

title: [Ragnoz Bumbledown's Furrier]
description: Bundles of furs and skins are piled haphazardly to the ceiling.  Bones of all sizes and shapes are stacked upon large shelves along one wall.  A long counter sits at the rear of the shop.

title: [Sorena's Emporium, Consignment]
description: Caught in perpetual twilight, the narrow passageway carved from rock and dirt is roofed over with thick, tangled roots.  Twining among the roots is an equally tangled series of interconnected glass tubes, each carrying liquids of varying hue and density.  A slate slab is balanced, somewhat precariously, atop several empty, stained casks that line the eastern wall.

title: [Sorena's Emporium, Used Goods]
description: The burrow's passage ends with an unmasked, earthen wall.  Root tendrils hang down from the ceiling, like forgotten streamers left in the wake of a party.  At the center of the rounded chamber, a stark white table stands, its pure white cover a clear contrast to the carved dirt walls.

title: [Company Store, Public Storage]
description: The noises of the busy store are somewhat muted.  This room provides access to the company's storage facility, where lockers may be rented for personal use.  Padded benches line the walls for the ease and comfort of customers awaiting their turn.  A large opening in the wall provides access to the company lockers.  A heavy curtain that has been hung across the opening provides any needed security.

title: [Company Store, Public Storage]
description: Quieter than the rooms to the west, this room provides access to the company's storage facility, where lockers may be rented for personal use.  Padded benches line the walls for the ease and comfort of customers awaiting their turn.  A large opening in the wall provides access to the company lockers.  A heavy curtain that has been hung across the opening provides any needed security.

title: [Thistleberry's Hut, Consignment]
description: Unrecognizable aromas hang in the air, although fainter than in the front of the shop.  A scuffed manifest lies attached to a short counter by a tarnished metal ring.  Cupboards line the back wall, their doors marred by dents and random scorch marks.

title: [Thistleberry's Hut, Repository]
description: Three torches hang upon the back wall, illuminating a cluttered storage table directly beneath.  Items are stacked upon it with no real degree of neatness or organization, allowing and demanding patrons to rummage for themselves.

title: [Sylvarraend Herbals]
description: Moonlight glimmers through the glaesine windows, each framed with a swath of pale yellow gauze.  The monir planked flooring is polished to a dull sheen.  Lining the walls are shelves holding bottles and flasks of all sizes, each carefully labeled with a small tag denoting its contents.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although a slight amount of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on either side are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Priestly Purchases]
description: An elaborate stained glass window has been set high into the ceiling here, depicting a large golden crown upon a field of white.  The daylight streaming in cloaks the chamber in a pleasantly bright amber glow, illuminating the small glaes-paneled case set below the masterful work of art and several chests lined up in a symmetrical pattern with the rest of the room.  A tattered robe hangs behind the wall nearest the case, its handsome design barely visible amid the rips and stains upon it.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Niche]
description: Smooth pale stone walls create an oval space just large enough to accommodate a few patrons at a time.  Other than the subtle sheen of polished stone, there are neither embellishments nor furnishings to distract the eye from a sigil-carved round window, which catches the eye immediately upon entering.

title: [Valina's Herbs and Tinctures]
description: Sunlight streams in through a clear glaes skylight, bathing the room in a warm and comforting glow.  Cots covered with starched white sheets are lined up in neat rows along one wall.  Alongside each cot, a small table holds bottles and jars of various potions and tinctures.

Moonlight streams in through a clear glaes skylight, bathing the room in a cool silvery glow.  Glaesine lamps provide dim illumination by which the healers work their art.  Cots covered with starched white sheets are lined up in neat rows along one wall.  Alongside each cot, a small table holds bottles and jars of various potions and tinctures.

title: [Vornavis Exchange, Solhaven]
description: This wood panelled room is as elegant as the bank lobby, and carpeted in the same plush burgundy.  Travelling merchants are busily exchanging their foreign currency.  A clerk is seated behind a nearby desk, waiting patiently to assist the next customer in line.

title: [Nexus]
description: Arches of different colors branch off at eight points of the compass.  The slate floor is bare but for a sleek black marble counter in front of three prosperous-looking gnomes dressed in checkered fustian livery.  Above all hangs a bright crystal chandelier.

title: [Sylvarrglin Moving Company]
description: Unfurnished save one polished maoral desk placed in the center of the floor, the moving company's sparse offices speak of quiet efficiency.  A clerk sits on a chair behind the desk, peering down her spectacled nose at all who enter.

title: [The Lost Home, Foyer]
description: Tall columns of dark marble rise above you, supporting the high, vaulted ceiling.  The black-tiled floor is covered with a large, thick forest-green carpet.  On the far side of the foyer a fire is roaring in a massive basalt fireplace, sending waves of welcome heat into the room.  Several comfortable looking chairs are pulled to the side of the fireplace, close enough to enjoy the fire without getting too warm.

title: [Ta'Illistim Forging Supply Shop]
description: A wide haon counter bisects this portico.  Standing near the gap in the length of the counter, a tall elf with weathered features and broad shoulders looks ready to assist those wishing to purchase items from the inventory displayed beneath the counter's glaes top, or to collect silvers from aspiring weaponsmiths wishing to use one of the numerous workshops joined to the portico by paved walkways.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Foyer]
description: Situated at an angle to either side of a polished oak door that leads to the street is a set of low tables covered with vials of dyes.  A long glass front cabinet stands in the center of this quaint foyer and is flanked by arches, on the left and right, which lead further into the shop.  Behind the cabinet, a long hallway terminates in a set of oak steps and is illuminated by evenly spaced wall sconces.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Main Room]
description: Smoothly polished oak walls reflect soft light from the high ceiling's chandelier.  A long table stretches across the front wall.  Several barrels sit at the end of the table, opposite of the door.  A series of oak pedestals stands in the center of the room, highlighting several pieces of merchandise.

title: [Furrier]
description: Rough-hewn fel walls rise to an unfinished vaulted ceiling giving this small room an airy feeling.  Hooks of wrought-iron hang from a sturdy fel beam that acts as the main support for the ceiling above.  Fine furs hang from the hooks, while bundles of various hides are stacked around the perimeter of the room.  A large stuffed bear greets visitors by the front door.

title: [Itarille Seregon, Front Room]
description: Silvery hoarbeam rafters support an intricate reed fan system over the center of the room, its wide blades turning slowly to circulate air.  Armor stands arranged throughout the small shop are set to face either each other, the counters, or the shelves, which display leather wares and fashions.  Glaesine windows framed in dark thanot stand open to the sunlight, which glints off of the vaalin latches and hinges set into the dark wood.

title: [Ravelin Bank, Teller]
description: Sturdy, black granite forms the back wall housing the bank's vault, which has a brown-clad elven guard standing next to it.  A long oak counter with two tellers at their windows sits before the vault.  A dozen glaes globes hang from the ceiling, illuminating the entire room with green-hued light.

title: [Natulcien's Healer Hall, Shop]
description: Stretched between ancient modwir trees, the ceiling is fashioned of a sturdy canvas and silk blend.  Permanent eastern and western walls support shelves and drying racks that house herbs, tinctures, and poultices alike, while a linden platform lifts the floor off the ground and is covered with lush rugs.  A set of steps leads down into a garden towards another canvas covered platform.

title: [Natulcien's Pavilion]
description: Moss green and bright white walls flutter gently in the river-borne breeze that flows freely through the raised platform room.  Comfortable cots, set with light blankets and soft silk pillows, line the structure's two permanent walls, while a third is set at the back near a canvas wall bound to faenor anchors.  Rafters stretch between the walls and dangle dozens of frosted globes over the entire room providing it with constant illumination, while a tightly woven canvas and silk canopy stretches above it.

title: [Jidrael's General Shop, Commons]
description: Frosted globes dangling from vaalin chains set into the ceiling sway slightly in the cool river breeze that passes through the small shop from the long open windows set into each of the room's three walls.  Decorative and functional wicker chairs offer perches for waiting customers and are arranged in casual patterns amongst the trunks and counters displaying the shop's wares.

title: [Kreldor's Locksmithy, Workroom]
description: Candle fixtures wrought of faenor hang from the high fel beamed ceiling illuminating a long birchwood counter.  Placed against the back wall is a worktable scattered with various tools, vials, and wedges for opening locked containers.  Two large windows flank a narrow ladder that leads up to a loft area.  A lush verdant fern in a large ceramic pot is placed in the far corner, its leaves falling over onto the patterned floor.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Boxes bearing stamps from virtually everywhere are stacked to dangerous heights in a seemingly haphazard manner.  The boxes have been pushed aside here, making room to proceed both north and south.  To the east, a curtain occludes a small alcove.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Boxes bearing stamps from virtually everywhere are stacked to dangerous heights in a seemingly haphazard manner.  The boxes have been pushed aside here, making room to proceed both north and south.  To the east, a curtained opening occludes a small alcove.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Pristine and tidy, the small room has walls of stucco that are a brilliant shade of white.  A large marble fireplace, riddled with gold veins, rises in the northern corner of the room and casts rippling orange lights upon a pair of armchairs that have been positioned close by.  Near the door is a curtained arch with a low counter topped in black marble set before it.

title: [Cobblers' Wares]
description: Behind a long, marble-topped counter stands a storage unit that encompasses the entire wall.  The top third of the unit is comprised of shelves containing boxes of many sizes.  The remainder is made entirely of wide, shallow drawers labeled with the names of various animals.

title: [Rainbow Tent, Entry]
description: Heavy iron brackets secure some sturdy wooden stemples that lead down a nearly bottomless hole in the center of the room.  Several brightly colored footprints and splatter marks painted upon the wooden floor lead from the stemples to the tent entry, with one footprint bearing seven differently hued toe marks.

title: [Warehouse, Storage Room]
description: The storage room is surprisingly quiet, though compared to the warehouse itself it would almost have to be.  A long wooden counter stretches across the entire length of the room, restricting public access to the main storage area.  At the end of the counter is a low, wide platform that is used to facilitate the loading and unloading of leathers and furs.

title: [Temple, Chapel of Life]
description: Far beneath the roots of the Temple, you stand in a place of judgment and change.  Two statues face each other across the chamber.  One, made of pale alabaster, gleams in the dim light.  The other, carved of diorite, soaks up all light and is barely visible.  A bell tolls somewhere unseen, deep and sonorous, as the heartbeat of its mother must sound to the babe yet unborn in the safety of the womb.  There is a sadness to the sound that instills in you an intense sense of loss and foreboding.

title: [A Fallen Giant]
description: The tumble of fast-moving water suffuses the air with constant sound and a glimmering display of light dances through the trees that edge this stretch of grass and thick scrub.  The remnant of an ancient tree fills this clearing.  The sheer breadth of the stump and its ragged summit overhead can only hint at the once great majesty of this forest king.

title: [Cobbling Court, Storage Area]
description: Stacks of crates and barrels create a sort of crooked pathway that snakes throughout the room. With her arms folded across her chest, the warehouse manager keeps a watchful eye on everyone and everything in the storage room.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Entry]
description: This quaint cottage, smelling of rich earth and damp foliage, is home to a hard-packed dirt floor covered in wood shavings and golden hay.  When even the slightest breeze blows through the room, dust dances and swirls around the floor while sharp whistling noises serve as musical accompaniments.  Many tendrils of bright green ivy drape from the ceiling to the floor along the east wall, creating a delicate curtain leading into the next room.

description: Reddish tiling spreads across the floor in pleasant contrast to the white stucco walls.  A trio of curving arches to the west open up into the showroom, while a simple arch to the north leads out into an open-air courtyard.  Just adjacent, a large bamboo desk has been commandeered by a massive collection of papers and half-full dye bottles.

title: [Herbalist, Salesroom]
description: The acrid smell of cooking acantha fills your nostrils the moment you step inside the cottage.  Various herbs and flowers hang drying from a line that has been strung back and forth across the room.  Wicker baskets of all shapes and sizes have been laid out across the counter, offering all types of remedies.

title: [Memnole's Cottage]
description: Sparse and spacious, the cottage has three windows set into the center of each of its walls and though it has an entry there isn't a door.  Bamboo floorboards maintain a bright glossy sheen that easily reflects the filtered sunlight throughout the area and even reaches to the center of the room where a patterned prayer blanket rests.  Small shrines located in each of the room's four corners are lit by various candles, their flames sporadically spluttering.

title: [Marble House, Arcane Sales]
description: The shop opens up into a vast space.  Numerous trinkets and potions can be seen scattered throughout the many holding containers lining the silk-draped walls.

title: [Tigerlily Bowery]
description: Walls covered in warm brown panels rise from the coral orange tiles that spread across the floor and are only interrupted by wide windows that are framed in cerulean gauze drapes.  Standing opposite the entry is a roped-off arch, which has a set of stairs leading up.  Twin counters stand in the center of the shop and flank a workbench, where various bows are being crafted.

title: [Firefly Villa, Front Desk]
description: Polished paneling reflects the light the candles that are housed within wrought iron wall scones, their warm glow providing ample illumination throughout the small lobby.  Tall and wide, an alcove recessed into the northern wall housing a plethora of cubbies is guarded by a circular teak and cedar desk, while a set of spiraling stairs leads to the second level.

title: [Marble House, Consignment]
description: A large woven tapestry dominates the eastern wall, illustrating an elven mage clasping an intricately carved amulet.  Tucked into a corner is a sorting bin filled with sands of varying color and refinement.

title: [Marble House, Used Emporium]
description: Nearing the back of the shop, the displays begin to offer less polish and reveal more usage.  Despite their appearance, their craftsmanship shows many more years left before their expiration.  A witchwood pentagonal table stands neatly centered along the back wall.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Tunnel]
description: Light from the outer caverns filters through the translucent mushroom cap, playing off bits of crystal that have been suspended from the ceiling.  The surroundings are quite drab in comparison to the exterior, though a hint of color can be glimpsed further down a steep tunnel.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although a modest amount of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly. title: [D.H. Cobbling Outlet, Stock]
description: A wide steel counter runs along a parallel section of the western wall that has been fitted with sliding drawers housing a variety of skins, pelts, hides, and other cobbling supplies.  Thick inventory lists have been bound together in a book that rests on a table off to one side.  The mingled scents of leatherworking, tanning, and dying drift in from several directions.

title: [Cysaegir, Top of Pedestal]
description: The air thickens from this vantage point on the pedestal, where alternating shades of paled purple, pink, and white light reflect from the disk above, struggling against the glare of the golden sun.  Like fingers of a blind man, hazy mist traverses the ground to obscure the form of a woman.  Loud creaking sounds, emanating from the warped rocking chair she rests in, are muted significantly by a droning sound like that of a thousand agitated cinder wasps.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: The sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.  The aromatic fragrances of tuberoses fill the air from where they overflow from within stamped brass flowerpots.  Several of the tall stalks are bent over the side of the pots, as if the clusters they bear are too heavy.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: Only diverse in their coloring, almost perfect specimens of verbena is crammed into embossed brass flowerpots.  In one of the pots, a lone salmon-hued blossom stands out.  The sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.

title: [Ariebaela's Archery Nook]
description: Located at the back of the shop adjacent to a carved wooden counter, a thick, leather-bound tome rests in the seat of a rocking chair.  Draped across the back of the rocker is a forest green lap blanket made of thick wool.  Fluttering from the open window of the cottage are delicate silk curtains embroidered with crossbows, arrows, and bolts in iridescent thread.  The gentle breeze causes wood shavings to scatter across the floor of the otherwise pristine shop.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Natural recesses in the stone display various crystal figurines in an assortment of shapes and colors.  A rock formation that is topped with a square piece of glass is obviously serving as a counter.  Mullein torches cast flickering light along the walls, bathing the floor beneath them with a soft glow.  Concealing one of the shop's stone walls is a series of dupioni silk tapestries.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Mullein torches cast flickering light above a table that is holding an assortment of very interesting items pertinent to the art of alchemy.  Piles of large, leather-bound tomes take up space in three of the four corners of this oddly shaped chamber.  Blocked by a rocking chair with an overstuffed pillow as a cushion, the wall bears a hole of considerable size.  From within the breach, greenish light waxes and wanes rhythmically.

title: [Cobbler's Cobby, Storage Room]
description: Bound by thick cords, spotted leopard pelts lay in a heap outside of an overturned coffer.  On a countertop in the rear of the room, clear jars are filled with an assortment of various-sized brass studs.  Displayed on the opposite end of the counter are shiny buckles that can be used to adorn almost any style boots or shoes.

title: [Trading Post, Dry Goods]
description: Backpacks, sacks and cloaks are folded neatly onto shelves behind the counter.  A few flasks filled with colored liquid decorate the crossbeams overhead.  Flickering candles add a little light to the otherwise dim, windowless room.  Heat billows in from the wood burning stove in the foyer to the east.

title: [Trading Post, Jeweler]
description: A tall counter stretches across the center of the room, a latched swinging door being the only route to the area behind it.  The red carpeting is somewhat worn on a path from the counter back to the center of the trading post.  A long table behind the counter has piles of different gems on it, sorted by size, color, and type.  The pass through the mountains is visible out of the window to the east.

title: [Trading Post, Furrier]
description: The thin carpeting is mostly covered with a plush bearskin rug.  A few small skins cover the otherwise bare wooden walls.  The rock barrier of the mountainside is the only thing visible out of the window.  A stout dwarf works diligently behind the counter, measuring and cutting skins of all kinds.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Chamber]
description: The musty smells of damp earth and moldering stone clash with the acrid smoke from guttering censers scattered throughout this narrow space tucked between the foundations of massive columns.  Someone has hung some old tapestries in the gaps between the footings, but their decaying and moth-eaten fabrics do little but reinforce the shabbiness of the area  The only furnishing is a slab of ochre sandstone, from which hangs several wooden amulets.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.
The narrow stone passageway is entirely silvery grey -- floor, ceiling, and walls alike -- save for a peacock blue silk curtain.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Festival Bank]
description: Blue-green moss creeps along the upper walls of the structure, which is leaning very slightly to one side.  Where windows once looked out, boards now cover the spaces, and dust, mud, and cobwebs sweep across amlost every surface.  The only clean space is a makeshift teller's cage and a polished silver sign set up in one corner.

Where windows once looked out, boards now cover the spaces, and dust, mud, and cobwebs sweep across almost every surface.  The only clean space is a makeshift teller's cage and a polished silver sign set up in one corner.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which runs north-south.  On the east wall is a curtained opening, and to the south you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [Island Armor]
description: Potted palms in each of the four corners add a splash of green to the otherwise pale brown veneer of this polished bamboo paneled room.  Mannequins of various statures stand along the walls boasting the newest armor styles, and an elaborately carved gold and green marble counter dominates the back of the room.  Shelves have been built into the wall behind the counter, each one holding samples of the various armor accessories up for sale.

title: [Island Arms]
description: Polished green and black marble walls enclose this spacious room.  Sharply arched windows open up to the lush greenery outside and allow a fragrant island breeze to freshen the air within the shop.  Glass display cases rest on the cool green marble floor at sporadic intervals, while pewter oil lamps hang on the walls between the windows.  Taking up residence at the back of the room is a large bamboo lacquered counter.

title: [Warehouse, Cobbler's Delight]
description: White shutters frame an enormous window in the eastern wall, which is covered in stucco and painted a deep emerald green.  Complementing the warm glow of the teak floors, a long counter fashioned of linden stretches across the center of the room, creating a physical barrier that separates the shelves filled with wares from the walking space.  Baskets arranged along the opposite wall are filled with threads, measuring tapes, thimbles, and other cobbling necessities.

title: [Once A Pawn A Time]
description: Tightly packed earth held in place by rusted wire meshwork makes up the bottom of the walls, while the upper portions are composed of blocks of limestone that jut up into a brush-woven ceiling.  Several swamp goblins argue unceasingly as they rummage around behind a huge slab of limestone that serves as a counter.  Nearly obscured by the mud and filth caked on its surface and set behind a squat limestone barrel, a stiff curtain hangs from several crooked hooks.

title: [Lyra-Flyr Corral]
description: Set to one side of the bailey, near the hostelry, a small verdant corral is surrounded by a pale stone fence.  A beautiful maple stable sits towards the back of the enclosure.  High above the double sliding doors are a pair of morning doves perched on a stack of hay.

title: [Locus Lyceum, Clerk's Office]
description: Screens painted with orange lotus blossoms create a protective barrier around the eastern and northern curve of the room, while the western curve is fashioned of dark green bamboo poles.  A glass-topped white rattan desk is positioned catty-corner to the room's only true corner and is arranged so that the person sitting in the rattan chair can watch both the western and southwestern corridors with an unhindered view.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This cozy little warehouse almost has a boutique-like feel to it.  Individual displays are separated by large hanging tapestries and are individually attended by smartly dressed assistants.  A light perfume hangs in the air, continually refreshed by occasional spritzes from an unseen source.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: Numerous neatly labeled bins line the walls of this well-tended establishment, displaying a myriad of trinkets, doodads, and kitsch.  Large paned windows have been thrown open to allow ample natural light and the comforting island breeze into the shop, though not a speck of dust or sand is visible anywhere.  Thick, immaculate rugs, in neutral earth tones, cover the center of the open floorplan, providing soft, secure footing as the shopkeeper busily checks and rechecks each bin repeatedly.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This well-stocked warehouse contains a vast array of keepsakes and collectibles.  Carefully organized and maintained, it is clear that the keeper considers this a labor of love.  Attendants loiter in various places, awaiting the queries of any potential customer.

title: [Antiques, Baubles, And Trinkets]
description: Stacks of wooden boxes and crates are piled high around the small room overflowing with a wide assortment of trinkets.  Various bits and pieces of curiosity are stuffed inside several dust-covered display cases.  The walls are lined with wooden shelves cluttered with a tangle of items.  Attendants wander in and out of the aisles, pausing to peer inside a container before resuming their search.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: Numerous baubles and trinkets fill nearly every available nook and cranny of the building.  Dark and musty, a slight hint of dust and mildew hangs heavily in the air.  Sturdy shelves and deep oak bins strive fruitlessly to contain the jumbled mess.  Several attendents move confidently among the items, seemingly knowing exactly where everything is.

title: [Skyhigh Curiosities]
description: Piles of modwir cases are displayed about the small room, their insides lined with soft velvet to cushion the various treasures nestled within.  Several glass boxes in front of an arched postern door show off a wide variety of curiosities through clear panes.  Although the containers are organized haphazardly, a pair of attendants seems to know exactly where each requested item is.

title: [Warehouse, Storage Room]
description: The din of the open warehouse is muffled by several mammoth hides draped against the walls, the giant layers set behind a long wooden counter, preventing access to the public.  A riveted wooden platform sits towards one end of the counter, loaded with twine-tied bundles of fabric, neatly stacked and labeled.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Countinghouse]
description: Shadows dart in and out of this corner nook, and hushed whispers mix with the distinctive sound of clinking coins.  Raucous cheers from the arena make it nearly impossible to understand the mutterings.  A pair of black-gloved hands poke out from beneath a stone ledge, ready to accept your coins.

title: [Oleander's Defenses]
description: Slightly crowded, the shop is filled with armor-adorned mannequins that display the various wares sold here.  A short, low counter bisects the shop at the back, while a series of wide windows, each wrapped in silk, occupy two of the four walls and allow the island's breezes to cool the otherwise warm room.

title: [Cypress Sundries]
description: Whitewashed walls wrap the tiny room and are interrupted by enormous windows framed by thick shutters that can be opened to allow the cool island breezes to pass through.  Cabinets and cupboards housing various sundries are positioned between the windows, while a low counter stands before a double-wide arch.

title: [Rose's Arms Depot]
description: Framed in oak, a pair of windows flank the entry and allow the bright glow of the day to slant across the smooth tiles of the floor.  Sturdy racks, crafted of various woods dyed a warm golden hue, are neatly arranged throughout the shop and display the various wares sold here.  A thin counter, its sides wrapped in off-white skirts, stretches across the back wall.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Bank]
description: A tall counter stretches around the edge of a vault-like opening on the wall.  Several layers of wooden spikes are carved into both sides of the counter as if to keep things in or out; which, is unclear.  Standing behind the counter is a tall burly banker garbed in thick furs.

title: [Caligos Pawnshop]
description: Water-warped oak boards run from floor to ceiling, their wavy faces are pockmarked with rusty nails and the seams between are filled with fresh tar.  Dust swings lazily back and forth from the rafters as an exterior breeze invades the shop from the open teak door, while golden light pools upon the distorted floorboards from lanterns hung to either side of a few crooked stone steps that lead into the backroom.  A hollow manatee skull hangs over the counter and creates shadows upon the smooth surface.

title: [Caligos Bank]
description: Arranged at an angle to two water-stained walls, a driftwood counter and a painted wooden sign beside it seem to be the focal point of the long, rectangular room that is cloyingly filled with an acrid scent of seawater and rotting vegetation.  Scrub marks are deeply gouged into the floorboards, evidence that someone attempted to reduce the stench and stains, and several lanterns dangling from above are arranged in close groupings in an effort to keep the bank's corners in shadows.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This warehouse is absolutely packed with all manner of baubles and knick-knacks.  Despite the large number of displayed items, great care has obviously gone into organizing the shelves, for nothing seems cluttered or haphazard.  Attendants move through out the room, delicately adjusting and cleaning each piece, while responding to the needs of any potential customer.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This carefully cut warehouse is shaped into a near perfect square.  Pedestals of living rock have been sculpted at exact intervals throughout the entire area.  Each one is carefully adorned with the finest of collectible treasures that one can find.  Several attendants wait nearby, ready to serve the needs of any potential customers.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This cluttered warehouse is nearly packed to the rafters with all manner of trinkets and collectibles.  Attendants busy themselves by sorting items into densely packed displays, following an organizational system apparently known only to themselves.

title: [Irreplaceable Items on Ice]
description: The scent of pine is strong here, but works in concert with the decor of this efficient store.  A dusting of snow covers every flat surface, falling off the edges in a frozen tableau.  Wide green shelves line the walls, festooned with nooks and crannies of every imaginable shape and size.  Despite the amount of storage, not a single space is unoccupied.  Halfling attendants scurry about, assisting customers as needed, but remaining busy with any number of small tasks.

title: [City Stables, Stalls]
description: Soft whinnying, snorting, and the stamping of hooves resounds throughout the stables.  Stablehands are constantly on the move, fetching fresh horses for the traveling merchants, messengers, or guards who board their steeds here.  The stalls are clean and well-tended, and the horses seem content with their lots in life here in the Landing.

title: [Erenad Courtyard]
description: Surrounded by a pale grey stone wall, the cobblestone courtyard of the carriage house fans out in semi-circular pattern with the focal point leading to a white paneled house.  To the other side of the building is an archway that leads into the stable.  Pots of blooming flowers are set about decorating the area with their bright colors.

title: [Viridian Meadows, Pasture]
description: The grass in this area is uniform in both length and hue, creating a breathtaking panacea of emerald green.  An ornate wooden fence encircles the meadow in dazzling white, and each span of the fence contains a different equestrian silhouette at its center.  Each post in the fence is topped with a brass lion, brightly polished and facing outward, placid and regal.  At the far end of the meadow, a wide white barn with deep umber accents can be seen.

title: [Sorsha's Tent, Inside]
description: This dimly lit tent is filled with carefully stacked piles of armor, clothing, and various other trinkets too numerous to mention.  A long table rests in the corner and behind it, an enruned veil which seems to be covering the back section of the tent, preventing any chance of seeing what lies beyond.

title: [Kraken's Fall Bank, Teller]
description: A wide wooden counter spans the entire width of this room, and interspersed across its top are heavy iron bars a handsbreadth apart, securely fastened to both the counter and the stone ceiling overhead.  A glossy black placard inlaid with gold leaf text is prominently placed above a single gap in the center of the iron supports.  Three stern-looking guards stand at the ready, their hands near their weapons as they track every movement in the room.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Taskmaster]
description: This room is excessively fragrant, due largely to the number of burning braziers interspersed about the space.  Each one appears to be emitting a slightly different hue of wispy smoke, and a purplish haze has accumulated along the ceiling, nearly obscuring the timber overhead.  A small desk sits against one wall, piled high with papers and scrolls of various sizes and shapes.

title: [Bejeweled Booty]
description: Hazy moonlight filters through the entrance flap of the modest tent, assisting the dusty oil lamps set about the shop to provide some illumination against the night shadows.  The corners of the shop are filled with piles of exotic goods and a large expensive rug stretches across the ground.  A long glass counter serves as the focal point and a curtain of colorful glass beads offers access to the backroom.

Though some sunlight filters in through the entrance flap of the modest tent, the interior remains cool and shadowed.  The corners of the shop are filled with piles of exotic goods and a large expensive rug stretches across the ground.  A long glass counter serves as the focal point and a curtain of colorful glass beads offers access to the backroom.

title: [Unburied Treasures]
[Unburied Treasure]
description: The salt-bleached floorboards of this wagon groan ominously underfoot, and a stuffed seagull eyes you suspiciously from a prominent perch directly over the driftwood countertop that dominates the space.  Small chests and crates litter the floor, stacked haphazardly atop each other in places, and each containing some manner of bauble or trinket.  The air is humid and dank in this place, combining with the small room to create a stifling ambience.

title: [Unburied Treasures, Smithing]
description: Leached of color, the driftwood walls curve to form a peaked roof that converge upon a single, thick oak beam.  Brass lanterns, shielded by rainbow glaes windows, hang from hooks over a leather-topped dark oak counter, their steady glow illuminating both the counter's surface and a nearby mahogany sign.  A low cloth-covered bench pressed against one wall looks to have served as someone's bed in recent history, and discarded clothing strewn about the space bespeaks a history of residence in this small room.

title: [The Intoxicating Flora]
description: Tendrils of pale white smoke snake through the dense jungle of plants occupying most of the available shop, leaving the faintest whisper of dark amber to resonate throughout.  A resin-stained workbench sits entangled in vines along the back wall, the top covered in dusty tomes alongside a worn marble mortar and pestle.  A faint hiss and rattle echo within the walls, its origin obscured by leaves and blossoms.

title: [The Intoxicating Flora, Clinic]
description: Bundles of dried, fragrant herbs are scattered across the room, the appendage-like pieces obscuring the more macabre animal bones littered in between.  A pool of heavy grey wool engulfs a tall figure standing between a rough canvas cot and small wrotwood table, the second covered in deeply carved grooves.  Overlapped hemp mats cover the floor, the pieces concealing the deep red stains that have seeped into the dirt.

title: [Bushybrow's Collectibles]
description: Despite the chaos outside, the interior of this shop is still and quiet.  The ambient noise is muffled by the stacks and stacks of misshapen crates piled high against the outer walls, and the wooden plank floor underfoot is made of sturdy beams that don't make a sound when trod upon.  A large glass-topped table stands near the center of the space, remarkably clean given the constant bite of salt in the air.

title: [The Naked Fauna]
description: A small counter occupies the back wall, its backdrop a large glass tank housing a variety of colorful fish.  Stretched beneath a tall drying rack covered in stretched animal skins, a loosely-woven seagrass mat attempts to protect the wagon floors from scuffing but does little to hide the wear and tear.  A cheerful windchime of two pewter octopuses sways in the doorway of the shop.

title: [Mystigoggles Magicorium]
description: Weblike tendrils of smoke weave between the multitude of telescopes that line the walls of the shop, leaving only the faint fragrance of petrichor to linger in the air.  Various glass lenses have been set up across the canvas-draped counters, the convex and concave domes angled to highlight the wares in the dimly lit room.  A long-haired grey cat lounges lazily upon an old velvet chaise at the back of the shop, occasionally scanning the room before returning his nap.

title: [Mystigoggles Consignment]
description: A one-eyed wench warily glances about the shop, her hands placed firmly upon an elongated ebonwood counter situated at the center of the rug-covered floor.  The occasional spark of light flickers from a series of glass spheres flanking the counter, highlighting a pair of realistic leathery toad and frog figurines leaning against a brass-latched box.  Matching chests overflowing with a number of magical components line the brocaded walls, the contents clicking and twinkling together at various intervals.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Front Desk]
description: A happy clerk in a smart blue uniform stands alert at a clean little desk.  A handful of freshly-buffed brass keys hang on the wall behind the clerk as he spins about his dominion in perpetual search for something to tidy up.

title: [Office of Transportation]
description: Cobalt blue rugs patterned with red and gold whorls stretch across the office floor, the metallic threads dancing as the swirling light of dozens of pendant-shaped frosted globes anchored to the ceiling pulse with a variety of hues.  A lacquered golden linden counter takes up most of the eastern wall and creates a protective barrier around a portly female agent, who watches the office's comings and goings with interest.

title: [Office of the Curator]
description: An errant breeze ruffles the gauzy curtains that frame a picture of a frog sitting on a box.  Backlit by candles in wrought iron wall sconces, tiny motes ride the current, eddying around and over a wide assortment of baubles, curios, and statues.  A thick layer of fresh reeds supports a braided burgundy rug, and a well-used broom leans against a brass plaque affixed to the wall.  Mounted strategically above a windowed blue door is a brass bell.

title: [Cartwright, Office]
description: Small copper lanterns, hung from wrought iron chains, cast shadows that flicker gently against pine-paneled walls.  Flanked by two uneven stacks of sealed crates is a pocked cypress desk set at an angle near the far corner of the room.

title: [Storm Petrel's Wing]
description: Along this shop's timbered walls, bows of all makes and sizes hang like stuffed and mounted hunting trophies.  Feathers, paint splatters, and other evidence of arrow-making lightly litter the creaky wooden floors.  Behind a narrow leather-topped counter, the shop's wide variety of archery-related wares sit on display.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A bright blue curtain hangs on the south wall, masking the entrance to a locker booth.  The corridor branches off to the northeast and southeast, with more locker booths visible in both directions.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A flashy azure curtain masks the entrance to a locker booth in the north wall.  The hallway branches off to the northwest and northeast, with more locker booths visible in both directions.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: The north wall of the hall is covered with a garish blue curtain marking the entrance to a locker booth.  The hallway branches off to the southwest and southeast, with more locker booths visible in both directions.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A stark black curtain covers the entrance to a locker booth on the north wall of the walk.  The hallway branches off to the northwest and southwest, with more locker booths visible in both directions.  An aged hoarbeam bookcase sits flush against the wall at the intersection.

title: [River Lily, Livery Stable]
description: As the path progresses, the carpet of grass at its borders lengthens from a short shear to a lush, thick pile where its conveyance ends at a wrought iron gate.  The verdure rises in full sprays at the base of each post of an age-darkened split rail fence that encloses a livery yard.  Beyond the barrier stands a rustic dark green stable with high, arched roofing and dark green walls that blend with the verdant surroundings.

title: [Inking Den, Storage Hallway]
description: Stretching the length of the eastern wall, bright tiles of various hues and sizes are fitted together to create a rolling sea mosaic.  Beneath the churning waves mermaids frolic with dolphins, while sea hags coax sailors from their ships.  A large wrought iron ring anchored to the ceiling holds a glass-paned lantern over a curtained opening and provides ample illumination over the navy blue and gold rug-covered ground.

title: [Inking Den, Storage Hallway]
description: Stretching the length of the eastern wall, bright tiles of various hues and sizes are fitted together to create a rolling sea mosaic.  Beneath the churning waves is the dark shape of a kraken, while above is a three-masted schooner.  A large wrought iron ring anchored to the ceiling holds a glass-paned lantern over a curtained opening and provides ample illumination over the navy blue and gold rug-covered ground.

title: [Inking Den, Storage Hallway]
description: Stretching the length of the eastern wall, bright tiles of various hues and sizes are fitted together to create a rolling sea mosaic.  Beneath the churning waves are buried treasures and sunken ships, while above are avian-filled skies with puffy white clouds.  A large wrought iron ring anchored to the ceiling holds a glass-paned lantern over a curtained opening and provides ample illumination over the navy blue and gold rug-covered ground.

title: [Inking Den, Storage Hallway]
description: Stretching the length of the eastern wall, bright tiles of various hues and sizes are fitted together to create a rolling sea mosaic.  Beneath the churning waves are clouds of mica-dusted silt and bright crustaceans, while above are stormy skies and rollicking ships.  A large wrought iron ring anchored to the ceiling holds a glass-paned lantern over a curtained opening and provides ample illumination over the navy blue and gold rug-covered ground.

title: [Inking Den, Storage Hallway]
description: Stretching the length of the eastern wall, bright tiles of various hues and sizes are fitted together to create a rolling sea mosaic.  Beneath the churning waves are several wavy kelp beds, while above is a night sky displaying the tiny spheres of all four moons.  A large wrought iron ring anchored to the ceiling holds a glass-paned lantern over a curtained opening and provides ample illumination over the navy blue and gold rug-covered ground.

title: [Inking Den, Storage Hallway]
description: Stretching the length of the eastern wall, bright tiles of various hues and sizes are fitted together to create a rolling sea mosaic.  Beneath the churning waves are several forms of colorful aquatic life, while above are clear skies and bobbing ships.  A large wrought iron ring anchored to the ceiling holds a glass-paned lantern over a curtained opening and provides ample illumination over the navy blue and gold rug-covered ground.

title: [Cold River, Dock]
description: A grim black dock pokes out into the Issenflow, its warped planks glinting with ice in the aurora's light.  Two shipping boats and a dilapidated barge are tied to the dock poles.  The sound of the water slapping their hulls provides sullen percussion, accompanied only by the taunting babble of the river's sluggish flow.

title: [Sparkfinger's Alchemy, Workroom]
description: Uneven light from the aurora wavers through windows of brown glass, glinting off of bubbles in the panes.  Several glowing lamps supplement the weak lighting, awakening glints and gleams from multicolored bottles on lopsided shelves lining the walls.  Behind a steel-topped counter, bubbles froth feverishly within a collection of beakers and flasks filled with multifarious fluids.

title: [Mist Harbor Mail Office]
description: The bright sunlight which trickles in from the small dusty window along the far wall dances across the warped driftwood floorboards of this small mail office.  A hurried mail clerk rushes back and forth across the mahogany front counter, stuffing envelopes and packages in various awaiting cubbyholes, seemingly oblivious to the rest of the world.  In the corner of the room, a nearly featherless macaw sits in a tarnished silver cage releasing a shrill squawk with each new customer who enters the building.

title: [Post Office, Finn's Office]
description: A heavily scarred desk is situated opposite of the entrance to the room, and behind it stands a grizzled half-elven clerk.  Strung along the walls is a length of thick rope hung with an odd assortment of items.  Leaning against the desk, in easy handreach of the clerk, is a large, armed crossbow.  The occassional squawk of a river bird passes through the poorly constructed walls of the room, along with the scent of wet earth.

title: [Northern Post, Mail Room]
description: Framed by windows of frosted glass, the front door of the post office allows wintry air to cut through the warmth of the close room.  Beeswax candles sit along the window sills, but they lend more light than heat and perfume the air gently with their honeyed smell.  The real heat source is a blazing coal stove behind the polished pine counter.

title: [Northern Post, Little Shop]
description: Shelves full of packing materials line the brick walls of the little shop, making it seem more cramped than its limited space would suggest.  Guarded by a carved statue of an emperor penguin, the counter has a small stand holding envelopes and stampbooks.  Crystal-globed candles occupy sconces on the walls, lending a pleasant beeswax scent to the air and brightening the surroundings.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Peacock Couriers]
description: Dark blue tiles cover the floor of the spacious office, their hue matching those that line the single arch leading out of the building.  Pots of lush greenery are scattered about, contrasting with the darker decor.  A long marble counter divides the room in twain with a pierced mistwood screen resting atop.  Windows in the partition show the space beyond, which is lined with small, silver mailboxes, each one set with a tiny dial.

title: [Imperial Courier Office, 'Haven]
description: Faint light from the street outside filters into the room through the a large oak-framed window, providing scant illumination for a pair of paintings hanging upon one wall.  Numerous large sacks, packages, and crates are stacked and organized behind a long wooden counter that dominates the back and side walls.  A pair of glass hurricane lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting soft light across the room.

Sunlight fills the room as it pours in through a large oak-framed window and illuminates a pair of paintings hanging on one wall.  Numerous large sacks, packages, and crates are stacked and organized behind a long wooden counter that dominates the back and one side wall.  A pair of glass hurricane lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting additional light across the room.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Mail Room]
description: Tucked away from the bustle of the airship terminus, this small room is only slightly less crowded than the main lobby.  A steady flow of people come and go through a broad archway to pick up or drop off parcels with the mail clerk behind a heavily dented oak counter.  The stuffy air is filled with a light dust that smells of paper, burlap, and sweat.

title: [Zul Logoth Mail Depot]
description: Snaking its way around this cramped room is a long line of Zul Logoth residents awaiting service, most wearing impatience on their faces.  A uniformed clerk is stationed behind a dingy stone counter, next to a shiny grey glaes stand stocked with mailing supplies.  Occupying most of the western wall, a wide notice board has been tacked up with numerous papers.

title: [Cysaegir, Words on the Wind]
description: Several hanging baskets of wildflowers fill the room with rich floral scents.  A large ebony counter dominates the center, its surface covered with piles of journals and parchment.  The back wall is lined with rows of small cubby holes stuffed with various envelopes and papers.  Wooden crates are stacked beneath the mail slots, each filled with a variety of packages and parcels.

title: [Teras Postmaster]
description: The air is heavy with the scent of paper and dust.  A doddering dwarven postal clerk keeps watch from behind a sturdy counter, above which hangs a framed sign.  The portrait hung near a distressed leather curtain is the only thing resembling decoration in this small office.

title: [Wandering Kraken's Mail Shop]
description: Neat as a pin and cozy, the shop has several mail-related wares stacked on shelves behind a polished driftwood counter with crystalline sides, and red-bricked walls are painted with cheerful images of absinthe green krakens juggling packages, letters, and books of stamps in their many, ocean blue tentacles.  Several tropical plants in terracotta vases line the walls, and a bright red hibiscus shrub flourishes next to piles of stacked mail.

title: [Scrivener's, Mail Room]
description: The entire back wall of this utilitarian room is covered with wooden shelving to form a latticework of pigeonholes for mail.  Each of the side walls holds a similar set of shelves, though the openings are larger, some almost ample enough to accommodate an average-sized dwarf.  Separating the sparsely furnished reception area from the bustling activity of the mail center is a tall slate-topped counter.  Smaller display cases topped with thick glass bracket the entryway.

title: [Clearing]
description: This wide clearing is covered in hay, though sections of black volcanic rock peek out from beneath.  Directly across from the entry arch is a large black barn trimmed in fiery red paint.  The handles on the door are glaes and forged in the shape of a horseshoe.

title: [Yander's Farm, Barn]
description: Dust motes float lazily in the air amid the redolent aroma of fresh hay in the barn's interior.  Heavy oak rafters high overhead span this large open area suitable for several gnomish threshing machines.  A newly painted baker's door stands open along the western wall, providing egress to the attached stables.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Paddock]
description: A long, weathered fence made of alternating pine and birchwood encloses a particularly large meadow and separates it from the surrounding wilds.  Snow has piled up in the four corners of this large paddock, while an oblong trail that has been shoveled nearly clean in the center, the exposed ground covered with hoof marks.  Near the back of the lot stands a well-constructed barn illuminated by several oil lamps near its doors.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Corral]
description: Thick oak posts are securely anchored into the ground and linked with wooden rails to form a sturdy perimeter.  Hard packed dirt and gravel makes up the surface of the inner yard.  A wooden stable stands at the eastern end of the corral, where a pair of doors stand open to allow easy access.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Hallway]
description: A runner of thick, red woolen carpet follows the hallway north and south.  The runner covers the center of the red marble floor, providing a stable, soft, quiet area on which to walk.  Along the hallway, heavy golden velvet curtains allow entrance to private booths where one can access a personal locker.  Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walnut walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

title: [Brindlestoat's, Gem Shop]
description: The low eaves of the shop are smoke-stained and adorned with hanging sashes in a variety of faded colors.  A few pieces of old jewelry glint sullenly from beds of threadbare black velvet near the windows, but they are of low quality and luster.  Behind the smooth wooden counter, protected from the rest of the room by an old steel grate, is a more impressive trove of baubles and trinkets in a variety of metals and jeweled hues.

title: [Brindlestoat's, Moneylender]
description: A crooked wooden desk dominates the small nook to the eastern end of the jeweler's shop.  A tattered green banner above is stitched with piles of glinting coins.  At the desk sits a wizened halfling moneylender who pores over his ledgers with squinting eyes.

title: [Bramblefist's Tanning, Furrier]
description: A snarling warg head stares down from over the doorway leading into the small shop, watchful eyes taking in the collection of tanning racks and barrels of stinking liquid.  Beyond the crowded foyer is a counter of spruce draped in elk hide.  Wreaths of pine and other woven evergreens hang on the walls amid trophies of the hunt, but the fresh woodsy scents do little to ameliorate the sour odor of the business.

title: [Clove and Dandelion]
description: Bundles of fragrant phlox, winter savory, and tufted goosegrass hang from the exposed rafters of the cottage, the scent of dried flora mingling with the haze from a cobblestone chimney.  Baskets, gardening and hunting tools, and various trinkets hang from the rough pine walls, creating a cluttered yet cozy feel to the space.  Low chairs surround the fireplace and rest upon a faded rug of ebon and tangerine hues.

title: [The Greedy Ghost, Entry]
description: A duo of cats prowl along the lacquered mahogany counter running the length of the shop, nonchalantly tipping small piles of jewelry and gemstones to the wood-planked floor behind them.  An ethereal jewel-laden spectre mutters to itself as it attempts to reorganize the treasures, gently chastising its feline companions in half-hearted fashion.  The faint clatter of chains and bangles echo through the shop as the spirit moves about, gesturing as a small quill and parchment records its haul.

title: [Bones and Baubles, Entry]
description: The well-dressed form of a greenish grey zombie stands before a bejeweled counter, the proprietor attempting to wipe away clumps of dirt and flesh from the glass, despite being the origin of the detritus.  Every corner of the shop is filled with antiques and weaponry, the stacked crates sorted by a small family of raccoons grasping each item curiously between their claws.  The tiniest of the cubs waves about a single finger bone as it attempts to add it to the treasure pile.

title: [The Haunting Sphere, Entry]
description: Creeping vines of blackened ivy engulf the walls of the small shop, the tendrils wrapped tightly along the exposed wooden crossbeams, spilling foliage across the velvet-draped glass counter in the center of the room.  Vellum-cut lanterns of glazed parchment cast uneven shadows across the rune-etched floor, exposing the circular patterns inscribed in faded ebon chalk.  Various sealed glass jars line the back wall, filled with macabre oddities that float suspended in the luminescent liquid.

title: [Otherworldly Wealth, Lobby]
description: A pair of skeletons, bedecked in faded smoking jackets and cravats, sit on elevated platforms before several rows of benches, the duo elbowing one another as they chuckle to themselves.  Gilt-framed paintings of towns and villages cover the scratched stone walls, the images appearing to move from picture to picture as they navigate the vertebral-carved edges.  A thick glass-paned tank is filled in the skeletal forms of several fish, bumping into one another as they swim about the greenish water.

title: [Logging Colony, Tig's Barn]
description: Patches of mud, dried and cracked on the edges, dominate the entry to high-ceilinged stables, while sash windows tilted open allow the coastal air to slip through the humid confines.  Tidy bales of hay, straw, and rushes surround support posts that are evenly spaced down the various lanes.  The whiny and nickering of stalled animals fills the air.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.

description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east-west.  To the east you can see an intersection leading to more lockers, and a curtained opening on the north wall.

description: You are in a dimly lit hallway.  The torches on the walls flicker and fade casting all manner of shadows about the hallway.
