title: [Imperial Post]
description: Roughly triangular in shape, the Imperial Post widens at the back, providing ample room behind the counter for the storing of mail and letters awaiting sorting.  A polished lebbek wood sign hangs on one terracotta-accented wall, next to an elaborate mural of Brisker's Cove.  Pots of bright pink muhly grass cluster around a vase of fresh-cut flowers, adding splashes of brightness to the otherwise pristine white-and-terracotta decor.

title: [The Jolly Chimera, Cleric]
description: Several cots line the room beneath detailed murals of various ship battles with body-strewn decks.  Each mural depicts a dwarven cleric walking cheerfully through the carnage.  The floors are scuffed and splattered with crimson stains, which are only partially obscured by various potted herbs.  A dusty cabinet is filled with chrism gems, white flasks, and obscure paraphernalia.

title: [The Jolly Chimera, Healer]
description: Lush greenery in terracotta pots fills the area with the overwhelming fragance of healing herbs and plants.  A few utilitarian cots are positioned within reach of the healer, and several shelves line the walls, overflowing with potions, elixirs, and salves.

title: [The Drifting Depository]
description: Dank and humid, the brigantine's interior is dimly lit by flickering torches.  A ripped banner hangs along the back wall, reading "Bank of Kraken's Fall," and an incongruously pristine and gigantic iron vault sits in the corner behind a rickety counter.  Two guards flank the vault, each bristling with weaponry and bulging muscles.

title: [Good Fences]
description: Uneven flooring with a decided downward slant holds dozens of rickety shelves crammed with dust-covered trinkets from numerous ports of call.  A glass-fronted countertop may once have been designed to showcase wares, but its current smudged and saltstained existence reveals only shadowy outlines of items in its depths.  Sitting on top of the countertop is a small sign propped up by a rusty bell that reads, "Ring for Service."

title: [The Elven Sole, Entry]
description: The lacquered floor has been fashioned from a mixture of parqueted light and dark wood.  A freestanding desk in the center of the room has a long-haired elven woman behind it.  Against the left wall is a stockpile of wooden crates stamped in black with a logo of crossed laces.  A colossal bronze sign hangs above the grand archway, which leads to an illuminated hallway.

title: [Imperial Counting House, Entry]
description: Crowded but tidy, the customs house is home to many official services within the Comyner's Ward.  Stacks of crates and boxes waiting to be inspected have labels of lading attached to their faces, the inked markings nothing more than chicken scratch and patterns of repeating numbers.  A small accounting booth occupies one wall, a bored teller sitting behind its protective bars.

title: [Imperial County House, Exchange]
description: Dimly lit and cramped, the small hallway is stifling and warm.  Very little airflow makes its way through the passage as crates and boxes fill the eastern wall from floor to ceiling.  Illuminated from within, a small exchange booth houses a sleepy clerk.

title: [Nielira Harbor Mail Office]
description: Ebony-washed bricks create the framework of the mail office, the stones curtained in drapes of Nalfein ivy, creating a backdrop of ivory-edged vert leaves.  Floor-to-ceiling windows crafted from blackened iron are affixed with jade-lacquered shutters, the apertures allowing a seaside breeze to filter through the shop.  The narrow slots provide small glimpses of the bustling harbor, the faint sounds of the piers echoing against the counter-set dark stone walls.

title: [Cordwainer's Muse]
description: Jewel-toned swathes of fabric are draped across the jade-washed stucco walls of the shop, the brocades and laces entwined with chain-strung faerthiel in accompanying colors.  Wrought pewter brackets loft cases in vertical rows against the back wall, the footwear displayed behind panes of glass set before the ivy-curtained counter covered in dye swatches.  A lace-appliqued shoe form stands nestled in the far corner, its surface covered in silk-petaled naefira trailing down toward the planked floor.

title: [Nielira Harbor Bank]
description: A wide mural of Nielira Harbor engulfs the back wall of the establishment, the watercolored parchment covered in strokes of ink indicating points of interest.  Heartleaf curtains a glass-encased booth nestled in the far corner of the area, the exchange carefully watched by a trio of guards standing by a ceiling-high cabinet of labeled drawers.  Charcoal-drawn sketches of tall-masted vessels encircle a lacquered haon door, the entry revealing a long corridor filled with the scent of aged vellum.

title: [Nielira Bank, Exchange Booth]
description: Graduated curtains of verdant heartleaf veil the glass-encased booth from view, the floral-engulfed back wall creating a brilliant contrast to the lacquered ebony counter standing within the center.  A raven-haired exchange clerk stands behind the counter, occasionally turning around to prune the blossoms behind her, her belt laden with a variety of small garden tools alongside a quill and tiny inkpot.  The sounds of commerce and seagulls intermingle from outside the booth, the heavy footfalls echoing across the room.

title: [Mist Harbor Forge, Entrance]
description: A thick, heavy atmosphere fills the air with the acrid scent of smoldering metal.  A stone hallway leads towards several forging workshops opposite a steel-banded ironwood door that serves as an exit.  Dominating the far wall, a large placard crafted from wrought iron proudly showcases the forge's emblem, depicting a roaring furnace surrounded by a tapestry of intricately forged weapons and armor.  Lined up against a wall, a large steel workbench with several tools lies in disrepair.

title: [Khazar's Hold, Bank Branch]
description: The thin red carpet that covers the floor is worn in a line from the north to some teller windows, head high to a dwarf, in the southern wall.  Apart from a sign that has been hung on the wall over the windows, the only other decoration in the room is a small framed painting hung on the west wall.  Otherwise, this plain room offers no other portals or exits.

title: [Snakeroot's Apothecary, Store]
description: Lemon balm and lavender overflow the planters hung by the window of the shop.  The sweet scent from their profusion of flowers fills the small shop and is only the foremost of the multifarious herbal scents in the air.  Nosegays and herb bundles hang from the walls and occupy several small display tables in the cozy space.  Behind a high poisonwood counter, more dangerous herbs are kept, including sprigs of nightshade, clusters of white deathwort, and hemlock.

title: [Eldritch Elixirs, Showroom]
description: Brightly colored bottles catch the sunlight streaming through the wide bay windows facing the street.  They cast fragments of bright color--scarlet, green, and indigo--across the other wares in the showroom, an eclectic collection of wands, amulets, potions, and other arcane implements.  Atop a pedestal of carved ebony, a glass display holds a sliver of plinite the color of absinthe, but the crystal is spiderwebbed with deep cracks.

title: [Eldritch Elixirs, Acquisitions]
description: More of a workroom than a sales parlor, the room smells faintly of acrid catalysts and burning sulphur.  The likely source of the odor is a series of spiraled tubes, beakers, and vials full of strange bubbling liquids that sits behind the narrow teak sales counter.  Several bottles holding quicksilver, oil of antimony, and spirit of hartshorn gleam from a shelf that would require a ladder to reach, their identities obvious from neat labels beneath each.

title: [Vorwyn's Lapidary, Procurement]
description: Guarded by a high counter of jewel-inlaid walnut, an elaborate gold and steel lockbox holds a pile of silver, gold, and copper coins.  The tools of a jewelcrafter's trade hang from a rack of the same fine wood, hammers, chisels, tongs, and hand drills all maintained with painstaking care.  A worktable beneath the rack houses a pair of lathes.  Though clean, the wood of the table glints with gem dust in the light streaming through the windows.

title: [Gaunt's Run, Broker]
description: Shaded glimaerstone lamps illuminate the wood-paneled walls of the shop's back office, awakening reddish glints in the smooth ebony.  Behind an antique desk hangs a portrait in an elaborate gilded frame.  The canvas features an older man, his hair silvered at the temples, standing with a pomegranate in hand.  He is tall and raw-boned.  To either side of the portrait, cases hold tablets, daggers, and other artifacts of times past.  A burgundy rug softens the alternating wenge and white oak flooring.

title: [Grigg's Countinghouse, Clerk]
description: Stained glass windows cast shards of colored light on the gold-tasseled scarlet runner as it approaches a long thanot counter, behind which sit clerks in formal attire.  Several are busy counting piles of gold and silver coins, some with strange shapes like hexagons and squares.  One has platinum tradebars stacked before him.

title: [Matters of Metal, Smithy]
description: Soot stains the circular wall enclosing the smithy, darkening toward the rafters.  The crisscrossing beams overhead are intensely black, stained by decades of smoke.  Near to a stone-lined forge, an old anvil with a veil iron face and horn is littered with fragments of glistening metal.  An oaken tool rack hung opposite the forge holds tongs, hammers, and pokers.

title: [The Raven's Roost, Post]
description: An uncomplicated chandelier of iron and brass hangs from the ceiling near the entrance, supplementing the meager light streaming through the doorway into the windowless chamber.  In an alcove sits an old modwir desk, the space atop it littered with stacks of letters and unsent parcels.  From above comes the muted cawing of ravens.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Grotto]
description: Damp and dilapidated rugs, their scent cloying and dank, conceal cracks along the surface of a granite mezzanine overlooking a honeycombed grotto.  The sound of water dripping from crystalline stalactites echoes as it falls into a subterranean lagoon, causing ripples that glow and fade as they expand.

title: [Skins and Grins, Salesroom]
description: The air is thick with the pungent stink of tanning agents and the sickly sweet odor of animal carcasses.  Windows opened to let the malodorous melange escape share the stony walls with fine furs and fangs from a wide assortment of beasts.  Behind the counter a swarthy furrier works her trade, aided by tanning racks and vats of murky yellow fluid.  A massive skull with curled horns and a long jaw hangs over the partition.

title: [Northwatch Bank]
description: Brightly lit by overhead pendant lanterns, the counter area features intricate carvings of snowflakes and mountain ranges on the marble teller counters, each conveying icy landscapes in brilliant detail.  Behind the counters, a mural showcases fjords and mountains, conveying a coldness not easily felt within the humid space.

title: [Vornavis Bank]
description: Brass rods anchored to the white marble walls support long swathes of emerald green Vornavian silk, the unfettered ends pooling upon the polished floors.  A massive chandelier hovers over the space, illuminating the various teller counters fashioned of golden linden and carved with elegant swans with splayed wings.  An enterprising employee has roughly carved an orange-red lobster into the lower left corner of one counter, its claws open at the regal bird's webbed feet.  Beyond the counters is a mural.

title: [Seareach Bank]
description: Pendant lanterns dangle over the area, casting a warm glow over deep blue tapestries adorned with the red eagle crest of Seareach.  Gold-trimmed display cases house snakestones in hues of green and blue, the carved pieces arranged upon copper-hued velvet.  A polished marble counter with swirling patterns of sand and sea stands before a wall of intricate mosaics that depict the coastal trade routes of Brisker's Cove.  Tanned bankers work behind the counter.

title: [Torren Bank]
description: Sunlight filters through narrow, gold-trimmed windows, warming the white marble walls.  Gold-accented counters are carved with river motifs, depicting swirling currents and leaping fish.  A brass rod supports a canopy of light blue silk, embroidered with Torre's white stork crest.  The far wall features a mural of Torre's docks, where storks swoop over anchored ships.  Pendant lanterns, with copper stork bodies and etched glass panels, hang overhead, casting a soft, steady light.

title: [Landing Bank]
description: Transforming the opulent space, wooden beams of roughly hewn modwir are installed under the vaulted ceiling, causing the pendant lanterns to cast lattice-like shadows upon the floor.  Alternating oak and pine planks create a false wall designed to hide some of the white marble, its face covered in a chaotic mural in bright colors.  Protected by guards, tellers work from a pair of high counters, a potbellied stove resting between them.

title: [Bank of Teras Isle]
description: Rich granite from Teras Isle lines the lower walls, contrasting beautifully with the white marble.  Gold veins, naturally running through the stone, shimmer under the pendant lanterns.  Central to the room is a teller counter, forged from Terasian ironwood, detailed with hammered gold, and shaped like waves crashing against the shoreline.  Above, a large mural depicts the ancient volcano of Teras, with dwarven miners chipping away at its base.

title: [Bank of the Folly]
description: Mahogany counters arranged side-to-side form a horseshoe shape at the center of the space, their high sides intricately carved with repeating kraken motifs.  Beyond, a large, circular mural depicts azure and indigo waters with frothy white waves where the many tentacles of a kraken emerges from the depths.  Pendant lanterns of blended sea glass and black iron shed their wavering light upon coastal-themed artwork that hangs on the walls between the booths and the lobby beyond.

title: [City-States Bank]
description: Polished white marble floors reflect the lights of pendant lanterns anchored to the ceiling, the combination of reflected light and soft glow from recessed windows above effectively illuminating the space.  Arched wooden counters crafted from ancient, dusky haon line one side, each adorned with delicate silver inlays depicting various elven city-states.  Painted within panels upon the surrounding walls, a variety of murals offer bright splashes of color against the austerity of the surrounding marble.

title: [Cysaegir Bank]
description: Polished granite counters line the walls, each one adorned with free-flowing flyrsilk banners in vibrant hues.  Soft, ambient light filters through translucent panels anchored to the ceiling, each depicting dragonflies in flight, their wings catching the light and casting intricate patterns on the floor.  Between the counters, murals of Cysaegir are arranged amid those of Cysaelotar.

title: [Scales of Trade Pawn, Entry]
description: Teak walls frame the shop's interior, their surfaces lined with shelves displaying trinkets, oddities, and small treasures.  A long counter with a smooth, worn top runs along one side, its drawers filled with ledgers and cloth-wrapped parcels.  Several cases hold polished jewelry and rare coins, their surfaces reflecting the glow of hanging lanterns.  Braided rugs cover the floor, softening footsteps, while narrow windows let in gentle sea breezes.  A ladder leans against a corner shelf stacked with books.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Front Desk]
description: Arranged along the northern wall, a refurbished tobacco wood desk is attended by a young half-elven clerk who greets visitors and answers questions with aplomb.  Several hooks with either tags or keys hang upon the wall, each tidily labeled with a room number, and a wide cork message board allows visitors and locals to leave notes for one another.  The eastern and southern corridors lead toward the inn's guest rooms, while a door to the southeast offers egress.

title: [Whispering Waves Stables, Stall]
description: Blackened iron latticework stretches across the ceiling, descending in filigreed designs to mark the confines of individual stalls built into the walls of the stable.  Windows high above keep air flowing through the structure, which is cool despite the humidity outside.  Rain barrels are arranged within the center of the corridor, their tops covered in mesh to keep unwanted pests at bay.

title: [Rust and Rivet Locksmithing Co.]
description: Moonlight glistens in the wide windows at the front of the shop, casting silvery light across a workbench cluttered with tools, unfinished lockpicks, and keys.  A small brass bell above the door rings softly with each entry, blending into the faint clatter.  Bins of spare parts and coils of twine line nearby shelves, while hooks on the walls display lock mechanisms and key blanks.  The floor is scuffed but clean, with scattered marks hinting at years of steady foot traffic.

title: [Apothecarium, Healing Hands]
description: Soft, ambient light emanates from intricately designed lanterns suspended from the ceiling, casting gentle shadows across the white stone floor.  Thick vines trail from hanging planters, their tendrils framing clusters of floral-patterned cushions arranged neatly across the pebbled ground.  A central wooden table holds small bowls of herbs, vials, and a mortar and pestle, its surface dusted with faint traces of crushed leaves.  A faint aroma of blossoms and herbal infusions lingers in the still air.

title: [Melpomene Manor, Second Floor]
description: Connecting seamlessly to the space below via a smooth staircase, the room is framed by white plaster walls.  Turquoise shutters frame the windows, letting in natural light and adding a vibrant touch to the space.  Near the double doors of teal shutters, which open onto a rooftop veranda, a pair of backless curule chairs has been set.  A bespeckled half-elf agent stands nearby, quietly reading.  Overhead, an intricately carved ceiling beam runs the length of the room, adorned with motifs of tamarisk leaves and blossoms painted in soft green and pink.

title: [The Contempt, Quartermaster's]
description: An ebony door studded with golden rivets opens onto a precisely ordered chamber.  Brass-bound ledgers are stacked atop a mahogany table, joined by polished scales and stacks of silver coins.  Canvas sacks and labeled crates line the far bulkhead beneath racks that hold well-secured inkpots and parchments.  The compartment smells strongly of parchment and sharp preservatives.

title: [The Contempt, Hold]
description: Far from the open air and the activity of the other decks, the hold is dark and echoes with a symphony of creaking timbers and dripping water.  Though a skim of water lingers over the swollen planks of the deck, most of the cargo, a collection of crates, barrels, and foot lockers in a variety of makes, remains dry and secured by lengths of line.  A single sea lamp swings from a rusted iron chain overhead, throwing fitful light over the cavernous space.

title: [The Contempt, Hold]
description: Dim lamplight from a scratched iron lantern casts wavering shadows across the hold, reflected in rippling puddles scattered across the deck.  Within a loose semicircle of crates and barrels, an unvarnished oak table holds brass scales, a chisel, and neat piles of coin.  Damp burlap sacks slump along the hull.  Most exhale a sweet-must aroma of spoiled grain, but a few clink tantalizingly with every pitch of the ship.

title: [The Contempt, Aft]
description: Beneath the thundering canvas of the mizzenmast, the quarterdeck rises imperiously toward the ship's blunt stern.  Mirrored sets of stairs ascend to the raised deck, leaving space for a black wooden hatch heavily reinforced with dark steel allowing entry to the cabin beneath.  Several barrels sit nearby in various states of disrepair, the golden frame of a compass atop one standing out against the dark wood.

title: [The Contempt, Trader's Cabin]
description: A narrow cabin lined with oaken shelves is secured by a carved black oak hatch.  Glass jars atop the shelving hold powdered indigo, starfruit seeds, and a few drying specimens of coral.  Tanned leather pouches and crates stamped with foreign seals occupy a polished walnut counter over a bunk that, while narrow, has sheets of jewel-toned silk.  Lanterns of hammered bronze cast warm light over a thick rug softening the floorboards, weighted in place by a footlocker made from polished teak.

title: [Forging Complex of the Kraken]
description: A cool breeze ruffles the canopy overheard, the tears in the fabric offering a temporary glimpse at the night sky constellations.  The salty scent of sea air wafts through the complex's skeletal walls, mixing with the smell of heated oils and metals and further punctuated by the stench of sweat.  Beside open crates filled with refined slabs of metal are iron braziers, the coals smoldering within.  Forgemaster Kutlosa stands beside the entrance to some some open-air forging workshops, a cocky grin playing on her lips.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Landing]
description: A dark gloom greets the end of the great stone stairwell as it comes to a stop at broad landing.  Pierced only by the light of a single flickering torch, the gloom gives way to a hallway leading to the east, the same direction from which flows a damp breeze thick with the smell of decay.  Footprints cover the surrounding floor in a haphazard pattern of chaotic activity, many possessing clawed toes and heels.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Library]
description: Brightly lit by the hundreds of candles that line the rafters, the small room is tidy and lined from floor to ceiling with shelves.  Each shelf holds a variety of items used for scrying, as well as several tomes of lore.  A simple desk is set in the center of the room and has a plush chair set behind it.  A quaint white oak door stands slightly ajar and leads to the Lore Circle, while a dark pine door leads to a small clearing at the back of the cottage.

title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
description: The light is so dim that you fail to see the huge mound of ice until you are upon it!  Peering closely, you discover that the mass is an ice-glazed titan who is sitting -- staring eyes opened wide and quite dead!

title: [Archeth's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the dark oak walls, and a deep red stucco ceiling rises overhead.  An iron candelabra sits in one corner of a stained oak floor.  There is a low wrought iron table on one side of the shop and an iron-banded wooden chest on the other.

Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the east and west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Standing opposite each other, a windowed blue door has the words, "Office of the Curator," etched into its glass, while a windowed brown door has the words, "Office of the Realtor," etched into its glass.

title: [Manor House, Second Floor]
description: Light shines into the end of this hallway where boards lie scattered beneath a window.  The boards have been clawed and gouged, but whether they were broken in from the outside or pulled loose from the inside isn't clear.  A chestnut door and a birch door face each other across the hallway just a few paces from the corridor's east end.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The root-supported clay walls bulge inward from both sides as if some extreme pressure has built up on the other side.  A bed of translucent lichen rises up from the floor, searching for some sign of light.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Guest Quarters]
description: The spacious wood-floored room holds the faint, sweet scent of chamomile and milk soap.  Branching off from a central common space, each sleeping quarter is furnished with a four-poster fel bed dressed in a brightly colored quilt and a polished cypress cabinet filled with simple essentials.

title: [Catacombs, Upward Tunnel]
description: This chamber seems artificial in some way you can't quite place.  The walls are still smooth, but the whole room is shaped like a teardrop laid sideways, narrowing to a small opening at its eastern end.  In the middle of the western wall is a very small, gothic-style wooden plank door with a brass sign on it.

title: [Hyacinthe's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the bamboo floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the silk ceiling, a bundle of dried flowers hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls.  An oversized sea chest is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Pretty-Up With Paint]
description: Taking up most of the room in the booth, a white linen-covered table is arranged with a palette of paints and several different brushes.  Several different patterns are painted around the walls of the booth, ranging from a vibrant green vine to a red bird depiction.  The open-air construction of the booth allows the sweet fragrance of strawberries to drift inside.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Hallway]
description: The white plaster walls are partially paneled in highly polished oak and extend to the east and west.   The warm highlights in the paneling are enhanced by light from brass ship lanterns along either wall.  A pair of carved signs, one pointing east and the other pointing west, hang on the wall opposite the arched doorway.

title: [House Sovyn, Ravenstorm's Room]
description: Decorated in relaxing shades of green and gold, everything in this room is scaled to giantman proportions.  The first thing you notice is the large ornate fireplace sending the odor of burning white birch throughout the room.  The plush forest green carpet muffles your footsteps as you walk in and notice the plants growing in all four corners.  A large solid bed rests up against one wall near a solid oak desk.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: Built above the Ring Loop and accessed via the stairs from below, this walking path is similarly wide but twice as tall, formed from the same pearlescent white stone walls found throughout Nyessem.  Instead of a ceiling, a pale blue mist hovers in the air, mimicking a clouded sky.  Next to the stairs is a stone cart with refreshments and a small sign.  Pillows are intermittently spaced for taking one's ease.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: The hall stretches off to the northwest and southeast, covered in a fine, red plush carpet.  A finely carved mahogany railing offers a good view of the common room below, showing bustling activity as people wander to and from the bar.  An ivory-inlaid oak door sits nestled between a pair of small paintings along the eastern wall.

title: [The Tailor's Muse]
description: The faint glow of dozens of silk-strung faerthiel illuminates the frame-covered walls of the boutique, the tiny baubles radiating outwards from a tall mirror set above the marble counter.  Glazed glass vases are interspersed between silk-draped mannequins caught in various balletic poses, their arms raised towards the staircase leading upwards towards the melodic sounds of instruments echoing across the steps.  A rose-carved cabinet stands against the far wall, stacked with rolls of rich fabric.

title: [Zellyle's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Manor House, West Entryway]
description: Moonlight washes over the once-beautiful tiles that cover the floor of the entryway in front of the oak entry door, but the boards beneath have warped, causing the tiles to crack and buckle.  Hallways lead from here to the north and south wings of the house, and a third corridor with several doors off it runs due east.  Pieces of broken wood beneath the window by the entry door are all that remain of a small table and chair.  A curving stairway leads up to an overlooking landing on the second floor.

Hallways lead from here to the north and south wings of the house, and a third corridor with several rooms off it runs due east.  Pieces of broken wood beneath the window by the entry door are all that remain of a small table and chair.  A curving stairway leads up to an overlooking landing on the second floor.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Tier 2]
description: Curving around the atrium, the second floor frames the grand circulation desk below, its presence marked by a tile mosaic in teal, white, and canary yellow.  Towering bookcases stretch toward the vaulted ceiling, their warm wood tones complementing white wrought iron railings.  Lanterns perch atop the posts, casting dappled light across the floor.  Above, staircases spiral toward the next level, their curves forming a clover arch over a quiet reading alcove nestled beneath its embrace.

title: [Luminaries and Aromatics]
description: Silken standards, bearing various denominational insignias and mounted directly into the wood floorboards, line one side of this room.  In front of the standards is a two-tiered glass table with a large candle-centered floral arrangement.  Scattered rugs, hooked from vibrant silk yarn, appear like colorful shadows under the weight of the cabinets that hold them to the floor.

title: [A Stone Chamber]
description: A single oil lamp hanging from the high vaulted ceiling illuminates the small oval chamber.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Firmly bolted to the wall at one side of the room is a small, cast-iron ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Lisera's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a high arched ceiling, a trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  An elegant silver jewelry rack and a heavy lead glass display case sit in opposite corners while an alabaster bathing maiden statue rests on a glossy black ebonwood floor.

title: [Calantha's Caravan, Work Space]
description: The cramped area at the rear of this caravan has a single cushioned folding stool positioned in front of a wall-to-wall oak counter spread with organized boxes of wares.  Above the counter is a recessed alcove stocked with bits of chalk, a spool of measuring cord, and a pinking iron.  A miniature silver crown chandelier is suspended from the ceiling on a short chain, casting flickering candlelight on a collection of rose pink silk pillows.

title: [Ruined Structure, Interior]
[Reconstructed Temple, Interior]
[Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
[Granite Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
description: The interior wall here has crumbled, the granite compacted and buckled beneath an immense stone shed by the outer wall.  A quick glimpse of the empty space between the walls offers a view of several small bundles tucked inside, each bound in leather cording and dusty.

Several whole and partial floor tiles are strewn at the base of the wall along with a pair of nippers, and a grout-covered sponge has been left soaking in a shallow basin of grey water.  Across the way, a section between pillars has been chalked out on the floor, a crude illustration indicating a future feature of the temple.

A few heavy crates packed with straw sit side by side against the wall, while a length of decorative wrought iron railing is propped against the pillar, awaiting installation.  A trio of iron brackets mounted high on the wall remain empty and awaiting items to display.

A bone-numbing chill haunts the outer edge of the temple sanctuary, and the only sound is the guttering of the candles set on a many-armed candelabra.  Two niches carved deep into the granite walls house a variety of ghezyte statuary, some bearing the damage of age while others seem newly sculpted.  From time to time, the candlelight catches on the metallic inclusion of the granite, giving the illusion of movement when glimpsed from the corner of the eye.

title: [Shallimar's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a twisted iron sconce hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a gilded maple cabinet sit in opposite corners while a woven Vornavian silk rug rests on the black marble floor.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, East Turret]
description: An openwork iron staircase rises up in a sharp spiral, ascending the levels of this small turret.  The walls have been painted a pale hue that contains a mottled shading of cream with touches of silver, more like moonlight shining on a field of snow than the flames of a white-hot inferno.  An arched doorway leads out to the garden.

title: [Trading Post, Wicker Room]
description: This room is full of wicker furniture and art, much of it in disrepair.  Some of the wicker is painted, but most of it is not.  Wicker chairs sit next to wicker tables.  The only piece of furniture that is not wicker is the bed, which sits against the wall opposite the door.

title: [ArborSong, Dungeon]
description: Stepping down the flight of stairs, a cold iron-barred cell contains a small threadbare cot, while a pair of dark iron rings set into the floor and two within the ceiling and a small rack are all that remain inside.  A long broom lays on the floor outside the bars near a large wooden lever that appears to control the cell door.

title: [Mitsoku's Niche]
description: The ceiling of the hollow slopes downward in this area, forcing those much taller than a dwarf to stoop, and the walls draw closer as the chamber narrows.  Strings of lights twinkle like summer fireflies from their place on the walls, draped over and around a variety of shallow nooks and knotholes.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Bedroom]
description: This small room attached to the larger great room of the cottage was probably the master bedroom.  It is completely empty now, except for a few small bushes that have sprung up through the floor near the window of the north wall.

title: [Studious Pursuits]
description: An oil-filled silver sconce hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls, and a dark and light oak ceiling rises overhead.  An iron candelabra sits in one corner of an ash grey granite floor.  There is an open-front willow display case on one side of the shop and a claw-footed wide mahogany desk on the other.

title: [Palma & Evynn's Room]
description: This is a room somewhat larger than most on this floor.  Soft pastel colors adorn the walls and brightly-colored curtains give a warm family atmosphere to the surroundings.  Nearly tripping over a child's rubber rolton, you note that room has been made for a child's bed to one side along with all the myriad items needed to keep one amused and clean.

title: [Aies Apartment, Archival Salon]
description: The stone stele that conceals most of one wall is itself partially hidden behind the cover of a paneled screen.  A domed glaes case sits near a wooden arch, while a low table is overshadowed by a carved pillar and wooden statue.  The polished plank floor and high silver gilt-paneled ceiling reflect the multicolored daylight coming in through an arched mosaic of glaesine tiles, which wraps around the silvered rectangle of a slender door.

A domed glaes case sits near a wooden arch, while a low table is overshadowed by a carved pillar and wooden statue.  The polished plank floor and high silver gilt-paneled ceiling reflect the multicolored moonlight coming in through an arched mosaic of glaesine tiles, which wraps around the silvered rectangle of a slender door.

title: [Andraiah's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Crimson Raven, Bar]
description: A polished cherry bar extends along the south wall of the room, behind which can be seen an impressive selection of wines and liquors.  Soldiers mill about, some leaning against the bar having a solitary drink, some gathered in conversation around a few tall tables, and some crowding around the arch to the game room, people-watching.  A large mirror over the back of the bar has been painstakingly cut into the shape of a raven, with shallower cuts picking out the detail of feathers, beak, and glittering eyes.

title: [Dhairn's Armory]
description: A battered iron helmet hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and a knotted oak ceiling rises overhead.  A suit of silver-chased armor sits in one corner of a sturdy planked floor.  There is a long varnished counter on one side of the shop and a series of low oak shelves on the other.

title: [Tippy Toes, Entry]
description: A richly carved mahogany carriage loaded with wooden trunks and wicker baskets is parked in the middle of the high-ceilinged foyer.  To the north, an archway separates the tack and equipment storage area from the living quarters beyond.  The fragrant scent of hay mingled with oiled leather hovers in the chill air.

title: [Dry Ring Pool]
description: A raised island sits in the middle of a sunken granite ring, and a granite stairway rises from the center of the ring to a room above.  From the marks all along the sunken ring, it appears that people descended the stairway from above in order to draw water from a sunken ring pool.  Once-colorful frescoes, now faded and cracked, adorn the walls above the outside edge of the pool.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Sanded, unpolished wooden planks cover the walls.  The room seems neither hot nor cold, bright nor dark, simply an extension of existence.  Grey cotton pillows have been piled in the center of the room, provided for kneeling and contemplation.

title: [Museum Member's Suite]
[Museum, Member Lounge]
description: This reception area is restricted to use by members, patrons, donors and the elite of Wehnimer's Landing, to gather and entertain like-minded culture mavens.  The marble floors and walls are highly polished, reflecting the limpid light that filters through the stained glass skylight overhead.

In the middle of the ceiling, a large crystal chandelier descends to illuminate the inlaid wooden dance floor in the center of the room.  Various stained glass skylights dot the ceiling in an artfully haphazard fashion, each one a different scene of upper class society.  Along the northern wood-paneled wall, a long cloth-covered table is laden with refreshments.  Against the opposite wall, several plush velvet settees rest on the green marbled flooring that runs the edge of the room, offset from an intricately patterned silk curtain in the corner.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Unlike the lower floors of the tower, this level was built with no dividing walls connected to the outer shell, so archers can move easily around the tower's perimeter.  Also, counting reveals that each of the tower's walls visible from here are pierced by ten arrow slits.  A steel-sheathed trapdoor, hinged along the side of the opening where the stairway comes up from the second floor, can be closed to isolate this level from access below and to provide solid footing for the arrow slits above the stairs.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Running down the length of the hall, the deep cerulean carpet continues along this side of the manor.  Ornate pewter sconces hang at regular intervals along the wall.  A small cushioned chair stands against the wall among the various doors that lead to private rooms.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The openings of small pipes are visible through the muck on the walls.  To judge from the smell, they used to deliver raw sewage into this main tunnel.  The tunnel continues to descend, as the darkness and humidity seem to close in around you.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique]
description: The heady scent of mixing essences wafts fragrantly around this section of the boutique.  Several porcelain bowls filled with crushed coloring agents line the back shelf, where a dwarven woman works mixing them.

Colorful bits of powder and cream decorate the rose-embroidered linen upon the glass display, the stains creating watercolor-like designs that complement the vellum paintings along the walls.  An etched iridescent glass counter dominates the center of the area, the glass container diagonally facing a tall wood-framed mirror, both pieces decorated with an elaborate floral motif.

title: [Signed, Sealed, Delivered]
description: Thick lengths of dark blue velvet cover the walls of the spacious wagon.  Gathered tightly, the drapery ripples as it cascades to the floor creating a puddle of rich material.  Crafted from thick oak, a large writing desk dominates the shop.  On one side of the polished top is a vase full of quills while on the other is a small wooden tray of wax.  In the center of the two is a pile of various parchments and paper.  Set back in the room is a small stack of boxes that rest underneath a pair of silk-lined shelves displaying a wide variety of rings.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Dining Area]
description: Resting on an elevated section of the faded wood flooring, a serving cart appears ready to topple over from the weight of its burden.  Thick layers of sawdust mixed with straw cover the floor completely in some places.  Strategically placed to offer a modicum of privacy, as well as to hide gaps in the floorboards, a tall serving counter is centered amidst a score of wobbly tables with stained and discolored tablecloths.

title: [Been Shanked Lately?]
description: Sturdy oak beams frame the lean-to and its roof, while heavy taupe oilcloth hangs in weighty lengths over the top and down the sides.  Expertly tanned hides and pelts line the interior, adding insulation to protect the heat rising from the small wood heater tucked into the corner.  A single, double-sided knife display sits directly in the center of the space, with each end adorned with an anatomical dissection chart, detailed with artist renderings of various animals.

title: [Tallytoe's Salvage]
description: Staves, polearms, and other long, stick-like objects protrude from an old oak bin to lean against the rum-stained wall.  Treasures, trinkets, and trash glint inside a cracked porcelain basin, which has been carefully positioned to cover most of a rather suspicious-looking dark brown stain on the rug.  From the top of a rickety walnut coat rack, the unblinking yellow glass eyes of a molting stuffed owl stare at passing shoppers.

title: [A Run-Down Desolate Cottage]
description: Cobwebs span every corner betwixt the walls and ceiling, some so laden with dust that they sag like worn out party banners, while others are still occupied by their creators and their mumified and cocooned prey.  The hearth is cold, but full of ashes, its outer masonry stained with soot, and a broken wooden chair lies discarded before it.  A single threadbare rug and one small table are the cottage's only other furnishings.

title: [The Last Enclave]
description: Beneath a jagged dome of opaque crystal, scarlet silk banners dangling heliodor tassels stretch from wall to wall overhead, brazenly displaying their grey tower sigils.  The crystal of the dome is suffused with magical energies, pulsing from sullen crimson to angry red before subsiding once again.  Steps lead up from a pair of iron-riveted doors so that a greeting host will always stand higher than newly-welcomed visitors.

title: [Delirium Manor, Pantry]
description: Set beneath a narrow window, the shelving and racks in this little pantry are similar to any other.  The contents, however, are not.  Front and center is a basket of hands, though it is unclear whether they are real or manufactured.  Propped up heads, turned to face a panelled wall, are spaced across the lowest shelf.  Alongside the peculiar array are fruits, vegetables, and a few sacks of grain.

title: [Wehnimer's Gallery, Foyer]
description: The black marble floor is polished to a high sheen, in contrast with the pearl grey granite columns lining the room.  Four archways lead to different wings of the Gallery.  Bare spots, with slightly brighter paint than the rest of the wall, indicate where items have been removed from above three of the arches.  The graven image of a female human face hangs over the last arch.

title: [After Thoughts, Mess Hall]
description: Encircling a multitude of dilapidated chairs, mangled copper handrails hang futilely from a glassless-windowed circumference of wooden plank walls.  Dominating the center of the hall, a warped three-legged table intermittently teeters on the soft, rotted wood deck.  A pitted copper canopy overhead blocks out most of the sky.

title: [Bard Guild, Shop]
description: Floor-to-ceiling windows have tops fitted with stained glass in bright red and copper hues, while the shutters that flank them are open to allow the salt-laden sea breezes to trickle in.  Opposite the windows and across the rug-covered floors, a double wide archway provides egress into the Great Hall.  Eastern and western bookcases provide a variety of wares for sale, the shelves watched over by an apprentice.

title: [Necropolis, Egress]
description: A thick blanket of mist stretches across the entire area, making it difficult to know what is ahead.  A putrid smell of swamp lingers in the cramped space, coming from an outward direction.

title: [Delirium Manor, Dining Hall]
description: Dozens of tables clad in pristine white linens fill this open dining space.  Fine china and stemware garnish the tall tables, while wooden dishware and utensils serve as place settings on the smaller tables.  A basket of kittens is tucked in a corner, but none seem to be moving, and an odd smell emanates from within.  Wooden sideboards set with colorful platters grace the northernmost wall.

title: [The Brewery, Stable]
description: Silver-hued driftwood planks form the finished facing of the stable's walls, while thick ship ribs provide structural support.  Lanterns are bolted to the inverted keel at even intervals, the bright illumination dispelling shadows and highlighting a tidily swept birch floor.  Tacked to a central post is a crisp vellum chore list outlining the duties of any proper horse owner, the lone lantern above it shedding light upon the east-facing door just beyond.
location: The Brewery, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Four Winds Bank, Lobby]
[Mist Harbor Bank, Lobby]
description: Exotic potted palms line the walls, their fronds gracefully reaching out creating a canopy of leaves that tickle the ceiling.  Between the trunks of the palms, a hint of the rich mahogany wall peaks out.  Handwoven imported grass rugs cover the wood floors.  Patrons come and go irregularly, a small group occasionally stopping to mill about in quiet discussion before continuing on through an intricately carved maoral arch that leads farther into the bank.

title: [Cluttered Intersection]
description: This room has been set aside for the storage of the many tools used by the Gnolls during their mining operations.  Picks, wheelbarrows, shovels and hammers are just some of the various types of hardware that are scattered about in this area.

title: [Locker Alcove]
description: You are standing in a tiny room whose facing wall is an array of small, locked doors.  A locker has been removed for you and is sitting on a small counter.

title: [Dungeon, Green Tunnel]
description: Both the amount and the stench of the luminescent green substance have accumulated at this far end of tunnel.  The tunnel rotates fairly quickly in a clockwise manner, making it very difficult to stand upright.  A faint grating noise can be heard as the tunnel grinds on its course, spinning in a disorienting fashion, around and around.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: The construction of the terrace is clearly not of humanoid design, eschewing conveniences like steps and siding and favoring organic shapes with odd elongations.  Looking as if it is grown rather than shaped, the stone has wide pores and a faintly translucent patches that are reminiscent of rosin.  At the terrace's northwestern extreme, it stretches into a languid bridge spanning to another platform constructed above the lowest reaches of the cavern.

title: [Reticent Repose, Sitting Room]
description: Subtle moonlight casts an eerie glow through some frosted windows surrounding wide alder doors, while golvern sconces illuminate a gold-framed portrait suspended above a marble fireplace.  Shadows waver over an elaborate rug centered upon dark mahogany floors between two plush couches.  Twisted silk ivy garlands woven with dried grapevines hang across ivory walls, their lengths strung with clusters of ceramic berries.  In a darkened corner of a bare wall, a beveled mirror hangs opposite a set of mahogany double doors inlaid with gilded eahnor wire.

title: [Forge and Hearth]
description: The mahogany planks comprising the shop walls are covered in copper-framed drawings of dense tree-covered woodland areas, the depictions varying through mediums of charcoal and paint.  Between the artwork are vertical diagrams of flatware and crockery, each piece carefully detailed in flowing calligraphy, the illustrations set alongside their matching counterparts across a glass-filled display.  A bare countertop of wood-framed stone sits at the back of the shop, unadorned save for an aged brass lamp.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Cavern Home, Junction]
description: A northwest/southeast corridor crosses a northeast/southwest corridor.  The gelatinous trails along the ceiling also cross, and bursts of energy coming from different directions sometimes pass without colliding.  At other times they arrive at the junction point simultaneously, doubling their illumination power for just a moment before continuing along the ceiling once more.  The rippled walls and ceiling cast no shadows, nor do they reflect the light in any great quantity.

title: [Cacographic Critters]
description: Rough-hewn planks form the walls of this cramped shed, and chilled drafts attest to the lack of skill in their assemblage into their current configuration.  In sharp contrast to the shack and the questionable nature of its continued existence, a polished brass lantern rests atop a glass-fronted case that stands in the middle of the floor.  Its glow illuminates the case, a small velvet-topped table to one side, and some free-standing shelves holding stacks of writing materials, each stack topped by a rock to keep the sheets off the floor.

title: [Kobold Mines, Entrance]
description: This is a wide section of cavern that slopes rapidly downwards into darkness.  The rock-strewn floor has been worn smooth by the passing of many feet hauling heavy loads.  Several smaller caverns and chambers open up in several directions, but in the uncertain light their contents remain hidden.  Twin streaks of rust vanish downslope into the chill and damp air of this benighted domain.

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: You wander in between mounds and pillars and walls of quartz, the twisted patterns making your eyes cross a bit as you wonder where that dripping sound is coming from.  In the middle of a blink, you catch a glimmer of something gold!

title: [Shear Delight, Scents Of Self]
description: Sticks of incense rest in several carved wooden holders on a low counter that traverses the muted beige walls that surround this room.  The heady scents of sandalwood, lavender, and orange mingle in the air, offering a calming atmosphere to the area.  Several sofas against opposite walls offering a place to relax, and potted ferns add a touch of color.  A sign and a rectangular mirror stand upright on one of the counters, while several attendants loiter about.

title: [Li'aerion, West Parlor]
description: A ceiling washed in deep blue and indigo is studded with sparkling diamonds of white, yellow, and pale blue.  Constellations form and scatter as the gems inexplicably shift positions, as though the domed ceiling were fluid rather than stone.  The gems reflect the light cast by the flames of white candles, clustered on a low silver oval table.  A large grey sheepskin rug is soft underfoot, dotted with some tasseled blue velvet pillows.  The walls are bare, save for a black silk tapestry on the eastern wall.

title: [Merchant's Guild, Anteroom]
description: This small antechamber has a desk with several important-looking documents scattered across its surface.  An oil lamp burning provides some dim light.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Victory Barracks, Armory]
description: The armory stretches to the left and right from the entry, the windowless space lit by lanterns hung at intervals along the walls.  Several steel weapon bins containing an assortment of weapons line the walls, while numerous sturdy leather dummies wearing various suits of armor stand single-file down the center of the room.

title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
description: Jagged fingers of metal point from the walls and roof at a thousand angles like a mob of kobolds asked to give directions.  The ground is awash with rodent urine and there are more squirrel pellets piled across the sodden ground than gems in an archmage's coffers.  If you lived here, you'd have a bad attitude too.

title: [Zandactyl's Armory]
[Zandactyl's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter sit in opposite corners while a bronzed drake sculpture rests on a speckled black marble floor.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Convocation]
description: Tiers formed in a semicircle funnel down to a single stone podium.  Each level is lined with pale grey carpeting that blankets most of a dark verdant marble floor.  Obsidian benches cushioned with ebon velvet stand in rows upon each echelon, their sides carved with a single triskele.

title: [Zul Logoth, Winding Tunnels]
description: Tunnels branch off in every direction.  Tiny, white-flecked fungi grow in clusters along the rocky floor.  Heavy footsteps echo from somewhere deeper in the underground network.

Several small puddles reflect the light of the resident phosphorescent moss.  Water occasionally drops from the ceiling, landing with an audible *plop*.  The air is slightly stagnant throughout the area.
Part of the wall has been chipped away at, an apparent attempt at creating yet another tunnel.  Slender stalactites hang low, covered with glowing, mottled green-blue moss.

A faint scent of salt clings to the air, a result of the natural deposits in the rock and dripping water.  Grooves in the floor, obscured by the darkness, create a hazard for those wandering these tunnels.
Diffuse light emanates from the bluish-green moss thriving within the confines of the tunnels.  Roughly scrawled upon the rocky walls are several arrows, each pointing to a different passageway.
Snaking paths have been cleared through the rock, crisscrossing at this juncture.  A faint coat of slime covers several of the rocks here.
Clusters of reddish crystals sparkle among the rocky walls.  Several of the stalagmites have had their tops hewn off, with the rubble strewn across the uneven floor.

title: [Cleodelia's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by refurbished driftwood walls, the shop features a multicolored giant toy rolton in the center of its honey oak floor.  A round mithril-framed window hangs under the skylight-set ceiling.  Right near the front is a bronze-framed clothing rack and a velvet-lined silver jewelry box.

title: [Ashorien Brothers Movers]
description: Rough and undyed wooden crates of all sizes have been assembled and arranged, each one sporting a fire-branded number for ease of selection.  A few crates standing next to the doors bear the same address and tufts of dried fibers used for packing peek out around the seams.  A sign with rates hangs on the wall, next to a parchment calendar circled with today's date.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Constant vibrations are causing silt and dirt to shake free from the ceiling.  Light catches the particles on their way down and gives the area a rainlike effect.  The falling dust in this area only worsens the poor visibility provided by the dim light of this cavern.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Workshop]
description: This room is clearly utilitarian in design and usage.  Cluttered wooden tables line the walls, interspersed with bookshelves of various sizes and shapes.  Alchemical tools adorn some of the tables, while others hold flawed gems, or piles of parchment.  A large chandelier is suspended from the ceiling, lit with bright yellow flames that cast a bright light across the entire space.

The cluttered workshop has become a maze of wooden tables, bookshelves, and oversized alchemical tools, the potential shortcuts cut off by stacks of parchment covered in splatters of paint.  A battered wooden chest overflowing with flawed gems has been marked with a large arrow to indicate the correct pathways, the jewels casting fractured rays of light emanating from a barely dangling chandelier.  Small pockets of space interspersed between the stacks of books show evidence of hidden inhabitants.

title: [Sevannha's Outfitting]
[Sevannha's Magic Shoppe]
[Sevannha's General Store]
description: Beneath an elegantly arched fel ceiling, an old elven war banner hangs on one of the red brocade walls.  A carved oak table and an elegantly carved oak armoire sit in opposite corners while a pile of unmarked crates rests on a glossy black ebonwood floor.

title: [Cavernfast, Riverwalk Point]
description: The tunnel opens, offering a view of River Ne'Halin, which lends its chorus to the carved walls in a gentle harmony.  The water glistens in the soft lamplight, its roiling surface reminiscent of a great serpent arching its back just beneath the surface of the swift river.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The air smells unbelievably fresh, and you inhale great gasping breaths, having nearly forgotten what fresh air smells like.  You seem to have reached the end of the tunnel, as it empties out into a large underground river.  The slope is quite steep, and the small stream of sludge would be racing along, if it was any less thick.

title: [The Brass Ring, Storage]
description: A small herd of carved wooden horses in various states of disrepair are crowded into a makeshift corral taking up most of the available storage space above the carousel.  Leather reins and tarnished bits hang on oak-paneled walls on both sides of a cedar cabinet filled with evenly spaced shelves.  Suspended from the low ceiling by lengths of faded velvet, myriad brass rings, each polished to a mirror shine, reflect the flickering light cast from a pair of lanterns mounted near the stairway.

title: [Tymseram's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, an old elven war banner hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  A iron-bound ebonwood chest and a gold-veined black marble counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a dark mahogany floor.

title: [Playing Dead, Showroom]
description: Decorated in muted dark tones, the small showroom features an elegantly carved ebony coffin to one side and a velvet-draped table to the other.  A simple dark grey curtain partially obscures a doorway leading to the back of the wagon.  One of the candles has been snuffed out on the far wall, leaving a corner shrouded in shadow.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Front Desk]
description: A long, polished mahogany desk takes up most of the northern space in the room, its front surface carved with a bas-relief of a large kraken with tentacles that reach to the outer edges of the desk.  A series of slots and pigeon holes line the wall behind the surly innkeeper, a few of the room keys visible inside their recesses.  A plush sanguine runner travels the length between the foyer and front desk, its soft material covering the rough oak floorboards.

title: [Sylvanfair, Heathyr's Room]
description: These spacious quarters are littered with arcane tomes, artifacts and implements of sorcery.  Centered against the far wall, an elegant round bed is draped by a lavish blanket of fire cat fur, with a dramatic painting hanging on the wall above it.  To the left is a modwir dressing table with an oval mirror mounted in its back and framed by two brass sconces.  A curtained window highlights the wall to the right and piles of books and scrolls are scattered below it.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is very dark inside this tunnel.  The floor continues to rise as loose bits of rock crunch underfoot.

title: [Genivie's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and a mistwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of the wooden floor.  There is a glass-topped mistwood counter on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Shear Delight, Lobby]
description: Plank driftwood flooring extends out in a wide expanse, broken only by several standing aquaria filled with blue water and several saltwater fish in varying hues, from vivid orange to deep violet.  Several exits reside in the white wood-paneled walls, an ovular black metal doorway to the east, a curved brown arch to the north, a pale tan-striped curtain to the west, and a pale driftwood hallway leading back to the salon.   An oversized window allows in the natural light from outside, illuminating the room with golden sunshine.

title: [Strange Skins, Backroom]
description: A rank odor, seemingly the combination of decaying flesh and tanning solution, wafts from the piles of animal skins stacked about the room.  Makeshift torches set a flickering glow against the crumbling cavern walls, as dwarven workers filter in and out of the area with supplies.  In the center of the room is a long wooden workbench strewn with tools and various tarnished metal objects.

title: [Monastery, Abbots' Room]
description: The furniture in this room seems to have withstood the passage of time well.  A large four poster bed stands against one wall.  There is a wooden chair in one corner, adjacent to a plain wooden table.  Against the north wall stands a large bureau, with torches mounted on the wall on either side of it.  There is a large frame hanging over the bureau, but there is nothing mounted in it.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Alchemist, Hallway]
description: Massive chunks of stone and fallen timbers force anyone who would traverse the hallway to duck and weave through the hazardous ruin, a labyrinth made more disorienting by the light dusting of broken glass sparkling from every surface.  Although shadows dominate the wreckage, a single shaft of moonlight lances down through a gaping hole in the ceiling, illuminating a round spot on the dusty, threadbare hall rug.
