Although shadows dominate the wreckage, a single shaft of sunlight lances down through a gaping hole in the ceiling, illuminating a round spot on the dusty, threadbare hall rug.

title: [Koops' Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an oval-shaped speckled marble counter on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: The floor here is bare hardwood, polished to a sheen by generations of passing feet.  Large wax candles set in sconces along the walls cast a yellowish light along the hallway.  A polished wooden staircase leads down.

title: [Glarstim Cavern, Shack]
description: An assortment of fishing equipment is prominently displayed on the glimmering racks that are carved right out of the shack's walls.  Miniature potted toadstools illuminate the cozy space with variable hues of soft white, blue, and peach.  Tacked onto a hanging bulletin board are the names of fishermen with descriptions of their prize catches.

title: [Sintik's Weaponry]
[Sintik's Outfitting]
description: A ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and a mistwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  A sharp wooden guilotine sits in one corner of a speckled black marble floor.  There is a gilded maple cabinet on one side of the shop and a bloodstained marble slab on the other.

A ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls, and a mistwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  A sharp wooden guilotine sits in one corner of a speckled black marble floor.  There is a gilded maple cabinet on one side of the shop and a bloodstained marble slab on the other.

title: [Gryphon Holding, Stables]
description: Redolent of hay and horses, the stables are clean and well-tended.  Grooms and stable boys move about the numerous stalls, their efforts acknowledged by contented whickers echoing almost conversationally.  At one end twin destriers stand in adjacent stalls, their eyes bright and ears flicking alertly as they stamp to and fro, anxious to greet their riders.  Caparisoned barding of black, ruby, and silver is laid out on a stand next to each steed, along with a monogrammed leather saddle.

title: [Gylterhom's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is an ora-bound large walnut trunk and a wide faenor-trimmed table.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Slick Ledge]
description: The ledge is wet and hot to the touch.  Just holding on is a chore, and blasts of steam slap against the rock as if hoping to tear all life away and hurl it into the vengeful maelstrom.  Down below a dark opening seems to lead to a tunnel from the crashing surf, for every now and then a great wave crashes in, only to be vaporized almost instantly as it meets the lava flow.

title: [Sanctuary of the Mind]
description: Honeycomb-shaped cubbies ring the space, their compartments fitted with tomes and neatly rolled scrolls, while lanterns placed along the upper ledges cast a steady light.  Shielded vessels filled with ruby red coals maintain a dry, even warmth, their glow steady beneath protective grates and lids.  A thick fleece rug spans the floor, its dense fibers muting footsteps and softening the acoustics within the sacred chamber.

title: [Hot Baths]
description: Serpentine gold-scaled dragons flank the sides of a large pool bubbling with heat stretching across the room.  Rearing out of the watery depths is a glittering drakes head statue, its maw open to gush forth a huge stream of steaming hot water high up into the air and back down with a splash.  Lustrous marble columns ringed with silver leaves mark the edges of the circular pool, their surfaces trailed with tiny droplets.

title: [The Sea Chest]
description: The inside of this old shed still looks like...a shed.  At any rate it's clean, and a single table holds an assortment of traditional seafaring accoutrements.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The walls of the cramped tunnel are pockmarked with a multitude of tiny holes, little streams of water trickling down from each.  Fed constantly by the small streams, the floor is slick and slippery with moisture, slime mold flourishing in the damp environs.  The globules of grey ooze glisten with a multicolored sheen, whorls of color swimming across their lumpy forms.

title: [Buttons Table]
description: A sealed, glass decanter filled with hundreds of buttons sits at the center of this rectangular table.  The buttons bring to mind visions of overstuffed halflings, bellies popping from their vests after a third dinner for the evening.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Moonsedge, Smithy]
description: A cadaver hangs from the soot-blackened rafters of the smithy, his flesh ravaged with claw-marks and bites as if wild animals have been at the body.  The forge has been cold long enough to have a silvery coating of dust over it, and the leather of the nearby bellows is torn to shreds.  Weapon blades of iron and steel lie in a pile on the ground, fused together by rust.

title: [Hall of Records]
description: Scribes once worked furiously at these four desks, detailing all of the actions taken by the Council and its servants.  The shelves are crammed from floor to ceiling with papers and scrolls:  census records, imports, exports, treaties, council meetings, and military actions.

title: [Emblematic, Workroom]
description: The walls of this narrow workroom are decorated with numerous emblems.  A short table and bench are covered in artist's tools, and pots of differently colored powders and fluids are organized in a nearby rack.

title: [The Companion's Companion, Eats]
description: Large palm fronds line the walls, giving the small alcove a slightly crowded feel.  Pushed together as if to make more shopping room, a pale-colored natural wood block, a tiered silvery modwir stand, and a metal-hooked spinewood rack offer a variety of containers and provisions for the discerning companion owner.

title: [Brewmaster's Tap, Cellar]
description: While floor-to-ceiling beer kegs betray this space as a storage area, puddles of fresh ale show it's still a popular drinking spot in this bar.  Upright kegs and smaller casks serve as makeshift tables and seats, all illuminated by the unsteady flickering candlelight of an overhead cast-iron chandelier.

title: [What Suits Zoo, Backroom]
description: A sturdy cedar door anchors the bare, unpainted floor of smooth rock, which supports a large workbench bookended by heavy chests of tools and precious metals.  Various taxidermied birds of prey hang overhead from steel wire, while murals of woodland creatures, furry and scaly alike, wrap around the walls.

title: [Monastery, Council Room]
description: In the center of the room stands a large triangular table cut from a single slab of granite.  A large faceted crystal globe hangs over the table, and three smaller ones adorn each corner.  A lone chair sits on each face of the triangle that forms the table.  Five feet behind each of those chairs rest two more with a small table between them.

title: [Timor's, House Annex Hallway]
description: The hallway floor is warped and uneven.  Ceramic oil lamps hang from the ceiling, bathing the hallway in a flickering light.

title: [Underway, Cavern]
description: Standing apart, as if accorded some special regard by the Dwarven masters that sculpted the statuary in this cavern, the broken base of a fluted stalagmite pedestal is all that is visible here.

title: [Hallway]
description: A staircase leading down to the cellar is flanked on either side by oaken pedestals topped with decorative statuary.  Framed portraits and landscapes done in a variety of styles line the outer wall.  While each piece of art is aesthetically pleasing in its own right, the ensemble as viewed together seems somewhat mismatched.

A staircase leading down to the cellar is flanked on either side by oaken pedestals topped with decorative statuary.  Framed portraits and landscapes done in a variety of styles line the outer wall.  While each piece of art is aesthetically pleasing in its own right, the ensemble as viewed together seems somewhat mismatched.  A small crystal oil lamp hangs from a hook at the top of the stairs, illuminating the descent.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Observatory]
description: The catwalk encircling the lofty chamber seems dangerous, suspended on very thin wire supports attached to the transparent bubble overhead.  At the sphere's center, a colossal machine dominates everything, its gears, arms and pulleys so numerous, no self-evident logic can be determined by looking at them.  A flight of tenuous stairs, likewise suspended on thin wires, leads up to a higher vantage point.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: A mound of polished skulls has been stacked with intricate precision so that their peak is just shy of reaching the ceiling.  A fence of golden chain has been built around the bones, securing them in their place of eternal honor.

title: [Durgrimst's General Store]
description: Beneath a white painted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the gilt-trimmed white marble walls.  A large carved haon rack sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the cherrywood floor.

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Inlet]
description: A ruby-toned velvet runner protects the polished dark glaes hallway that transitions into a narrow stairway outfitted with an elaborately silverworked banister.  The steep ascension ends at a well-appointed landing decorated with some blooming bright sanguine geraniums in squared terracotta planters that frame an oversized ebony doorway.
location: Emberglaes Hearth, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Huff 'n' Puff, Center]
description: At the center of the canvas-covered barge, a large opening in the roof above affords the chimney from a wood burning stove a place to vent its sooty smoke.  More hooks dangle from the supports overhead, appropriately place near the fire, to help cure the bundles of tobacco.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Withdrawing Room]
description: The walls here are cloaked in shadows and faded tapestries, their subjects now obscured.  Remnants of old rugs lie on the flagged floor.  The wooden rafters of the ceiling are festooned with birds' nests and the webs of spiders long since gone, like decorations for some dreadful festival day.  In this chamber, time seems bound only to the measured tread of decay.

title: [Silvergate, Mapmaker's Room]
description: Several leaded-glass windows allow a flood of light into the room, bathing the massive cartographer's worktable in bright light.  Scattered on the table are the tools and products of the mapmaker's trade.  A small, brass-paneled fireplace remains unlit.  An ornate bookcase takes up much of one wall.  The room is brightened by an exotically patterned rug covering the polished parquet floor.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: Your footsteps echo through the large, open sanctuary.  Chandeliers hang from the square beams above you, the red wax dripping from them looking disturbingly like blood.  Overturned and splintered pews litter the floor, sprinkled with sparkling dust from the ruined stained glass windows in the walls.  To the east opens a collapsing archway, sagging beneath the stone above it.  A pair of double doors opens to the south.

title: [Cavernfast, Ne'Halin River End]
description: A large courtyard overlooks Stonestep Clinch.  On the plaza's north edge, a low granite wall serves as the only boundary preventing a plunge down into the dark water of River Ne'Halin.  A mosaic inset with colorful stones covers the courtyard's floor, depicting an intricate pattern of knot-work that circles a central spiral.  A full yellow moon sits in the nucleus of the design, reigning proudly in its own firmament of tiny stones.

title: [Honeyed Gears, Backroom]
description: Cool lamplight casts gentle shadows across polished floors and pristine surfaces.  Shelves, each flawlessly aligned, display labeled containers and gear-lined cases.  Near the far wall, a smooth walnut writing desk gleams beneath perfectly stacked folios, its drawers closed flush.  The faint scent of ginger and old ink lingers like a quiet promise of precision.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Grawood Flowers]
description: Although somewhat dusty, the shop is otherwise tidily kept, its interior lit with simple lanterns that hang from several beams in the ceiling.  A single wide row of wooden racks stretches across the center of the floor, its upright fixtures holding up baskets filled with various flowers.  On the far wall, just behind a long counter, a sliding panel is affixed in the open position.  Windows placed high up on the walls allow a glimpse of the starlit sky outside.

Although somewhat dusty, the shop is otherwise tidily kept.  A single wide row of wooden racks stretches across the center of the floor, its upright fixtures holding up baskets filled with various flowers.  On the far wall, just behind a long counter, a sliding panel is affixed in the open position, allowing a view of the field of flora sprouting into bloom outside.  Windows placed high up on the walls allow sunlight to stream into the shop to bathe the wares in a pale golden glow.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Temple of Koar, Narthex West]
description: Culminating in an alcove, the western end of the high-ceilinged narthex centers around a sculpture of polished brass.  Set atop a mosaic-tiled dais, the statue is many times taller than a living man.  Candles set in alcoves about the room lend their unified light to the metal, setting it brightly aglow.

title: [A Dark Shaft]
description: Endless tangles of cobwebs hang down from the ceiling, finding their way into your hair and clothes.  The walls here are scarred with pick marks but evidently the miners gave up in favor of other more profitable sites.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Broken pieces of mining equipment lie scattered about the tunnel.  One large mining pick juts out from the wall next to a chalky-white outline.  The pick is the only unbroken piece of equipment in the area.

title: [Hevalt's Weaponry]
[Hevalt's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a raised fel panel ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a bamboo rack sit in opposite corners while a bronzed drake sculpture rests on the oak floor.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: Grey, time-worn limestone walls provide a grim atmosphere to this wide hallway.  The high ceiling and thick layer of pale silt covering the floor provide hints that the passage may once have boasted a smooth, plaster veneer.  A narrow crack in the northern wall starts just above the floor and climbs toward the ceiling from east to west.

title: [Cysaegir Exchange]
description: Facing a wide archway is a single maple counter upon which sits a pair of quills and a large inkwell.  Thick black curtains have been drawn over all the windows, casting the room in perpetual darkness, save for the glow of three sconces set into the stone wall.  Behind the counter, the exchange clerk sits on a tall four-legged stool, his face plagued with a perpetual look of boredom.

title: [Murkshev's Outfitting]
[Murkshev's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the rough pine walls, and a deep red stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is an iron-banded wooden chest on one side of the shop and a lacquered wooden shelf on the other.

title: [Harborside Haberdashery]
description: Neatly arranged rows of boxes stacked upon each other against the walls display an assortment of styled hats, along with tiny plaques etched with prices in silvers.  An order counter at the back of the shop is shrouded in a haze of tobacco smoke, where a petite woman with a gem-adorned headband shrewdly gazes at everyone who enters.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel, Storage]
description: A series of steps leads down from a large stone archway into a long, narrow chamber built under the earth.  Large timbers line the walls and support the earthen ceiling above a dirt floor.  A broken goat cart lies discarded and dust-covered in one corner, joined in the opposite corner by several empty crates.  The roars of jungle trolls reverberate faintly from the direction of the ceiling.

title: [At The Ready]
description: Simply assembled planks of black oak and limestone compose the outer structure for the fairly spacious dwelling.  Dusty iron lanterns hang from the four cobweb-strewn corners of the squared space, emanating with a dreary, wavering glow that spreads over a high-backed aged teak chest and a rough-hewn white cedar rack.  Arranged at the back, a splintered mistwood case is bookended by a heap of discarded whittling tools and haphazard curls of lumber scraps.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Attic Storage]
description: Old furniture, trunks, crates and the like are spread chaotically around the room.  Some have been hastily covered with sheets, others were simply jammed into any available space.  Old clothes and piles of shabby china add to the rubble.  The only thing left clear of chaos is a large full-length mirror which leans against a wall, almost hidden in a shadow.

title: [Sacristy of Domination]
description: Small renderings of each of the Arkati have been painted on the walls that ring this room, all gazing upward at the impressive fresco overhead.  Set at the center of a raised circle of black slate, an ornate grey mistwood throne carved to resemble an elegant tangle of thorned vines dominates the setting.  A row of torches behind the throne cast an uneasy, wavering light across the chamber, elongating the sharply-curved barbs into distorted shadows that creep across the floor.

title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
description: The well's bucket is firmly lodged in a mass of frozen tree limbs and dried brush.  The rope holding the bucket, grey with frost, dangles slackly above, rising upward like a wisp of smoke.  There doesn't seem to be any way to get farther down.

title: [Fethilryn's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a fringed crimson silk banner hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a long mahogany rack sit in opposite corners while a sphere-topped black marble fountain rests on a dark oak parquet floor.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: A damp breeze blows in through a warped door tucked away in an alcove in the west wall.  Dead leaves skitter across the floor, leaving tracings in the dirt.  To the north, at the head of the sanctuary, the altar sits above the floor level for all to see.  Once a comforting presence, the altar now seems dead at best, malevolent at worst.

title: [Ebb and Flow]
description: Elaborately paneled with a mosaic of coral, the ceiling rises high above in a dome of brilliant, vivid colors that depict the bed of an ocean.  Rays of natural light from narrow slats in the ceiling penetrate swathes of chiffon in shades of blue, green, and silver cut to resemble ocean currents cascading down from above.  Shelves are built into the walls and a few racks are placed about the room to display items for sale.

title: [Temple of Rot, West Transept]
description: Deep, short steps rise up from the nave toward the temple's chancel, curling away from an obscenely feminine statue of bronze.  Urns of pale jade are spaced along the outer steps, holding sirenflower, lavender, and lilac.  The plants are overgrown and seem almost too healthy, the green of their stems so vivid as to be unnatural.

title: [East Woods, Tunnel]
description: Several trickles of water collect in a small pool at the end of the passageway.  The water gleams faintly in the subdued glow of the lichen lining the damp walls.  Dark and oily, it looks as unsavory as it smells, but the multitude of animal tracks pressed into the muddy tunnel floor around the pool indicates that it is a popular source of water for the denizens of the tunnels.

title: [Victory Barracks, Dormitory]
description: A dozen military-style cots fill the dormitory, each outfitted with a single, firm pillow and a coarse wool blanket.  A wide, flat footlocker lies at the end of each cot, leaving just enough space to walk comfortably between them.  The quiet snores of the few off-duty guardsmen drift through the room.

title: [Tyrrah's Armory]
description: Enclosed by textured red silk walls, the shop features a horse-mounted female statue in the center of its ebonwood floor.  A gold and crimson wyvern tapestry hangs under the arched fel ceiling.  Right near the front is a carved oak table and a gold-veined black marble counter.

title: [A Rustic Cabin]
description: A fire burns cheerily in this one-room cabin's fireplace.  Spartan furnishings convey a sense of loneliness and a lack of concern for creature comforts.  In one corner a cot resides, covered with an unkempt grey blanket.  A single chair snuggles up to the rough-hewn pine table in the room's center.  The cabin's door is propped open, allowing fresh air to circulate liberally.  Much of it is drawn up in the fireplace's rising heat, carrying the scent of cooking stew out through the chimney.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Upper Hallway]
description: Heavy curtains block the starlight from streaming through vast windows along the eastern wall, necessitating the candles carried by grotesques in arched nooks along the walls.  The small, comical gargoyles bend as if to surveil a dark-stained pine door, which is etched with a spread-winged raven surrounded by falling feathers.  A grey-trimmed scarlet carpet runs up to the foot of the door to soften the cold stone of the walk.

A grey-trimmed scarlet carpet runs up to the foot of the door to soften the cold stone of the walk.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Adytum]
description: The solemn surroundings are more befitting the priests and priestesses who dedicate every hour of their lives to the temple, than a mere trespassing worshipper.  Lit with several oil lamps set in iron sconces, rows of onyx benches stand in a circle around a central altar.  Steel grey vestments chased with crimson-threaded flames hang from several hooks along the walls.  Three arched openings lead to smaller alcoves off the main chamber.

title: [Aagor's Armory, Helms]
description: The light of brightly burning brass lanterns glints off polished metals everywhere the eye looks.  Solid oak posts and beams serve as a support structure to prevent damage from cave-in.  All manner of metal armors and accessories fill the shop, pride of craftsmanship evident in how they are maintained and displayed.

title: [Lewk's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A twisted invar rack and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a rough stone floor.

title: [Ranger Guild, Squirrel Room]
description: Dimly lit, this room has a dank, musty smell to it.  In the dim light provided by the sole lamp one can make out row after row of small cages.  Peering inside the cage closest to the door reveals that the occupants are bushy tailed squirrels.  Further back in the room is a small desk with little scraps of paper and a sign on it.

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: The tunnel walls are hot enough to burn your hands if you touch them.  This narrow passage slopes deep into the mountain, channeling hot air up toward the surface.  Looking downslope, you see an orange-red glow at the far end of the tunnel.

title: [Balantine's Outfitting]
[Balantine's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an engraved copper bin on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Gardeth's Outfitting]
[Gardeth's General Store]
description: Beneath a glossy modwir plank ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gilded maple cabinet and a bamboo rack sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a mistwood plank floor.

title: [Rogue's Gambit, Entry]
description: Oil lamps with inverted conical shades hang directly over the merchandise displays situated about the interior of the pavilion, providing ample light under which the goods for sale can be examined, while leaving the rest of the space crowded by dim shadows.  Tucked into the only well-lit corner is a small round table with a discreet vellum note card posted among the wares, and off to the side is a rack of dark metal hangers.

title: [Serenity, Work Alcove]
description: Small and intimate, this alcove is carpeted with a gold rug woven with black abstract patterns.  The only furnishings are a large fel cabinet and some sapphire silk cushions for seating.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Unwilling to disrupt the symmetrical spacing of the arrow slits along the tower's west wall just to provide access to the tower's roof, the builders constructed a narrow, freestanding set of steps that rise from near the wall of the inner chamber and end little more than a pace from the outer wall.  Empty quarrel bins and an empty barrel, of a size to hold cloth yard shafts, are lined up along the wall between the arrow slits.

title: [Starshadow's Room]
description: Candles too numerous to count line the walls, filling the air with their heady and almost seductive scent.  A black wrought-iron four poster bed dominates the room, dark green silk tapestries hanging from the sides.  A fire burns quietly in the fireplace, and hung over the mantle is a portrait of Noi'sho'rah.  The floor is made of pure black obsidian, inset with a circle of copper.  Strange runes surround the circle, compelling to both the eye and the mind.

title: [Silken Mist, Casino]
description: Plush padded velvet chairs and a thick luxurious carpet are but a few of the expensive alterations made to this shipboard casino. Even when gambling, nothing less than the ultimate in comfort for the customers is acceptable.  All of the crew are dressed in elegant silk attire, the women in long gowns and the men in fitted doublets and breeches.  Based on their wide smiles, they all seem to greatly enjoy their jobs as dealers or servers.
location: Silken Mist on Four Winds Isle

title: [Black Table]
description: An etched silver lamp illuminates this dark corner.  The soft satin fabric covering the table is delicately embroidered with silver runes and the surrounding chairs are upholstered with soft black velvet.

title: [Rianon's Outfitting]
description: A woven floral tapestry hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls, and a glass-tiled vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  An ornate bottled ship sits in one corner of a swirled sea glass floor.  There is some carved haon pegs on one side of the shop and a wide knotted oak counter on the other.

title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
description: Giant toadstools tower, shedding a pale blue luminescence upon this slight bend of the tunnel, causing diminutive veins of black opal to shimmer faintly.  Hanging above the numerous brightly-colored doors are boldly painted signs advertising each merchant's names.  The faint aroma of cigar smoke filters in from a small niche frequented by resting miners.

title: [Alchemy Workshop]
description: Smooth black stone walls with circular windows and low ceilings create a chamber of comfortable proportions.  Ample enough to carry out one's work, yet small enough to keep focused on the tasks at hand.  A sturdy workbench sits at the very center of the room, fully equipped with the necessary apparatus to pursue alchemical transmutations.  Low, black-painted wrought iron lamps cast enough illumination to glint off the translucent still on the workbench.

title: [Monastery, Living Quarters]
description: This room appears to be used as living quarters for those who reside in this stronghold.  A row of six bunks lines each of the walls and a row of a dozen cabinets stands opposite the doorway.  A large table stands in the center of the room with a half dozen chairs scattered around it.  Mounted onto the ceiling is a large cast iron chandelier with dozens of small, lit candles dropping wax down onto the top of the table.

title: [Rakish Accoutrement, Entry]
description: A multitude of liana vines woven together artfully form the walls and ceiling of this cozy shop.  Set in opposite directions, two smaller rooms are somewhat visible from this main entry, each boasting their own unique selection of wares.

title: [East Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the northeast and southwest.  High, vaulted ceilings vanish into the darkness high above, dimly lit by flaming sconces that line the walls of carved basalt.  A pale haze of smoke drifts through the still air.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Entry]
description: Dull dark mahogany panels the entryway of the establishment, the wood probably once rich but now dusty and unpolished.  Plain egg-and-dart wainscotting adds some definition and design to the otherwise boring walls, splintering in several spots where it remains intact.  A flight of crooked wooden stairs leads up to a small landing, and double-width lintelled doors brace the hallway on each side.  Paralleling the staircase is a narrow corridor leading toward the kitchen.

title: [House Sovyn, Sinn's Room]
description: Cool air surrounds you, permeating your being.  Candles on a seven-sided altar provide the only light in this dim room.  Shadows cast by the flickering candlelight shift in a macabre dance over the floor-to-ceiling bookshelves lining the walls.  Papers and opened tomes are strewn on a desk in organized disarray.

title: [Labyrinth, The Unending Path]
description: A series of large chutes snakes back and forth above, swiveling and swerving in and out of the shadows.  Small motes and specks of dirt and dust dance slowly downward, visible in the streams of moonlight that break in through the holes in the ceiling above.

A series of large chutes snakes back and forth above, swiveling and swerving in and out of the shadows.  Small motes and specks of dirt and dust dance slowly downward, visible in the streams of daylight that break in through the holes in the ceiling above.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: A faint light trickles in through the cracks in the ceiling, as the tunnel continues to drop.  In the distance, you can hear the faint scratching sounds of vermin being about their business.

title: [Icemule Trace - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Solindago Anox, Office]
description: Clean white stucco walls run down to hand-tooled ebonwood wainscoting and up to brushed silver ceiling tiles all around this simple room.  A large rolled-edge mahogany counter separates the entrance from a narrow hall leading to various administrative offices.  A heavy rolled velvet rope stands in the way of further progress, a painted sign stating boldly, "Under Construction."

title: [Market of Lost Things]
description: Lanterns of tinted glass sway from chains overhead, painting the planked floor in drifting patches of red and turquoise.  Stacked crates form a crooked walkway between crowded stalls displaying their wares, the underlying clink of coins echoing throughout the market.  Along the starboard wall, a crudely painted kraken points the way to the nearest exit.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, West Rise]
description: Reflective flecks of quartz and mica glimmer along the small tiles lining the web of walkways along the western rise of the cavern.  Lacy, glowing bluish-grey moss clings to the edges of the several large holes, highlighting the openings that lead to the guild's alchemical workshops.  A faint odor of sulfur and salt lingers in the air.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Trails of hoof prints lead in from the north and turn into the adjacent tunnels.  A slight breeze of musty air makes itself known though you are not certain from which direction it originates.

title: [Burning Twilight, Entry]
description: Pendulum lanterns of frosted glass dangle from the lofty ceiling of bright blue azure, each creating bright pools of golden sunlight.  Grass green floorboards, swept clean and left uncluttered, support a long, oak counter where weapons are displayed within the pools of light.  Stained glass decorates the edges of the large picture window that gazes out on the dirty thoroughfare, while a radiant sun in goldenrod and dandelion yellow fills the door's frame.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: A clammy chill descends upon your skin as you take a moment to survey the enveloping gloom.  A tunnel carved through glistening black rock stretches as far as the dim light allows you to see, to the east and west.  Hundreds of cramped, oblong tombs open out of the walls wherever space permits.  Most have remained sealed but others have collapsed or been pillaged over time.  A thin rivulet of water runs east down the center of the floor.

title: [Twilight, Lower Environs]
description: Illuminated by eight freestanding copper fire pits, these environs are meticulously clean and dry.  Light from the pits dances about the area, providing a warm, almost cheerful, glow.  The faint sound of flowing water echoes through the cavern, although no obvious source exists.  Carved into the bedrock are numerous chambers, many carefully fitted with secure frames and doors for privacy.  In the center of the cavern, a wide column rises up to the ceiling and beyond, a spiral staircase carved into its bulk.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Tunnel]
description: A shimmering band of crystal glints in the dim light of the tunnel.  Milky white with flecks of gold, the mineral vein might be a rare form of quartz, although its exact nature remains mysterious.  The low rumble of flowing water can be felt beneath the stone floor.

title: [Murkshev's Magic Shoppe]
description: A colorful Icemule map hangs on one of the dark oak walls, and an ash grey plaster ceiling rises overhead.  A polar bear rug sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is a large brass-bound chest on one side of the shop and a heavy wooden desk on the other.

title: [Lorsan's Weaponry]
description: The walls are draped with peacock blue curtains pooling onto the floor.  The black ceiling is dotted with silver paint that sparkles above, giving the illusion of the night sky.  Carved ivory columns stand in the corners of the room, lined with ivory shelves between them.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Isle Designs, Walls]
description: This area of the building has been made to mock a scene at a relaxing beach.  Several layers of fine, white sand cover the floor, dotted with seashells and dried seaweed.  In the center of the room, an oversized red and white umbrella has been forced into the sand and is surrounded by sandcastles and tiny bright red crabs.  From the fishnet-covered walls protrudes a set of driftwood shelves, the only sign that there are items for sale.

title: [Nihala's Auditorium, Backstage]
description: Nervous energy lingers in the small space, belied by cluttered vanity mirrors and disheveled costume racks shoved off to the edges of the room.  A stone chimney stretches proudly up the back wall through the darkened timbers of the ceiling, though the slightly smoky quality in the air suggests a less-than-perfect draw, even for the timid fire presently burning.  An elaborate painting of a halfling with caked-on makeup in a tutu has pride of place over the mantel.

title: [Merchant Complex, Roramnoak]
description: Below a series of torches that cast their golden light on this area, some sturdy shelves of walnut display all kinds of cloth and leather baggage.  Stacked along the wall below are larger storage containers for customers who want to move more goods.  A worn stool next to a cupboard off to the side provides the owner of this shop a place to rest their butt and beverages.

title: [Sooty Surface Table]
description: Evidence of a contained fire abound in this tiny booth.  Not only does the presence of greasy soot seem to cover the table and every other existing surface, but also the lingering odor of charred hair confirms that something went awry for an unfortunate individual in the not-so-distant past.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel]
description: The absence of light in the tunnel magnifies the sound of the water trickling down the stairs and the smell of the dirt.  The wide plank steps are moldy and slippery underfoot.  A slight breeze rises up the tunnel.

title: [Twisting Tunnels]
description: A maze of tunnels leads away from this small chamber in all directions.  The low ceiling, poor lighting, and sudden twists and turns make it impossible to see far enough in any direction to get your bearings.  Some passageways lead only a few feet and dead end, while others twist and turn in odd directions before opening into another chamber.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Squirrel Haven]
description: Sky blue washed walls surround the plush green carpeting of this nature-inspired room.  The ceiling is decorated with white fluffy clouds.  An oak tree-shaped bookcase stands in the far corner of the room, its branches covered sparsely with green felt leaves and hanging multicolored lanterns.  Along the opposite wall rests a lacquered oak bench topped with coppery velvet cushions.  Sprawled in the middle of the room lies a peach and white checkered blanket covered with fuzzy squirrel-shaped pillows.

title: [Wine Cellar]
description: The temperature of this chamber is a bit cool, but not unpleasantly so.  Several rows of wine racks fill the room.  While most of the bottles are of elven vintage, there are a few other rare labels as well.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Lake Chamber]
description: Molten lava bubbles and explodes at the center of the lake of liquid rock that fills this chamber.  Large enough to hold a couple of good-sized manor houses, the heat trapped in here begins to sear exposed flesh within seconds.  The level of the lake must have been higher in the past since a ledge of black basalt circles the room and extends into the lava pipe to the west.  Part way up the chamber's dome a patch of sky is visible through a gaping hole in the basalt.

Part way up the chamber's dome a patch of night sky is visible through a gaping hole in the basalt.

title: [Kaldonis's Outfitting]
[Kaldonis's General Store]
[Kaldonis's Magic Shoppe]
[Kaldonis's Smuggled Rubbish]
description: Hung silk walls rise from a thickly carpeted floor.  Just above a potted palm tree hangs a silken sea-themed tapestry, and a silk-covered ceiling completes the picture.  An aqua-hued seaglass display and a warped treasure chest stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: This portion of the island is covered with white sand and black stones.  The rocks seem to be scattered about randomly, but oddly all of them are exactly the same size.  There is no telling what they are made of, as the material of the stone is very unfamiliar.

title: [Heart of the Temple]
description: Large brass pillars surround this central chamber, reaching up to the high vaulted ceiling.  Intricate mosaics decorate the floor with a complex spiraling pattern.  Numerous monks sit in quiet prayer, entranced by the thick incense floating skyward.  In the center of the room stands a raised dais supporting an intricate altar, and above you glimpse several worshippers peering down over the balcony.

title: [Erykk's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Lahlia's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by woven grass divider walls, the shop features a pile of wooden shoe lasts in the center of its bamboo floor.  A trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs under the silk ceiling.  Right near the front is a vine-carved mahogany table and a long mistwood counter.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemic Room]
description: Moonlight slants through the driftwood-framed windows that break up the stark white monotony of the limestone walls.  Orderly rows of alchemy devices placed upon a white-washed oak workbench gleam in the golden light and provide ample illumination for the tiny alcove.  A dark ebon curtain is framed by brass lanterns, which currently burn brightly.

title: [Constabulary, Entry]
description: Large cobbled stones plastered with stucco form the walls of this windowless room, while thick iron bars create a barrier between the common area and that of the detention area.  Rough wooden benches form a loose waiting area in front of a baluster-surrounded counter where moldy and dust-covered papers are stacked in orderly piles.  Stretching along the eastern wall, a set of stairs rises to towards the second floor but sharply turns towards the north as it disappears around a corner.

title: [Wizard Guild, Shaft]
description: Vaalorn sconces cast a steady, bluish light over this circular room.  A wide walkway rings a shaft bored clean through the granite of the tower, allowing access to the two Guild towers at this level.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Miniature shop replicas sit upon a long counter display, each one with a different style of roof.  Several samples of the various materials available are displayed nearby, offering some suggestions about the choices possible.

title: [Hallway]
description: A delicate silver mobile dangles from the ceiling, tinkling softly from a stray breeze drifting in through an open window.  A narrow wooden table opposite the window holds a vase of wildflowers which stir gently in the draft.

title: [River's Rest, House Clerk]
description: Rough planks of axe-hewn wood cover the walls of this small shadowed office.  An old carpet lies before a scarred wooden counter, the pattern unrecognizable.  Standing on uneven legs, a crude bench rests against the wall next to a broken crooked door.  Hanging from the far wall is a patchwork blanket sewn from sail material.  A rusted anchor stands in the corner, bits of coral still stuck to its surface.

title: [Barrow, Altar of the Tenth]
description: A large, circular chamber yawns at the barrow's end, lit by roaring violet and crimson flames roaring from torches in sconces around the room.  Crudely carved from porous black stone is a squat, misshapen figure with membranous bat-like wings.  He stands atop a defaced altar of crimson-stained stone.  Staring down at the scene is a three-faced etching in the wall that has been slashed and raked so badly as to be almost unrecognizable.

title: [Myra's Millinery]
description: Simple wooden shelves hold chiseled wooden heads, each adorned with a tailored hat in various styles.  Several standing rack hold more hats, caps, and hoods.  Display cases for ribbons, feathers, and various sorts of hair adornments reside on the show counter.  The millinery stocks a wide variety of fashion and everyday headwear.

title: [Off the Beaten Trail]
description: Thick oak poles stand in each corner of the tent, holding the oilcloth canopy up overhead.  A round marble pedestal sits off in one corner of the tent, while a large mahogany map table occupies much of the central floor space.  An oilcloth flap hangs across the rear of the tent, concealing the back portion of the structure.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Bedroom]
description: The most prominent feature of this room is the four-poster bed against the wall opposite the door.  Each of its posts reaches almost to the ceiling before joining a rectangular frame that surrounds the bed, from which is draped a series of diaphonous curtains.  A small table is set near the bed, and a large iron-latticed lantern stands in one corner of the room.

title: [River's Rest Room]
description: Pale blue walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the southeast.  The focal point of the space is a swirling sunny yellow portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  River reeds and water lilies have been etched into the metal, their shapes intertwined to form a complex pattern.  A warm breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of River's Rest and the fresh fragrance of rain.

title: [A Dark Alcove]
description: Devoid of potential distractions, this dark alcove provides a refuge for training and deep contemplation.  Shadows flit across the opening of the tunnel leading back to the main cavern.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A cool draft blows down the spiral stone staircase in this corner of the hallway, sending the dust on the floor into intricate spirals in the air.

title: [Lounge Lockers]
description: Warm light filters through the curtained opening, faintly illuminating the simple cell.

title: [Naora's Outfitting]
description: A painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the glazed bamboo walls, and a sturdy bamboo-rafter ceiling rises overhead.  An elegantly woven reed mat sits in one corner of an intricate patterned floor.  There is a warped treasure chest on one side of the shop and an aqua-hued seaglass display on the other.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: This tight, north-south hallway is dark and dank.  Musty smells from the warehouse below waft up though obvious gaps in the floorboards.  Sawdust and discarded bent nails litter the floors.

title: [Anemone Villa, Maiden's Refuge]
description: Golden sunlight spills through the large floor-to-ceiling window that occupies the northern wall.  Azure paint provides a gentle backdrop to the white curtains and bedspread, while polished cherrywood boards create a warmly hued floor.  A narrow rattan bed fashioned of beige rattan is positioned against one wall to provide ample living space.  Resting in a corner, beneath a drop lantern of polished glass, is a round rattan chair.

A narrow rattan bed fashioned of beige rattan is positioned against one wall to provide ample living space.  Resting in a corner, beneath a drop lantern of polished glass, is a round rattan chair.

title: [Amicable Apparition Table]
description: A border of painted paper decorates the walls of this nook.  A repeating pattern runs the length of the papering, depicting a floating apparition.  Despite his dead state, he looks really quite friendly and chatty.  A haon table carved with the same pattern stands in the center of the booth.

title: [Dark Grotto, Cavern]
description: A sour, fetid odor fills this cavern, stinging your eyes and making breathing difficult.  A strange, gritty substance covers the floor of the cavern which crunches when it is walked upon.  At first sight it appeared to be simply a layer of dirt, but closer examination shows it to be some kind of finely pulverized stone.  The grey-white caps of mushrooms poke up in small clusters dotted around on the surface of the grit.

title: [Myslie's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a handblown double-heart bottle in the center of its plank floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a gilded maple table and a white marble shelf.

title: [Post Haste]
description: The wood-planked walls of the wagon are covered in hand-penned parchments and sheets of vellum, interspersed with colorful sketchings and watercolor renderings framed in bamboo.  Several blanket-cradled containers are nestled between curios filled with knickknacks, each piece of furniture adorned with a variety of faded stamps.

title: [A Touch of Zrenigotham Elegance]
[Akono's Weaponry]
description: Muraled wooden walls rise from a glossy mahogany floor.  Just above some puffed raw silk pillows hangs a trio-bladed mounted vellum fan, and a mosaic tiled ceiling completes the picture.  A white marble shelf and a beveled glass-covered case stand side by side in the middle of the room.

Enclosed by muraled wooden walls, the shop features some puffed raw silk pillows in the center of its mahogany floor.  A trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs under the tiled ceiling.  Right near the front is a beveled glass-covered case and a white marble shelf.

title: [Library, Collected Lore]
description: Three walls of this room are occupied by massive floor-to-ceiling bookshelves of gleaming mahogany.  In the middle of the room, a tall podium holds a large catalog.  The area is lit by a massive glass globe filled with darting fireflies, perhaps in an attempt to protect the library's precious contents from fire.  Sunlight falls in slanting rays from the passage created by a spiraling wrought iron staircase.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is a bend in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the west wall, and passages lead northeast and south.

title: [Warrens]
description: The earthen ceiling is badly saturated from some unknown source of water and this is causing the run-off to splatter to the floor in large droplets.  The excess liquid on the ground has made the floor muddy and difficult to walk on, although a few small footprints lend evidence that others have passed this way.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Curving slightly upward, the starboard section of the bulkhead appears to be unfinished.  Exposed wooden framing supports the fitted planks that form the skin of the ship.  The long companionway stretches aft, interrupted only once by a salt-encrusted porthole.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The entire area is engulfed in darkness.  You cannot see a thing!

title: [Castle Dungeons]
description: The dim hallway comes to an abrupt halt here.  A side passage leading northwest fades into the flickering torchlight.  A slight creaking noise draws your attention to an open cell.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Lanterns hung from closely-spaced wooden beams supporting the dark sandstone walls and ceiling illuminate the wide tunnel.  Broad enough to permit the passage of three or four horses walking in tandem, the tunnel ends in a pair of large gates.  A few tufts of lichen adorn the beams, scratch-marks on the wood revealing that the lichen is regularly removed.

title: [The Four Humours, Office]
description: A barnacle-covered tapestry stretches across the back wall of this cramped office, partially covering the polished wooden wall underneath.  A wide claw-footed desk takes up most of the space, while an elaborately embroidered rug spreads across the floor.  The subtle scent of medicinal herbs wars with the sharp, metallic tang of blood in the still air.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Sunroom]
description: A spacious sunroom is sequestered from the grand hall by lush silken curtains that are the color of fresh-spilled blood.  Opposite the draperies, a wide stained glass window allows in daylight, the grey and scarlet panels staining the radiance with jeweled colors.  Near to a velvet fainting couch, a semicircle of chairs sits facing away from the windows.

title: [Repository, Facades]
description: Carved into the moldings of the high ceiling is a multi-tiered image depicting levels of commerce, including raw materials mining, production, sales, tax, and use.  The pale grey-blue granite floors are clean and polished, bearing a number of angled counters with small replica facades that vary in size, color, and style.

title: [Diabolicoa's Outfitting]
[Diabolicoa's General Store]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a hammered copper hanging rack sit in opposite corners while a dusky blue cotton rug rests on a glossy mahogany floor.

title: [In The Rough]
description: The scent of tanned leathers and furs hangs heavy in the air in this part of the tent, as across many an oak frame, hides in various stages of tanning are stretched out.  Against the far wall of the tent sits a solid oak clothing rack, and adjacent to it is a low dark oak boot stand.

title: [Ice Hound Table]
description: A perfect ice hound head is mounted on the wall above.  A trick of the construction allows an occasional draft of cold air from outside, reminding you of the hound's icy breath.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: A towering gear-lined obelisk of panels, levers, and twisting metal rises out of the floor in the middle of the area, carrying all the way to the ceiling, where a series of thick pipes curl out and upward from it like limbs on an octopus.  Steam escapes the joints of these pipes, clouding the area around the obelisk in a haze.  The whir of machinery throughout the area creates a constant, rumbling din, with periodic vibrations rumbling the walkway and shaking the obelisk.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The shadowed ceiling ripples strangely, then squeaks.  A second glance reveals it to be a solid mass of bats, most of them juveniles.  A trio of the winged rodents swoops past you with shrill, piercing cries, defending their nest.

title: [The Rhimar Rink, Entrance]
description: Modwir walls enclose the well-sized shop, their surfaces colored with a whorled pattern of deep and light blues.  Small child-sized handprints of white paint are scattered along the walls, each one containing a scribbled name, and shaped to resemble a falling snowflake.  A large window opens near the entrance, where a burly giantman greets visitors.  A crowd of onlookers stand on the outside of a half-walled arena, watching as several people skate along a stretch of ice.

title: [Outpost, Landing]
description: Positioned beneath a domed ceiling, a circular golden linden staircase winds its circular path downward towards the lower levels.  Smooth walls, left plain and white, are interrupted only where arches provide egress.  The central arch emits a faint scent of tropical flowers.

title: [Sweet Dreams Shop]
description: Raised platforms are built around the perimeter of the shop, holding up for display a wide assortment of bedroom furnishings. The polished cedar panels dividing the wares into distinct decorative groups impart a crisp, pleasant fragrance to the surrounding area.

title: [Bettleforth's Rugs]
description: Hung from thick metal pegs on the walls are a number of rugs and other floor coverings.  Several empty crates have been stacked in the corner beside a simple invar-braced table.

title: [Obsidian Raiment]
description: Brocade rugs in shades of ebon, grey, and plum are centered on the floor covering the hard ground and giving a soft cushion for walking.  Stands and racks holding a wide variety of items are arranged against one wall.  Hanging from dark bronze chains are a trio of crystal lanterns that are positioned over a small ebonwood table.

title: [The North 'Haven Pawnery]
description: Boxes, crates, sea chests, and bulging canvas sacks are piled throughout the pawnshop in great, teetering stacks, leaving only narrow avenues between the tables of wares.  Two windows high on the plaster walls allow daylight to peek between the stacks, supplementing two small oil lanterns fixed on stout beams over the tables.

Boxes, crates, sea chests, and bulging canvas sacks are piled throughout the pawnshop in great, teetering stacks, leaving only narrow avenues between the tables of wares.  Four small oil lanterns fixed on stout beams over the tables provide illumination.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: Lit torches are mounted to either side of the doorways leading north and south.  The doorways are open, with no doors mounted in the frames to block passage.  The corridor continues to the southeast and west.

title: [Merchant's Guild, Records]
description: The only sound in this lavishly appointed room is the ticking of a wood clock.  The floor is covered with a rug of Velnalin pelts, the walls decorated with ornate stencils depicting various sorts of business transactions.  You notice a series of bookshelves, a rich mahogany desk, and an iron-bound chest.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Dining Room]
description: Mullioned windows with cerulean velvet curtains allow moonlight into the chamber, the centerpiece of which is a rough-hewn table of honey oak ringed by chairs.  The opposing wall is given over to a long aspen bookshelf holding countless tomes, its glass doors criss-crossed by wrought iron bars brushed with silver.  Patterns of gold leaf frame the coffered ceiling, highlighting a painting of battle in the streets of a port town.  A trefoil arch opens onto a parlor, while a smaller pine door leads to the kitchens.

title: [Monastery, Chamber]
description: Plush grey carpeting covers the floor from wall to wall, and a large modwir conference table dominates the center of the room with a dozen stiff-backed modwir chairs encircling it.  Covering the wall opposite the open doorway is a large tapestry hanging over a small polished modwir sideboard.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Landing]
description: The small, square hallway offers barely enough space to turn around in, and as a result, the boards here are well worn.  The wooden railing bows out slightly, probably from the frequency of hand traffic and people leaning their weight against the wooden slats while trying to get into their rooms.  A haon door is set on one side of the stairway landing and an ebonwood door is on the other side.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: A trio of dwarves stands in the center of the area, having a spirited conversation.  Their voices get louder and louder, and one begins smacking a sap into the palm of his hand rhythmically.  Perhaps the conversation is not going well.

title: [Crave Dining, Eatery]
description: Delectable scents fill the air as cozy heat tumbles through the space.  Bright lights illuminate the various dishes that are stored on tables, meat platters, and a seafood counter, while various clay soup pots warm on the many stoves at the back of the eatery.  Rhimar-lined cases house a cheese plate and a fruit bowl on one side of the entry, while drakar-lined cases keep several bread baskets and a large vegetable terrine warm.

title: [Stone Baths, Entry]
description: The room opens up into a large antechamber surrounded by walls of pale limestone, brightened from silver moonlight streaming in through glass windows.  A long navy blue rug stretches from a brass-trimmed door to a circular front desk where a female elven clerk smiles warmly.  The sound of clanking glasses is heard coming from a brass archway and glowing candles illuminate a broad hallway.

title: [Silversleeve's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Barracks]
description: Row upon row of bunk beds fills the large room.  Empty beds are neatly made while a few have sleeping Hendorans occupying them recovering from overnight patrols or guard duty.  Racks for armor and gear stand beside every set of beds offering ready access to their wearers.  At one end of the hallway is a letter writing station.

title: [Aspis Haven, Coffee Roasters]
description: The awakening scents of freshly roasted espresso and brown sugar fill the air in this cozy room.  A long maoral bar stands to one side, guarding an enormous brick-faced oven spanning the entire length of the wall.  Scattered throughout the room are several mismatched tables and chairs in a variety of arrangements.  The remaining walls boast a curated selection of small artworks and a floor-to-ceiling tapestry.  A silvered faewood bin rests below a large mounted blackboard just to the left of a green and silver chevron patterned curtain.

title: [Consortium, Founder's Hall]
description: Wide-paneled windows provide an expansive view of West Ring Road and the palisade walls of Wehnimer's Landing, with the trees of the Dragonsclaw forest rising in the distance.  Plush deep blue carpet runs the length of the floor and ends before a small step that leads to a tall modwir door.

title: [Hendor Room, East Niche]
description: Azure paint peels from the ceiling in long stripes, which are caught by the thick layers of cobwebs that cling to the corners of the room.  Splintered wood is collected in a thick pile on the northern wall opposite a blackened circle on the southern wall where someone tried to start a fire.  Pushed against the eastern wall, a glass and brass display case appears to be unscathed by the long ago blaze.

title: [On the Lighter Side]
description: Hanging from the support rafters above, a large crystal lantern brightens the small area.  Soft light glints off of the metals and precious gems used in adorning the various items on display.  A group of mannequins are placed about the room to show off the shop's wares.

title: [The Colonnade, Backstage]
description: This small space is cramped, with props and scenery piled in haphazard stacks on either side of a narrow walkway.  The rope for the curtain stretches from ceiling to floor near the light switches, the pulleys glisten with oil to avoid squeaking, and the wooden lever is buffed smooth.  Providing access to the stage are two arches, while at the back of the room, a wooden stage door leads out to the hallway.

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Exterior]
description: The tunnel opens out into a large, open, hemispherical space.  Extending from the wall is a building facade with the words "Mraent Granite Quarry" carved above a rounded archway.  A heavy iron door, smashed by some tremendous blow, hangs precariously from its hinges, no longer securing the hallway that leads deep into the darkness beyond.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: You can hear the gurgling of water somewhere behind a wall, but the exact source is difficult to pinpoint due to the hard, echoing marble.  Burning torches send shadows leaping about in a wild dance.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Lower Landing]
description: Round and cylindrical in shape, the chamber is unadorned except for a glowing malachite-hued column rising high in the center.  The white walls and floor glitter as the pale green light reflects off silver flecks of the stone.  Shadows flicker about as a shimmering ray of energy shifts and moves upon itself.

title: [Monastery, Masters' Bridge]
description: Leaves drift effortlessly about on a disturbingly cool breeze that travels across and under the bridge.  Long hemp cords bind the swaying bridge to tree branches high up in the canopy, and slender glass globes are tied to the rope hand railings.  The sound of rushing water filters across the path from a cliff that can be seen in the distance, while white cobblestones gleam in the sunlight from the courtyard that the bridge empties into at its other end.

title: [Unknown]
description: Elven archers in the livery of Vaalor stand astride an enormous marble arch.  Their arrows target a bilious green airship, but each is vaporized by a dull grey beam before reaching its target.  Below the aerial combat, hordes of animated orcs spew forth from a dark cavern, engaging in a vicious battle with two-headed centaurs defending a hillock of ice topped by an obsidian plinth.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Tunnel]
description: A cold gust of wind passes through the tunnel, a barely audible groaning following in its wake.  Motes of dust whirl with its passing, and then return to their places amid the rough sediment of the stone floor.

title: [Municipal Building, Hallway]
description: Dingy white stone walls meet dark grey tiled floor, creating a rather drab backdrop to a few sparse steel-framed chairs.  Most of the doors along the hallway have identifying signs tacked on or next to them, though a few are missing.

title: [Bent Creek Table]
description: Well known for its size, this round table is worn from the many gatherings of large crowds of customers wanting to enjoy each others company during their feasts.  Placed on the wall is a small sign bound in a leather frame.

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: The hall ends at an elaborately carved doorway that leads into a dark, open room.  A pair of stone pedestals rests on either side of the doorway, each supporting a bronzed soldier statue.

title: [Wayside Inn, Chamber]
description: Tables and chairs of all shapes, sizes and states of disrepair fill this large, undecorated chamber.  Seated at many of the tables are groups intent on serious card games.  From the far side of the room you hear the noisy cheers of a ragtag group of spectators rooting for the underdog in a wristwrestling match between the local blacksmith and an overfed member of the Wehnimer's Citizens' Militia.

title: [Guttin' Goods, Stock Room]
description: A number of featureless and weathered mannequins clutter two corners of the backroom, their bodies sporting an array of fishing attire and accessories.  A few empty ale mugs and some grimy dice rest on top of a stack of unmarked crates.

title: [Cavernhold, Large Chamber]
description: You are in center of this large chamber.  The lake lies to the north while the brewery and lichen farm are easily visible.

title: [Thanatoph, Vine Covered Shrine]
description: Stepping into the small stone shrine, you are amazed as neither dust nor dirt nor any of the overgrowth that kept it hidden from outside is present.  Echoing the loud hum outside, the walls hum with the flow of ancient power.  There is a small opening set above a stone altar, but otherwise the shrine is empty.

title: [The Red Wagon]
description: Sturdy wooden walls enclose the interior of this wagon, their surfaces sloshed with varying hues of red paint.  Overhead, a mosaic of a blue sea, complete with a large ship manned by a handful of halflings, is painted on the ceiling.  Several collections of daggers and swords hang on the walls, and a small writing desk covered with artistic sketches sits in one corner.  In the center of the room is a large table carved with a rough map and topped with an assortment of items.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: A lone stalactite has been painted with swirls of deep amethyst and streaks of sunny yellow-gold.  Elaborate feats of dwarven masonry stand on display out in front of an expansive storefront.  Idle chatter between shopkeepers, patrons, and neighbors runs together with the heavy footsteps of passersby.  Growing in the shadowed nooks of the tunnel are small clumps of softly glowing blue-green moss.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Wizard Guild, Stair]
description: A warm draft curls up from below as the temperature becomes chilly.  A solid zorchar rod extends from well below the stairway and reaches up into the observatory above.  Viridian and cerulean stained glass windows lining the narrow tower reflect the dim sunlight from outside, making the stairway brighter and casting an amorphous light on the carvings engraved along the polished stone walls.

title: [Brrr Necessities]
description: Brightly colored vials and bottles line tiered shelves and counters placed strategically about.  Several lavishly dressed ladies huddle together, dabbing their wrists and offering them to one another for inspection as they giggle and whisper among their group.  The fragrance of night jasmine intertwined with winterberries wafts throughout the space.

title: [Straight to the Point]
description: Swathes of faded midnight blue silk line the weathered wood of the wagon's walls.  A tattered dirty rug covers uneven planks used to establish the shabby floor which is littered with rusted needles.  Glowing crystal orbs are haphazardly scattered throughout the room, providing barely enough light to see.  A broken glass display case, stained with a bit of blood on one side, occupies a bit of floor space along one wall.  Against the opposite wall, a bent wire jewelry tree has been settled on top of a rotted oak end table.

title: [Souvenir Shop]
description: A variety of dried flowers hang from the ceiling, their subtle and pleasing scent wreathing the area gently.  Several baskets filled with leaves and bits of fruit are arranged on shelves, and bits of twine and other raw materials are spread across a small counter to the north.

title: [The Hair Apparent]
description: Constructed of stained oak panels that have seen better days, this squat building's low ceiling makes the space seem somewhat cramped.  Scattered on all of the walls are several dingy paintings, some of them hanging slightly crooked.  Taking up most of the room is a long display counter, its surface littered with wares for sale, while a swinging door leads further into the building.  The scent of strong cologne permeates the humid air.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Monkey Barrel]
description: Weatherworn barrels have been sealed shut and half-buried in sand, their dark lids forming a wide smile, but one has been left accessible.  A few banana peels have been tossed aside around a support beam made to look like a palm tree.  Crashed into the base of the faux tree is an odd makeshift boat created from an enormous barrel.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: The rows of bloated and maimed corpses have no end in sight, and the smell of decaying flesh and blood is overwhelming.  Flies swarm near the bodies, their buzzing providing a constant hum nearby.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: A chunk has been torn or blasted from an alabaster column, its once polished surface now marred with cracks and jagged bits.  Dried blood smears the ground along the tiled stone floor, tiny dark red flakes scattered about like crimson dust.  A terra cotta bowl resides in a corner of the hall, the depths filled with shreds of discarded selshis skin.

title: [White Haven, Chapel]
description: A multi-faceted crystal orb appears to float above a small white marble altar in the center of the chapel.  Light radiates from the orb, reflecting off the vines and symbols inscribed upon that altar and filling the room with its soft illumination.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel]
description: Widely spaced planks, rotting from age and exposure to moisture, make the floor of the cavern somewhat less treacherous.  The small room is dimly lit by a pale, glowing orb hanging in a moldy rope net.  Plank steps lead down.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: A flight of stairs opens into the office, a large, octagonal room occupying most of the building's third floor.  It has a high ceiling, rising into a dome painted with a representation of the sky.  Windows covered with wooden screens occupy most of the wall space.  Through the chinks in the intricately rendered patterns of the screens, truncated views of the town below can be seen.  A circular table sits in the chamber's center with high-backed chairs placed in a haphazard ring around its perimeter.

title: [Cleric Guild, Pantry]
description: One white half-circle wall encloses this room and its polished white tile floor.  A sturdy wooden shelf hangs by itself on the wall.  A marble-topped table serves as a centerpiece, while a store room clerk monitors the room's goings-on.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: The marble here is deep green from an admixture of hornblende.  The color varies in intensity and tone, which the sculptor has used to great effect.

title: [Bliss Island, Kitchen]
description: A massive stone hearth dominates the kitchen, its glowing embers radiating warmth along the floor.  The high ceiling has been fitted with vermilion rafters, while open windows let in the slightly salty sea air.  Laid out upon a sea glass-inlaid countertop are several trays of food and beverages.  Alternating red and white tiles have been inlaid into a square teakwood table, which has been surrounded by four matching chairs.

title: [Wisteria Winery, Vessels]
description: Various glass-front cabinets ring the small room, their shelves laden with an amalgamation of drinking vessels in a wide range of sizes, colors, shapes, and materials.  Opposite the displays is a beautiful fresco, its detailed decorations occupying the entire wall, that depicts the arkati Cholen reclining against a fountain.  Brilliantly glowing orbs dangle from the ceiling, their unwavering light dispelling any shadows from the surrounding area.

title: [Sehrgar's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an oak-framed ceiling, a pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls.  A salt-crusted sandstone case and a low wrought iron table sit in opposite corners while a knotted woolen rug rests on a varnished oak floor.

title: [Heavy Handed, Showroom]
description: A rough rectangle of burlap has been spread under the partially empty weapon stand in the center of the room, its surface covered with bits of straw that have fallen from the unpacked weapons.  Sealed crates have been neatly stacked in one corner, while another stack of empty ones have been haphazardly piled in another.  A clerk occasionally wanders through, adding inventory to the rack and making checks in a small parchment notebook.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: This plateau in the stairs is decorated with various Dhe'nar relics which provide a distraction to the vertigo-inspiring twist of stairs below them.  Stairs also lead upwards to a landing high above.  An odd electrical sensation makes your skin tingle, setting your hairs slightly on end.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tunnel Nexus]
description: Slivers of azurite crystal have been inlaid into a dizzying spiral pattern upon the cold stone floor.  The slightly arched ceiling has been carved with a swirling design that faintly resembles flowing runes.  Against the western wall, a set of onyx-inlaid doors are flanked by two recessed alcoves that house stairways leading to the lower level.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Solarium]
description: Moonlight pours through the glass roof onto lush greenery in terra-cotta pots, the petals of the scarlet hibiscus tightly closed for the night.  High-backed wicker chairs flank glass-topped sideboards set with cocktails, while green felted tables host lively card games and rolling dice.  A pair of ebonwood doors with hazy window panes opens out onto a lantern-lit patio overlooking the hotel grounds and expansive gardens.

title: [A Breath of Autumn, Clothes]
description: The air within the wagon's burnt orange walls is warmed by a long-piped wood stove tucked into a far corner, atop which sits a tiny, simmering pot filled with apple slices, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, orange peels, and star anise that fragrance the steam as it rises.  Every breath is spiced and rich, like pumpkin pie and mulled cider, and a chill trickle of air seeping in from around the door teases the burgundy cotton curtains as it passes on its way deeper into the wagon.

title: [Uxbri's Fragrant Firewood!]
description: A massive pile of split logs dominates the back of the small tent, and the pleasant smell of freshly chopped wood fills the air.  Sawdust and chips of wood cover the floor, and small footprints lead out of the tent.

title: [Wolves' Den, Stairway]
description: The stairs are steep and narrow, winding their way down into shadow.  A steady, chill draft blows up from below.

title: [Abalonia's Oceanic Artwork]
description: Beautiful wall hangings sway from the rafters in this small room, catching the moonlight and casting small rainbows of color on the walls.  A small stool rests in one corner, stacked with embroidery thread and tools.
